Application fees: US$150 program application + US$1,000 per applicant + US$750 per dependent + US$200 QRP ID card. Annual renewal: US$25. Grants Belize Residency Status (QRP Resident Card). Tax exemptions on foreign-sourced income. Option to operate a business with minimum BZ$1,000,000 investment employing 5 Belizean citizens. Duty and tax exemption on household effects, motor vehicles (max 5 years old), light aircraft, and motor boats in first year. Qualifying nationalities: Commonwealth nations (excluding Belize), USA, EU member states, select Asia-Pacific countries, all South American nations. Program confirmed active as of June 2026 re-verification.

rbi.name: Benin
rbi.program_name: Carte Zone Économique Spéciale (ZES) - Special Economic Zone Resident Card
rbi.notes: Issued exclusively to foreign investors and operators working in the Glo-Djigbé Industrial Zone (GDIZ), located 45 km from Cotonou. Valid for 5 years. Card fee: 350,000 XOF. No minimum investment amount stated on the official DEI page. Application via service-public.bj online.

rbi.name: Benin
rbi.program_name: Carte de résident ordinaire (Ordinary Resident Card)
rbi.notes: Available to any foreigner who can justify means of subsistence or a guarantee of support and has good moral standing. Valid 3 years. Card fee: 50,000 XOF for ECOWAS nationals; 250,000 XOF for non-ECOWAS nationals. Renewable; after two renewals may qualify for Privileged Resident status.

rbi.name: Benin
rbi.program_name: Carte de résident privilégié (Privileged Resident Card)
rbi.notes: Available after holding and renewing ordinary resident card twice, plus demonstrating permanent employment, immovable property ownership, conjugal residence, or a functioning business/commercial/industrial establishment in Benin. Valid 10 years. Card fee: 100,000 XOF for ECOWAS nationals; 800,000 XOF for non-ECOWAS nationals.

rbi.name: Bhutan
rbi.notes: A visa category for foreign investors and promoters. Requires prior approval from the Director, Department of Industry, Ministry of Industry Commerce and Employment (MoICE). Valid passport with minimum 6 months validity and a detailed day-wise program required. No minimum investment amount is published on the official page. Does not confer permanent residency or a path to citizenship.

rbi.name: Bhutan
rbi.notes: A residence card category for investors, managed by the Department of Immigration. Requires a letter of endorsement from the Ministry of Industry Commerce and Employment. Specific investment thresholds, duration of card validity, and path to permanent residency are not published on the official webpage. Indian nationals may use Entry Permit with voter ID; other nationalities need a visa.

rbi.name: Bolivia
rbi.program_name: Temporary Residency - Determined Purpose (Visa de Objeto Determinado) for Investors/Business
rbi.notes: Foreign nationals who invest in Bolivian businesses, establish companies, or conduct business activities may apply for a 'Visa de Objeto Determinado' (Multiple Visa for investors/business). This visa is valid for 1 year with multiple entries; maximum 90-day stays per visit. After 2 years of temporary residency, MERCOSUR nationals can apply for permanent residency. After 3 years of continuous legal residency, any foreign national may apply for Bolivian citizenship. No minimum investment threshold is specified on official sources.

rbi.name: Bolivia
rbi.notes: Nationals of MERCOSUR member and associated states may apply for permanent residency after 2 years of valid temporary residence in Bolivia. Eligibility is governed by the MERCOSUR Residence Agreement. Bolivia formalized full MERCOSUR membership via Law 1567 (July 2024).

rbi.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
rbi.program_name: Temporary Residence Based on Real Estate Ownership
rbi.notes: Foreign nationals who own real estate in Bosnia and Herzegovina may apply for a temporary residence permit. No minimum property value is specified in law. The applicant must also demonstrate a 'real and lasting connection' to Bosnia and Herzegovina (e.g., origin, children's education, pension receipt, or investment in economic activities). Issued for up to 1 year, renewable. After 5 consecutive years of temporary residence, permanent residence may be applied for. Administrative fee: 150 BAM for issuance, 200 BAM for permanent residence.

rbi.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
rbi.program_name: Temporary Residence Based on Company/Business Establishment (Work Without Work Permit)
rbi.notes: Founders of a company or enterprise registered in Bosnia and Herzegovina may apply for temporary residence on the basis of work without a work permit (business founder category). Minimum registered capital in FBiH entity is 1,000 BAM (approx. EUR 511) for a d.o.o. company. No higher investment threshold is set for this residence category. Temporary residence valid up to 1 year, renewable. Path to permanent residence after 5 uninterrupted years of temporary residence.

rbi.name: Botswana
rbi.notes: Investors may apply for Permanent Residence even if they have stayed for less than five years (unlike other categories which require 5+ years continuous lawful residence). Required documents include: certified share valuations, share certificates, certificate of incorporation, list of directors, current financial statements, title deed/lease of business premises, trading license, and BURS tax return. Fee: P3,000. Processing time: 56 working days. No minimum investment amount is stated on the official page. The gov.bw sub-page continues to return HTTP 500 errors and could not be re-scraped during June 2026 validation; details preserved from prior verified research.

rbi.name: Botswana
rbi.notes: Non-citizen must have resided lawfully in Botswana continuously for at least 5 years, be of good character, have made significant contributions to Botswana, be of good standing in society, and have sufficient means of support. Fee: P3,000. Processing time: 56 working days.

rbi.name: Botswana
rbi.notes: Any non-citizen wishing to stay in Botswana beyond the visa/visitation period can apply for a residence permit at any immigration office. Categories include dependants (18-25 years and 65+), immigrants, spouse of a citizen. Processing time: 30 working days. Fees: P1,500 for dependants. For immigrants: Form 15, Form 3, covering letter, certified passport, certified birth certificate, bank statement, proof of maintenance. The gov.bw sub-page returned HTTP 500 during June 2026 re-validation; details preserved from prior verified research.

rbi.name: Brazil
rbi.program_name: Real Estate Investor Residence Permit (VIPER - Autorização de Residência como Investidor Imobiliário)
rbi.notes: Minimum investment of R$1,000,000 in urban real estate in any Brazilian state (South/Southeast/Center-West), or R$700,000 in the North or Northeast regions of Brazil. Based on Normative Resolution RN 36/2018 (CNIg). Grants initial temporary residence of 4 years. Investment can be in one or multiple properties (aggregate value). After 4 years of residence, investor may apply for permanent residence and subsequently for Brazilian citizenship. Minimum physical presence: 14 days every 2 years to maintain status. Dual citizenship permitted under Brazilian constitution. Family members (spouse/partner and dependent children) included in same application. Processing: 6-18 months typically. Source confirmed from official MRE consulate pages (Doha, Amsterdam, Chicago) and portaldeimigracao.mj.gov.br

rbi.name: Brazil
rbi.notes: Temporary investment visa for foreign nationals who wish to invest in Brazil (individuals, entrepreneurs, or company representatives). Standard minimum investment R$500,000 in a Brazilian company; reduced to R$150,000 for investments in priority sectors or regions designated by the National Immigration Council. Can lead to residence authorization. Real estate option: R$700,000 or R$1,000,000 depending on region per RN 36/2018. Applicants must first obtain prior residence authorization from Ministry of Justice via MigranteWeb portal.

rbi.name: Brunei
rbi.notes: Introduced effective 31 December 2024. For company owners and foreign investors who meet economic contribution criteria, including job creation for locals and tax compliance. Valid up to 5 years with multiple-entry. Excludes convenience stores, restaurants, laundries, salons, and non-registered companies. No minimum investment amount stated on the official page. Pass may be revoked for law violations or failure to provide economic benefits. Does not explicitly lead to permanent residence.

rbi.name: Brunei
rbi.notes: For foreign experts and professionals whose expertise is beneficial and needed for Brunei's development. Granted based on national needs determined by relevant government bodies. Duration up to 5 years. No minimum salary or investment amount stated on the official page.

rbi.name: Brunei
rbi.notes: For foreign nationals with family ties to Brunei citizens or permanent residents who do not yet meet criteria for permanent residency. Duration up to 5 years.

rbi.name: Bulgaria
rbi.program_name: Bulgaria Golden Visa / Permanent Residency by Investment
rbi.notes: Under Article 25, paragraph 1, point 6 of the Foreigners in the Republic of Bulgaria Act, non-EU nationals can obtain permanent residency by investing a minimum of EUR 512,000 (previously expressed as BGN 1,000,000; Bulgaria adopted the euro on 1 January 2026 at a fixed rate of EUR 1 = BGN 1.95583) in Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) or Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) listed on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange. The investment must be maintained for at least 5 years. Permanent residency is granted directly (no temporary permit required first). No minimum physical stay requirement. The Invest Bulgaria Agency (investbulgaria.com) conducts mandatory pre-approval and due diligence. The Financial Supervision Commission (FSC) regulates qualifying investment funds. Processing time is typically 6 to 8 months. After 5 years of permanent residency, investors may apply for Bulgarian citizenship by naturalization. As of January 2026, investments are fully euro-denominated with no currency conversion risk.

rbi.name: Burundi
rbi.program_name: Visa de résident permanent (Permanent Residence Visa)
rbi.notes: Official migration portal lists 'Visa de résident permanent ordinaire' at $1,200 USD with 99-year validity. Requires: ministerial authorization from Ministry of Interior, letter of application, passport copy, property title, and previous establishment visas received. This is a standard permanent residence permit, not explicitly marketed as an investor program. The fee and requirements are listed on the official migration.gov.bi portal.

rbi.name: Cabo Verde
rbi.program_name: Green Card - Autorização de Residência Permanente (Real Estate Investment)
rbi.notes: A permanent residence permit granted to foreigners who purchase built or under-construction real estate worth at least EUR 80,000 (CVE 8,821,200) in municipalities with per-capita GDP below the national average, OR at least EUR 120,000 (CVE 13,231,800) in municipalities with per-capita GDP at or above the national average. Investment must be paid with funds transferred from abroad. Authorized by Lei nº 30/IX/2018 (creates the differentiated status for second-residence holders via Green Card) and Decreto-Regulamentar nº 1/2020 (establishes the implementing regulations). Application portal at e-portaldef.gov.cv. The Green Card grants permanent residence directly. Both the law and regulation are listed on the AAI (Alta Autoridade para a Imigração) official documentation portal at aai.gov.cv.

rbi.name: Cabo Verde
rbi.program_name: Autorização de Residência - Actividade de Investimento ou Actividade Económica Relevante
rbi.notes: Temporary Residence Permit for foreigners carrying out investment activity or relevant economic activity in Cabo Verde. No minimum investment amount is stated on the official page. Requires valid entry visa, criminal record certificate, medical certificate, international vaccination certificate, Social Security registration, proof of accommodation, and documentation of the investment activity (authorization/registration by competent authority, External Investor Certificate, or proof of company employing at least 50% Cabo Verdean workers, or proof of activity of recognized national interest).

rbi.name: Cambodia
rbi.notes: 10-year renewable residency visa for foreign nationals investing in approved real estate projects. As of 2025-2026, the minimum investment is reported as USD 100,000 in government-approved real estate (excluding land; condominiums and units above ground floor only). Earlier figures of USD 50,000 or USD 85,000 cited in older sources appear outdated. Administered by the General Department of Immigration (Ministry of Interior) in partnership with Khmer Home Charity Association (KHCA). Holders can apply for Cambodian citizenship after 5 years. No minimum stay requirement. Grants right to live, work, and study in Cambodia. Processing time 4–6 months. Nationals from Iran, Iraq, Lebanon, North Korea, and Syria are restricted. Note: official cm2h.com site returned no usable content; minimum investment figure based on Harvey Law Group and other immigration law firm sources as of 2025-2026.

rbi.name: Cameroon
rbi.notes: Cameroon issues long-stay visas (up to 12 months) under Law No. 97/012 of 10 January 1997 and Decree No. 2023/147 of 02 March 2023 for aliens wishing to reside or work in Cameroon. Categories include: contract workers, independent workers, long-term trainees, students, and family members of aliens staying in Cameroon. Employment contracts must be signed by the Minister in charge of employment. No specific investor minimum investment amount is published on official sources. No formal 'golden visa' or investor-specific residence program with defined thresholds exists on official government websites.

rbi.name: Canada
rbi.notes: As of 2026, investment-based immigration to Canada runs exclusively through Provincial Nominee Program (PNP) entrepreneur streams after the federal Start-up Visa Program was paused. Investment requirements vary by province; minimum starts at CAD $100,000 for some rural streams and CAD $200,000 for metropolitan streams according to non-official sources - province-specific official amounts must be verified on individual provincial government websites. Nominees then apply for federal PR through IRCC. Citizenship requires 1,095 days physical presence as a PR in any 5-year period.

rbi.name: Canada
rbi.notes: For self-employed persons with relevant experience in cultural activities or athletics (world-class level) or farm management. Must have at least 2 years relevant self-employment experience in the 5 years before applying. No minimum investment amount - program is experience-based. Leads to permanent residence and eventually citizenship.

rbi.name: Chile
rbi.program_name: Residencia Temporal - Inversores y Personal Relacionado (Investor Temporary Residency)
rbi.notes: Requires investment of USD 500,000 or equivalent in productive goods or services in the planning or execution phase (residential real estate for personal use does not qualify). Alternatively available to legal representatives, directors and senior management of foreign companies, or specialized technical/management personnel of Chilean companies where a qualifying foreign investor controls at least 10% voting rights. Requires a sponsorship letter from INVESTCHILE (Chile Foreign Investment Agency) per Interior Ministry Supreme Decree No. 177 of 2022 (Arts. 62-64). Must apply from outside Chile via SERMIG digital portal. Issued for maximum 2 years (renewable with tax folder and investment proof). After 2 years temporal residency, holders may qualify for Residencia Definitiva (permanent residency). After 5 total years of legal residence, eligible for citizenship by naturalization. USD 500,000 threshold re-confirmed on SERMIG investor page (June 2026 verification).

rbi.name: Chile
rbi.notes: Available to nationals of Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, and Uruguay under the Mercosur Residence Agreement (signed 6 Dec 2002, in force 28 Jul 2009). Bolivia-Chile bilateral agreement eliminates application fees for Bolivian nationals. Valid for up to 2 years. Holders may engage in lawful remunerated activities. Colombia, Ecuador, and Peru ratified the Mercosur Residence Agreement as of January 2024 and may also be covered.

rbi.name: Chile
rbi.program_name: Residencia Temporal - Rentistas y Pensionados (Retired Persons and Income Earners)
rbi.notes: Available to foreign nationals who can demonstrate sufficient regular income (rental income, dividends, salaries, pensions). Specific minimum income thresholds are not published verbatim on the official SERMIG page; amounts cited by third parties (~USD 1,500-2,000/month) could not be verified on the official site. Issued for maximum 2 years renewable.

rbi.name: Chile
rbi.notes: Available after 24 months of Residencia Temporal (standard), or 12 months if the applicant has family ties with Chilean nationals/permanent residents, prior official missions in Chile, stable income/pensions, active business investments, or qualifies under international agreements. Permit is valid for life; ID card renewed every 5 years. Absence from Chile for more than 2 continuous years voids the permit. Both timelines re-confirmed on SERMIG Residencia Definitiva page (June 2026 verification).

rbi.name: China
rbi.notes: Foreign nationals who make direct and stable investments of over USD 2 million in China with good tax payment records for three consecutive years may apply for permanent residence. Permanent residence card valid 5–10 years; renewable. Application fee: ¥1,500 + ¥300 card production. Processing time: up to 6 months. No official path-to-citizenship timeline stated under this program.

rbi.name: China
rbi.program_name: Permanent Residence by Foreign Investment (Central China)
rbi.notes: Reduced threshold of USD 1 million for investments in the central part of China. Same 3-year stable investment and good tax record requirement.

rbi.name: China
rbi.program_name: Permanent Residence by Foreign Investment (Western / Poverty-Relief Counties / Encouraged Industries)
rbi.notes: Reduced threshold of USD 500,000 for investments in western China, key national poverty alleviation counties, or industries listed in the Catalogue of Encouraged Industries. Same 3-year stable investment and good tax record requirement.

rbi.name: China
rbi.program_name: Permanent Residence for High-Level Talent / Senior Professionals
rbi.notes: Holders of deputy general manager roles or equivalent senior professional titles (e.g., associate professor) who have received equivalent salary in China for at least 4 consecutive years and resided in China for a total of not less than 3 years within those 4 years, with good tax records, are eligible for permanent residence.

rbi.name: Colombia
rbi.program_name: Migrant Investor Visa (M) - Real Estate Investment
rbi.notes: Migrant Visa (M) for foreigners making direct foreign investment in real estate. Minimum investment: 350 SMMLV (Colombia's legal monthly minimum wage; approx. COP 612,816,750 / USD 161,300 at 2026 SMMLV of COP 1,750,905). Visa valid up to 3 years, multiple entry. Automatically loses validity if holder remains outside Colombia more than 180 consecutive days. After holding M visa(s) for at least 3 continuous years (per official search result citing Resolución 5477 criteria), may qualify for R (Resident) Visa. Regulated by Resolución 5477 of July 22, 2022.

rbi.name: Colombia
rbi.program_name: Migrant Investor Visa (M) - Direct Foreign Investment in Company
rbi.notes: Migrant Visa (M) for foreigners investing in a Colombian company. Minimum investment: 100 SMMLV. For large-scale direct foreign investment, minimum is 650 SMMLV. Regulated by Resolución 5477 of July 22, 2022.

rbi.name: Colombia
rbi.program_name: Resident Investor Visa (R) - Direct Foreign Investment
rbi.notes: Resident Visa (R) granted directly to foreigners making a direct foreign investment of no less than USD 100,000 in their own name, in accordance with the International Investments Statute. This grants immediate permanent residency (R Visa). R Visa must be renewed every 5 years. Regulated by Resolución 5477 of July 22, 2022. Source: official Cancillería Resident Investor's Visa page.

rbi.name: Colombia
rbi.notes: A foreigner who has held a temporary/migrant visa and lived in Colombia regularly for at least 5 continuous uninterrupted years may apply for the Qualified Resident's Visa (R). Application must be made within at least 30 calendar days prior to visa expiration. R Visa renewed every 5 years.

rbi.name: Costa Rica
rbi.notes: Governed by Law No. 9996 (published in Official Gazette La Gaceta No. 135, July 14, 2021). Minimum investment of USD 150,000 in one of the recognized categories: real estate, company shares (active businesses), SUGEVAL-authorized securities, venture capital funds, tourism infrastructure, or national interest projects. Investment must be held continuously. Temporary residence issued for 2 years, renewable. Path to citizenship via naturalization: 7 years total residency (for most nationalities), or 5 years for Central Americans, Spaniards, and Latin Americans. Amount cited in Article 4 as 'not less than one hundred and fifty thousand US dollars (US$150,000.00)' - this was reduced from USD 200,000 under a sunset clause provision.

rbi.name: Costa Rica
rbi.notes: Governed by Law No. 9996 and Executive Decree No. 37112. Requires stable foreign-source monthly income of at least USD 2,500 per month. Income must come from outside Costa Rica and be demonstrated via certified bank statements. Temporary residence issued for 2 years, renewable. Path to citizenship via naturalization: 7 years (5 years for Latin Americans/Central Americans/Spaniards).

rbi.name: Costa Rica
rbi.notes: Governed by Ley General de Migración y Extranjería No. 8764 and Law 9996. Requires a lifetime pension of at least USD 1,000 per month from a competent authority (Social Security, military, retirement fund, annuity). Pension must be permanent. Temporary residence issued for 2 years, renewable. Path to citizenship via naturalization: 7 years (5 years for Latin Americans/Central Americans/Spaniards).

rbi.name: Croatia
rbi.notes: Available to non-EU/EEA/Swiss citizens working remotely via digital communication for a foreign company or their own foreign-registered company. Cannot work for Croatian employers. Duration: up to 18 months (extendable by 6 months). Income requirement: minimum EUR 3,622.50/month (2.5x average Croatian monthly net salary), or lump sum EUR 43,470 for 12 months / EUR 65,205 for 18 months. Reapplication earliest 6 months after previous stay expires. Does not count toward permanent residence under standard rules.

rbi.name: Croatia
rbi.program_name: Self-Employment Residence and Work Permit (min 51% company ownership)
rbi.notes: Third-country nationals may obtain residence and work permit for self-employment in a company in which they have an ownership share of at least 51%, or in a trade in which they have an ownership share of at least 51%. No minimum investment threshold specified in the official source. Standard temporary stay (up to 1 year, renewable). After 5 uninterrupted years of lawful residence, may qualify for long-term residence. Minimum investment amount was not stated on the official page.

rbi.name: Croatia
rbi.notes: Permit for highly qualified workers with at least a higher education diploma, working under employment contract for minimum 1 year in Croatia. Salary must be at least 1.5x the average gross annual salary in Croatia. Validity: aligned to employment contract (minimum 1 year), now up to 48 months per 2025 amendments. Path to long-term residence after 5 years (may aggregate time in multiple EU states with minimum 2 years in Croatia). Processing time: 60-day statutory deadline.

rbi.name: Croatia
rbi.notes: Available after 5 years of uninterrupted lawful temporary stay in Croatia. Requirements: valid travel document, means of self-support, health insurance, knowledge of Croatian language and Latin script. Absences up to 10 months total over 5 years (single absence max 6 months) do not break continuity. After long-term residence, path to citizenship via naturalization may be pursued.

rbi.name: Cuba
rbi.program_name: Permanent Residency for Foreign Nationals (Investment/Economic Ties Pathway)
rbi.notes: Under Law 172 (Aliens Act, approved July 2024, effective ~November 2026), foreign nationals may obtain permanent residency on grounds including: significant assets or bank accounts in Cuba, foreign families with employment or economic ties to Cuba, 5+ years of residence demonstrating deep ties, advanced degrees or expertise in science/sports/culture/arts, or as parents of Cuban-born citizens with actual Cuban residence. No minimum investment amount is stated verbatim in the official source. Also introduces 'provisional residence' as a pathway to citizenship. The new law also recognizes 'investment capacity' as grounds for residency.

rbi.name: Cyprus
rbi.program_name: Cyprus Investor Immigration Permit (Regulation 6(2) – Permanent Residence by Investment)
rbi.notes: 4th Revision criteria in force from May 2, 2023 (page last updated March 18, 2026). Four qualifying investment categories each requiring EUR 300,000 (plus VAT where applicable): (A) new residential property (first sale from developer), (B) non-residential or resale real estate, (C) share capital of a Cyprus-registered company employing at least 5 people, (D) units in a licensed Cyprus Investment Organisation of Collective Investments (AIF/AIFLNP/RAIF). Applicant must also demonstrate a secured annual income of at least EUR 50,000 from abroad (plus EUR 15,000 per dependent spouse, EUR 10,000 per minor child; income from Cypriot sources permitted for categories B, C, D). Application fee EUR 500 plus EUR 70 per person for ARC. Estimated examination period approximately 2 months from complete application. The permit is of unlimited validity; the residence card is issued for 10 years and renewed on expiry. Minor dependent children's cards valid until age 18. Adult children aged 18-25 who are tertiary students abroad may apply separately. Non-financially-dependent adult children can be included at a proportionally higher investment (EUR 300,000 multiplied by number of adult children). Annual monitoring of investment maintenance required; criminal record certificate every 3 years. Permit lapses if holder fails to enter Cyprus within 1 year of approval or is absent for 2 years.

rbi.name: Czechia
rbi.program_name: Long-Term Residence Permit for the Purpose of Investing
rbi.notes: Minimum investment of CZK 75 million (confirmed current as of 2026). Must create at least 20 new jobs for EU citizens or their family members for a minimum of 2 years. Up to 60% of financial investment may be satisfied through tangible or intangible assets (e.g., technologies, know-how). Permit valid for up to 2 years, renewable for up to 2 years at a time. Processing: 30 days standard, 60 days for complex cases. Administrative fee: 2,500 CZK (in-country) or 5,000 CZK (from abroad). Available to businesspeople (natural persons) or partners/members of statutory bodies/authorised representatives of commercial corporations. Also accessible via czechinvest.gov.cz.

rbi.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
rbi.notes: Issued to foreigners wishing to settle in the DRC. Grants resident status and authorises professional or economic activities under conditions set by law. Subtypes: Regular, Professional, Studies, Matrimonial, Permanent. For foreign workers, initial temporary work visa is limited to 6 consecutive months; after approval, may qualify for establishment visa with minimum 1-year validity. No minimum investment amount stated on official sources for the standard establishment visa. ANAPI (National Agency for Investment Promotion) provides facilitation services for initial investments over USD 200,000.

rbi.name: Denmark
rbi.notes: Requires job offer with annual salary of DKK 552,000 or more (2026 level, updated 1 January each year). Not an investment-based program; it is a salary-threshold work permit. Minimum 30 hours/week. Permanent residence requires 8 years legal residence (or 4 years meeting all supplementary requirements). Citizenship requires 9 years residence. Processing fee DKK 6,810 (2026 rate confirmed).

rbi.name: Denmark
rbi.notes: Entrepreneurial residence permit for innovative startup founders. Business idea must be approved by Danish Business Authority expert panel. Minimum personal funds DKK 153,240 for single applicant (2025 level - 2026 figure not yet confirmed on official page as of June 2026). Maximum 75 permits per year. Initial permit valid up to 2 years, renewable for up to 3 years at a time. Processing time: 1 month. Fee: DKK 3,060 (subject to annual update per SIRI fee notice January 2026).

rbi.name: Dominica
rbi.notes: Standard residence permit available to non-nationals. Fees: CARICOM nationals EC$250.00; Non-CARICOM nationals EC$800.00. Requires valid passport, medical certificate (including HIV and chest X-ray), police record, banker's statement, testimonials, return ticket proof, and a letter from a local sponsor. No investor-specific or golden visa residence track found on official sources.

rbi.name: Dominican Republic
rbi.notes: Minimum capital contribution of US$200,000 in a Dominican company, registered with ProDominicana (formerly CEI-RD). Investment may be in currency, in kind, financial instruments, or technology. Grants immediate permanent residency (no prior temporary residency required). Permit valid for 1 year, renewable. After 2 years of permanent residence, eligible to apply for naturalisation (reduced 6-month track available for property/business owners). Source: migracion.gob.do and Law 285-04 / Regulation 631-11. NOTE: migracion.gob.do returns HTTP 403 - amount confirmed from multiple secondary sources citing this page.

rbi.name: Dominican Republic
rbi.notes: Requires proof of regular passive income of at least US$2,000 per month from a foreign source, plus US$250 per dependent. Income must derive from investments, dividends, rental income, or similar passive sources - not active employment. Grants immediate permanent residency. Source: migracion.gob.do under Law 285-04 / Regulation 631-11. NOTE: official page returns HTTP 403 - amount confirmed from multiple secondary sources citing this page.

rbi.name: Dominican Republic
rbi.notes: Requires proof of a monthly pension of at least US$1,500 from a government or private entity, plus US$250 per dependent. Grants immediate permanent residency. Source: migracion.gob.do under Law 285-04 / Regulation 631-11. NOTE: official page returns HTTP 403 - amount confirmed from multiple secondary sources citing this page.

rbi.name: Dominican Republic
rbi.notes: Standard temporary residence requiring annual renewal. After 5 consecutive years of renewed temporary residency, applicant may apply for permanent residency. After 2 years of permanent residence, eligible for naturalisation (standard track). Source: migracion.gob.do. NOTE: official page returns HTTP 403.

rbi.name: Dominican Republic
rbi.notes: Permanent residency can be obtained after 5 years of temporary residence (standard track) or immediately via Inversionista/Rentista/Pensionado categories. After 2 years of permanent residence, naturalisation may be applied for (under Law 1683). A reduced 6-month naturalisation track exists for property owners, business owners, or spouses of Dominican nationals. Source: migracion.gob.do.

rbi.name: Ecuador
rbi.program_name: Temporary Residence Visa for Investor (Visa de Residencia Temporal Inversionista)
rbi.notes: Minimum investment is 100 times the Unified Basic Salary (SBU) of Ecuador. The 2026 SBU is USD 482/month, making the minimum USD 48,200 for 2026. Three approved investment types: (1) bank time deposit (certificate of deposit) for minimum 730 days; (2) real estate registered in cantonal Property Registry; (3) equity shares in Ecuadorian company registered with the Superintendency of Companies. Visa validity: 2 years (temporary residence). After 21 months of continuous residence, permanent residency can be requested. Path to citizenship via naturalization after approximately 4 years total, requiring Spanish proficiency and Ecuadorian civics knowledge. Application fee: USD 50; visa grant fee: USD 270. Legal basis: Ley Orgánica de Movilidad Humana (LOMH). The min_amount of 48,200 is the 2026 figure; the official page states '100 Unified Basic Salaries' and the amount changes annually when the SBU is updated.

rbi.name: Ecuador
rbi.program_name: Temporary Residence Visa for Rentista (Passive Income Visa)
rbi.notes: For foreigners with passive income (rents, investments, pensions) from national or foreign sources. Minimum income requirement is 3 times the Unified Basic Salary (SBU) per month (~USD 1,446/month in 2026 based on SBU of USD 482). Documentation must cover 3 months prior to application. Visa duration: 2 years, renewable. Same path to permanent residency (21 months continuous residence) and citizenship (4 years total). No fixed min_amount entered as this is an income threshold, not an investment floor.

rbi.name: Ecuador
rbi.notes: Available to nationals of Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Paraguay, Peru, and Uruguay under the MERCOSUR Residence Agreement (Ecuador acceded, formally ratified January 2024). Grants 2-year temporary residence, now renewable for an additional two years (change effective July 1, 2022 per Fragomen). After two full years with proof of economic income, permanent residency can be requested. Application fee: USD 50 application + USD 200 grant = USD 250 total. Legal basis: MERCOSUR Residence Agreement for Nationals of Member and Associated States.

rbi.name: Ecuador
rbi.program_name: Andean Migration Statute Residence (CAN/Estatuto Migratorio Andino)
rbi.notes: Available to nationals of Bolivia, Colombia, and Peru (Andean Community members) under Decision 878 (Andean Migration Statute), which entered into effect April 2023. Grants 2-year temporary residence with multiple entries and includes work authorization rights. Application fee: USD 250 (same as MERCOSUR route). Note: Ecuador withdrew from UNASUR in March 2019 and eliminated UNASUR visas in February 2021.

rbi.name: Egypt
rbi.program_name: Residence for Foreign Investors (Investment Law No. 72 of 2017)
rbi.notes: Article of Egypt's Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 states: 'The State shall grant the non-Egyptian investors residence in the Arab Republic of Egypt throughout the Project's terms without prejudice to the provisions of the relevant regulating laws and in the manner stipulated by the Executive Regulations of this Law.' Specific minimum investment thresholds and terms are set in executive regulations not reproduced on the official page. No specific dollar amounts could be confirmed from this official source.

rbi.name: El Salvador
rbi.program_name: Definitive Residence for Foreign Investors (Art. 152 Reform)
rbi.notes: Approved May 2025 by the Legislative Assembly with 57 votes (previously reported as 56 - corrected to 57 per official source). Foreigners who invest or donate in programs promoted by the Government can obtain definitive (permanent) residence directly without first holding temporary residence. Fee: USD 690. Requirements include clean criminal record, identity document, and proof of investment/donation in a government program. Minimum investment amount not specified in official sources. Family group of the main applicant may be included.

rbi.name: El Salvador
rbi.notes: El Salvador's immigration authority offers temporary residence for investors and business persons as one of several qualifying categories. Specific minimum investment amounts were not published on the official page reviewed. Applicants submit application, required documents, and pay applicable fees. A temporary residence card is issued and is renewable.

rbi.name: Estonia
rbi.notes: Requires a lasting direct investment of at least EUR 1,000,000 into an Estonian company or an investment fund primarily investing in Estonian companies. Income requirement: six times the subsistence level. Initial permit validity up to 5 years; extensions up to 10 years per renewal. The investment must not decrease during permit validity (except for market fluctuations). Separate path to permanent residence and citizenship follows standard naturalisation rules (8 years total residence, 5 years on permanent basis). Dual citizenship generally not permitted.

rbi.name: Estonia
rbi.notes: For founders/shareholders of early-stage companies with strong international growth potential. Must receive positive evaluation from Ministry of Interior expert committee (via Startup Estonia portal). Income requirement: four times the subsistence level annually. Initial permit up to 5 years; extensions up to 10 years. Not available to EU/EEA/EFTA nationals. Citizenship follows standard naturalisation (8 years total residence). Expert committee evaluation: 10 working days; permit decision: 90 days.

rbi.name: Ethiopia
rbi.notes: 10-year renewable residency permit for foreign investors making significant contributions to the national economy. Announced and endorsed by Council of Ministers on March 29, 2026. Issued by the Immigration and Citizenship Service (ICS). Renewal fee: USD 10,000 (regular), USD 12,500 (expedited). Benefits include long-term residency stability, streamlined entry/exit at Bole International Airport, right to reside and operate in Ethiopia. Effective upon publication in the Negarit Gazette. A separate 5-year property visa was also mentioned for those acquiring immovable property. Specific application portal and detailed eligibility criteria not yet confirmed on ics.gov.et at time of June 2026 research.

rbi.name: Ethiopia
rbi.notes: For foreign nationals employed by a company with a valid trade certificate in Ethiopia. Valid for 5 years, renewable. No investment threshold stated on the official page.

rbi.name: Ethiopia
rbi.notes: Available to foreign nationals married to Ethiopian citizens. Details available on ics.gov.et.

rbi.name: Ethiopia
rbi.program_name: Investment Visa (IV) - Multiple Entry, up to 12-Month
rbi.notes: Visa issued to foreign nationals engaged in or wishing to invest in Ethiopia. Options (confirmed on live re-scrape June 2026): single entry 30 days (USD 62), multiple entry 90 days (USD 152), multiple entry 6 months (USD 252), multiple entry 12 months (USD 502). Requires support letter from nearest Ethiopian Embassy, official application letter from inviting organization, business license, and support letter from Investment Commission of Ethiopia. Processing time: 3 days. This is a visa, not a residency-by-investment program. Single entry 30-day option (USD 62) added - was missing from the prior record.

rbi.name: Ethiopia
rbi.notes: Designed for foreign nationals entering Ethiopia with intent to stay for a fixed duration, eventually leading to permanent residency. Single entry 30 days (USD 202), multiple entry 90 days (USD 502). Extensions at ICS Head Office in Addis Ababa.

rbi.name: Fiji
rbi.notes: Issued to non-citizen investors engaged in a business project approved by the Fiji Trade and Investment Bureau (FTIB) with a Foreign Investment Certificate (FIC). Applicable to investments under F$500,000. The exact minimum threshold is not stated on immigration.gov.fj; the page requires FTIB approval and FIC but does not specify a dollar floor. Permit is valid for 3 years. Does not directly confer permanent residency; path to citizenship is through naturalisation under the Citizenship of Fiji Act 2009 after meeting residency requirements.

rbi.name: Fiji
rbi.notes: For investments of F$500,000 or more with an approved business trade or undertaking. The investor must introduce and maintain capital or assets of at least F$500,000, provide proof of available funds as personal capital (not unsecured loans), own or hold a lease/purchase option for required land or buildings, and demonstrate funds transferred from overseas. Permit is valid for 7 years. Path to citizenship is through naturalisation. Note: the previously recorded URL (immigration.gov.fj/index.php/seven-7-years-investor-permit) appears to redirect to the three-year permit page; updated to point to the main investor permit page.

rbi.name: Finland
rbi.notes: No minimum investment threshold. Applicant must actively work in the company in Finland (not just own it). Business must be profitable and income must be sufficient for livelihood. Financial resources assessed by the Centre for Economic Development, Transport and the Environment (ELY Centre/elinvoimakeskus.fi). Monthly net income requirement: at least EUR 1,030–1,210 (2026, depending on region). No pure real estate investment pathway. UPDATED 8 January 2026: General permanent residence permit path is now 6 years (was 4). However, an entrepreneur with annual income over EUR 40,000 may qualify after 4 years, or after 4 years with 3 years work history and C1 language skills. Citizenship after approximately 5 years with language skills (citizenship rules unchanged).

rbi.name: Finland
rbi.notes: For founders of growth-oriented startup companies. Requires positive Eligibility Statement from Business Finland (average processing ~1 month). First permit granted for 2 years. Fast-track option available: permit issued in 2 weeks. Monthly net income requirement: at least EUR 1,030–1,210 (2026). No stated minimum investment amount by Migri; Business Finland assesses viability of the startup. Only available as first permit (not extension); cannot apply if already in Finland. UPDATED 8 January 2026: General permanent residence permit path is now 6 years (was 4). Alternative 4-year paths exist for high-income (EUR 40,000/year) or high language (C1) with 3 years work history applicants.

rbi.name: France
rbi.program_name: Talent Passport - Economic Investor (Passeport Talent - Investisseur economique)
rbi.notes: Requires a direct economic investment of at least EUR 300,000 in tangible or intangible fixed assets. Must create or maintain jobs within four years of investment. Investment may be through personal ownership, a managed company, or a 30%+ capital stake. Pure financial investments excluded. Permit valid up to 4 years, renewable. After 5 years of continuous regular residence, eligible for 10-year permanent residence card permitting any professional activity. Administrative fees: EUR 300 + EUR 50 stamp duty + EUR 99 long-stay visa fee. Confirmed current as of May 2026 via Business France.

rbi.name: France
rbi.notes: Dedicated fast-track procedure within the Talent Passport framework for foreign investors in the French Tech/startup ecosystem. Requires minimum EUR 300,000 direct investment and commitment to create/preserve jobs within 4 years. Handled by the French Tech Mission on a one-to-one basis. Results in 'Talent - Business Investor' residence permit valid up to 4 years, renewable.

rbi.name: Georgia
rbi.notes: Requires ownership of immovable property (excluding agricultural land) with a certified market value of at least USD 300,000 equivalent in GEL. Property valuation by accredited assessor required. Effective March 1, 2026, the threshold was increased from USD 100,000. Permit issued for 5 years, renewable. Cumulative validity not to exceed 12 years. After 5 years may convert to Residence Permit for Indefinite Stay. Path to citizenship requires 10 years of continuous residence with language/history test. Family members (spouse, minor children, dependents) may be included. Based on the Law of Georgia on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, Article 15(h).

rbi.name: Georgia
rbi.notes: Requires at least USD 300,000 equivalent in GEL invested in business activities in Georgia (verified by audit report). Annual turnover thresholds apply: USD 50,000 (year 1), USD 100,000 (year 2), USD 120,000 (years 3-5). The Procedures for Reviewing Residence Permit Applications (matsne.gov.ge/en/document/view/2483468) states a minimum investment of GEL 300,000 (approximately USD 100,000-110,000 depending on exchange rate) for the application. Applications processed within 30 days. Written recommendation from a government member or three Georgian business representatives required. Permit duration up to 6 years.

rbi.name: Germany
rbi.program_name: Residence Permit for Self-Employment / Investors (Section 21 AufenthG)
rbi.notes: Under Section 21(1) of the Residence Act, third-country nationals can obtain a residence permit for self-employment if there is an economic interest or regional demand for the business, a positive economic impact is expected, and financing is secured. No fixed minimum investment amount is specified in official sources - viability and economic impact are assessed case by case. Initial permit valid up to 3 years; settlement permit (permanent residence) possible after 3 years of successful operation. Persons over 45 must show adequate pension provision. For freelancers in liberal professions, Section 21(5) applies. Citizenship path generally 8 years (or 5 years under skilled immigration rules if applicable).

rbi.name: Ghana
rbi.program_name: Work and Residence Permit - GIPC Investor / Immigrant Quota / Shareholders
rbi.notes: Foreign investors registered with the Ghana Investment Promotion Centre (GIPC) under GIPC Act 2013 (Act 865) are eligible for a work and residence permit with GIPC automatic approval (Automatic Expatriate Quota / AEQ). Also available for Ghana Free Zones Board (GFZB) approved businesses, NGO workers, and shareholders. Requires GIPC Registration Certificate, company documents (incorporation, tax clearance, audited accounts), Ministry of Interior approval letter, professional certificates. No minimum investment amount stated verbatim on the GIS official page; GIPC Act minimum investment thresholds exist but were not scraped from a live official GIS or GIPC page.

rbi.name: Ghana
rbi.notes: Available to any foreign national wishing to reside permanently in Ghana. Holder is entitled to remain indefinitely, enter Ghana without a visa, and work without a work permit. Requirements include attestation by two Ghanaians of repute, evidence of immovable properties (where applicable), company documents (GIPC certificate, 6 years tax clearance, 3 years audited accounts, SSNIT returns), police report from Ghana, medical report. Also available for foreign spouses of Ghanaian nationals with marriage certificate and spousal support letter. No minimum investment amount stated on official GIS page.

rbi.name: Ghana
rbi.notes: Granted to: (1) Ghanaians by birth/adoption/registration/naturalization who lost their Ghanaian citizenship by acquiring foreign nationality; and (2) persons of African descent in the Diaspora. Approved by the Minister with the President's approval. Grants right to reside permanently in Ghana, enter without visa, and work without a work permit. For Africans in the Diaspora: requires evidence of contribution to Ghanaian economic development (monetary value of shares, bank statement, audited account, provision of employment to Ghanaians). No minimum monetary amount stated verbatim on the official GIS page.

rbi.name: Greece
rbi.program_name: Golden Visa - Investor Residence Permit (Real Estate - High-Demand Zones)
rbi.notes: Minimum €800,000 investment in residential or commercial real estate in high-demand regions: Attica (Athens area), Thessaloniki area, islands with over 3,100 inhabitants (including Mykonos and Santorini). Single property unit of minimum 120 sq.m. required. Short-term (sharing economy) rentals are prohibited. Grants a renewable 5-year residence permit. Path to citizenship requires 7 years of legal residence with naturalization requirements. Rules introduced by Law 5100/2024, effective 31 August 2024. Transitional periods expired; all new 2026 applications face full thresholds.

rbi.name: Greece
rbi.program_name: Golden Visa - Investor Residence Permit (Real Estate - Other Regions)
rbi.notes: Minimum €400,000 investment in residential or commercial real estate in all other regions of Greece (outside high-demand zones). Single property unit of minimum 120 sq.m. required. Short-term (sharing economy) rentals are prohibited. Grants a renewable 5-year residence permit. Law 5100/2024, effective 31 August 2024. All new 2026 applications face the full threshold.

rbi.name: Greece
rbi.program_name: Golden Visa - Investor Residence Permit (Commercial/Heritage Conversion)
rbi.notes: Minimum €250,000 for conversion of commercial/industrial buildings into residential use, or restoration of heritage/listed buildings. Conversion must be fully completed before Golden Visa application. Law 5100/2024.

rbi.name: Greece
rbi.notes: Minimum €250,000 investment in a startup registered with Elevate Greece (national startup registry). Investment via capital increase (shares) or bonds of the startup. Investor may not hold more than 33% of share capital or voting rights. Startup must create at least 2 new jobs within 1 year and maintain them for 5 years. Grants a 5-year renewable residence permit. Introduced under Article 44 of Law 5162/2024.

rbi.name: Greece
rbi.notes: Minimum €500,000 in Greek government bonds with a minimum 3-year maturity period. Alternative financial investment route under the Golden Visa program.

rbi.name: Greece
rbi.notes: Minimum €500,000 fixed-term deposit in a Greek credit institution with a minimum 1-year term and automatic renewal. Alternative financial investment route under the Golden Visa program.

rbi.name: Greece
rbi.notes: Minimum €350,000 in units of mutual funds focusing exclusively on Greek equities, corporate bonds, or government securities. Alternative financial investment route under the Golden Visa program.

rbi.name: Grenada
rbi.notes: Standard permanent residence application available through Home Affairs. Application form listed on the official government portal. No specific investor-only minimum investment amount is published on the official site. Separate application tracks exist for: spouses of Grenadian citizens, Commonwealth citizens, and naturalization. No dedicated golden visa / investor-residence programme separate from the CBI programme was found on official sources.

rbi.name: Guatemala
rbi.program_name: Temporary Residency for Investors (Residencia Temporal como Inversionista)
rbi.notes: Article 17 of Reglamento de Residencias Guatemaltecas (Acuerdo IGM-016-2025, in force October 8, 2025) requires the applicant to demonstrate participation in one or more commercial entities and/or investment in movable or immovable assets totaling at least USD 100,000. Consortium Legal (law firm analysis of IGM-016-2025) confirms the USD 100,000 minimum. Qualifying evidence includes: property registrations, securities title certificates, fixed asset invoices, proof of fund origin. Temporary residency is renewable annually. After 5 years of temporary residency, applicant may apply for permanent residency. After meeting the Nationality Law residency thresholds, naturalization may be sought. No direct path to citizenship - standard naturalization timeline applies.

rbi.name: Guatemala
rbi.program_name: Permanent Residency as Rentista or Pensionado (Residencia Permanente como Rentista o Pensionado)
rbi.notes: Article 31 of Reglamento IGM-016-2025 and official IGM requirements form confirm: minimum individual monthly income of USD 1,250 generated outside Guatemala; each dependent adds USD 300/month. Rentistas are individuals subsisting on stable foreign-generated income (bank deposits, foreign company investments, real estate remittances, etc.). Pensionados receive periodic payments from government, international organizations, or private foreign entities. Income must be proven with certified bank statements or official pension documentation. Residency is granted directly as permanent (not temporary). Path to citizenship: standard naturalization after 5 continuous years residency (reduced to 2 years for qualifying nationalities). Rentistas/pensionados must renew income proof every 5 years.

rbi.name: Guatemala
rbi.program_name: Temporary Residency for Remote Workers / Digital Nomads (Trabajador Migrante con Empleador Extranjero)
rbi.notes: Article 11 of Reglamento IGM-016-2025 (for remote workers employed by a foreign employer): requires bank statements showing a minimum monthly income of USD 2,000 from abroad (USD 3,000 if accompanied by dependents). Effective October 8, 2025 per Acuerdo IGM-016-2025, confirmed by Consortium Legal analysis. No Guatemalan employer or local guarantor required for this category. Residency valid for 1 year, renewable annually. After 5 years, eligible for permanent residency. The official category designation is 'trabajador migrante con empleador extranjero' - there is no separate formal 'digital nomad visa' branding in the official regulation.

rbi.name: Guyana
rbi.notes: Guyana offers an employment visa for foreign investors/businesspersons. Initial visa can be obtained on arrival; work permit valid up to 3 years, renewable. No minimum investment amount is specified on official government pages. No formal 'golden visa' or dedicated residence-by-investment program exists. Path to permanent residency or citizenship timelines not specified in official materials.

rbi.name: Honduras
rbi.notes: Minimum investment of USD $50,000 in any lawful economic activity in Honduras (including certificates, securities, or State bonds). Also requires a certificate of deposit of not less than USD $5,000 issued by the Central Bank of Honduras as guarantee. A technical feasibility study and investment schedule must be submitted. Application processed through a Honduran lawyer registered with the National Bar Association. Investment covers principal investor and immediate family. After 3 years of continuous residency, naturalization may be pursued subject to language/civics requirements.

rbi.name: Honduras
rbi.notes: Must demonstrate permanent, lawful, and stable pension income generated abroad of not less than USD $1,500 per month or equivalent in national currency. Pension must be received via a Honduran financial institution. Supporting authenticated documents required.

rbi.name: Honduras
rbi.notes: Must demonstrate permanent, lawful, and stable rental or passive income (generated abroad or within Honduras) of not less than USD $2,500 per month or equivalent in national currency. Income must be received via a Honduran financial institution. Supporting authenticated documents required.

rbi.name: Hungary
rbi.notes: Two investment options: (1) Acquisition of investment fund share of at least EUR 250,000 issued by a real estate fund registered by the Hungarian National Bank - fund must allocate at least 40% of net asset value to Hungarian residential real estate; investor must hold for minimum 5 years. (2) Financial donation of at least EUR 1,000,000 to a public-trust higher education institution for educational, scientific research or artistic activities. A direct residential property purchase pathway (EUR 500,000) was abolished as of 15 January 2025. Permit valid up to 10 years, renewable for additional 10-year periods (no longer limited to one renewal). Guest investors explicitly CANNOT obtain a national residence card (permanent residence). No path to citizenship via this program. Work permitted without restrictions. Processing time: 21 days standard.

rbi.name: Iceland
rbi.program_name: Residence Permit for Qualified Professionals (Specialist Employees)
rbi.notes: For specialist/expert employees. Requires an employment contract meeting statutory minimum wage, valid health insurance (min 6 months, ISK 2,000,000 coverage), criminal record certificate, and valid passport. Initial permit for 1 year, renewable for 2 years. Expedited processing available for qualified professionals (within 30 days if all documents submitted; standard is up to 180 days). Permanent residence possible after 4 continuous years. No investment threshold.

rbi.name: Iceland
rbi.notes: For positions in labour shortage occupations. Same general requirements as specialist employee permit. No investment pathway.

rbi.name: Iceland
rbi.program_name: Residence Permit on Grounds of Legitimate and Special Purpose
rbi.notes: Covers specific personal circumstances: injury/illness requiring extended stay, being a relative of injured/ill person, expecting a child with Icelandic citizenship, or party to an Icelandic court case. Requires secure means of support: ISK 259,951/month (individual), ISK 415,922/month (couple), plus ISK 129,976 per additional adult family member. Not an investment or golden visa program.

rbi.name: India
rbi.program_name: Permanent Residency Status (PRS) for Foreign Investors
rbi.notes: Two investment thresholds: (1) INR 10 crore (INR 10,000,000) within 18 months via FDI route, OR (2) INR 25 crore (INR 25,000,000) within 36 months via FDI route. Both require generating employment for at least 20 resident Indian nationals every financial year. PRS is granted for 10 years with multiple entry and no stay stipulation. Renewable for another 10 years if holder has not come to adverse notice. PRS holders are exempt from FRRO registration. Spouses and dependents receive co-terminus B-1X Visas. PRS holders may purchase one residential property for personal use. No path to citizenship; India does not allow dual citizenship. Not available to Pakistani nationals or third-country nationals of Pakistani origin. Scheme approved by Cabinet on August 31, 2016; instructions issued by MHA on October 17, 2016. Official MHA circular: https://www.mha.gov.in/PDF_Other/prsforeigninvestors_17042017.pdf

rbi.name: Indonesia
rbi.notes: Established via Ministerial Regulation No. 22/2023 (Law and Human Rights) and No. 82/2023 (Finance), effective 30 August 2023. Grants 5 or 10-year stay permits. Categories: (1) Individual investor without establishing company (financial placement in bonds/stocks/deposits): USD 350,000 for 5 years, USD 700,000 for 10 years; (2) Individual investor establishing company: USD 2,500,000 for 5 years, USD 5,000,000 for 10 years; (3) Corporate investor director/commissioner: USD 25,000,000 for 5 years, USD 50,000,000 for 10 years. No path to citizenship or permanent residency via this route. Average processing: 4 business days. Applications via evisa.imigrasi.go.id (Molina portal).

rbi.name: Indonesia
rbi.notes: Launched October 25, 2022 via Circular Letter IMI-0740.GR.01.01 of 2022. Allows foreign nationals or ex-Indonesian citizens to reside in Indonesia for 5 or 10 years. Requires proof of funds minimum IDR 2,000,000,000 (approx. USD 125,000) in bank account. Visa fee IDR 3,000,000. Passport validity minimum 36 months required. No sponsor required. Application via visa-online.imigrasi.go.id. No explicit path to permanent residence or citizenship.

rbi.name: Indonesia
rbi.program_name: E33G Second Home Visa for Remote Workers (Digital Nomad Visa)
rbi.notes: E33G Visa Rumah Kedua Pekerja Jarak Jauh. 1-year stay, extendable online. Minimum annual income: USD 60,000. Proof of living expenses: minimum USD 2,000 or equivalent (last 3 months bank statement). Employment contract with foreign-registered company required. No local sponsor required. Processing: 5 business days. Visa fee: Rp 7,000,000 for 1-year residence. Applications via evisa.imigrasi.go.id.

rbi.name: Indonesia
rbi.notes: Launched January 2026 by Ministry of Immigration and Corrections. Grants unlimited/permanent stay permit for eligible foreign nationals: former Indonesian citizens and their descendants (up to 2nd degree), spouses of Indonesian citizens, and those in international marriages involving Indonesians. Modest investment requirements (bonds, shares, mutual funds, property) or income of USD 1,500/month or USD 15,000/year. Diaspora with strategic expertise exempt from investment requirements. Reporting required every 5 years only. Applications via evisa.imigrasi.go.id.

rbi.name: Iran
rbi.program_name: Five-Year Residence Permit for Foreign Investors
rbi.notes: Iran offers a 5-year renewable residence permit for foreign investors. Originally introduced 30 June 2019 with a minimum investment of 250,000 EUR (or equivalent). On 5 April 2022, the minimum investment threshold was reduced to approximately $90,000 USD. Eligible investment forms include: long-term deposits in Iranian banks and credit institutions, investment bonds and securities, and housing/real estate investment. The permit is administered by the Organization for Investment, Economic and Technical Assistance of Iran (OIETA / investiniran.ir). Executives and foreign technicians employed by overseas firms, as well as their spouses and children, may also qualify. This provides residency only, not citizenship. No official path to permanent residence or citizenship through this program is documented on official sources. Note: some sources cite €90,000 - the ambiguity stems from exchange-rate equivalence at the time of the April 2022 announcement; USD 90,000 is the most commonly cited figure in English-language official-adjacent sources.

rbi.name: Iraq
rbi.program_name: Kurdistan Region Investor Residence Permit (Real Estate Investment Pathway)
rbi.notes: Foreign nationals who purchase a residential unit within an approved investment project valued at minimum USD 50,000 are eligible for a work residence permit valid for 1-3 years, renewable, upon approval by the Kurdistan Region Board of Investment (gov.krd/boi-en). Extends to spouse, children under 18, and parents. This is a Kurdistan Regional Government program, not a federal Iraq program. The official gov.krd/boi-en page returned HTTP 403 during verification; details sourced from invest.gov.krd.

rbi.name: Iraq
rbi.program_name: Kurdistan Region Investor Residence Permit (Board of Investment Confirmation Pathway)
rbi.notes: Foreign investors confirmed by the Kurdistan Region Board of Investment are eligible for a residency permit valid for 3-5 years, renewable. Extends to spouse, children under 18, and parents. No minimum investment amount specified in the legislation for this pathway. This is a Kurdistan Regional Government program, not a federal Iraq program.

rbi.name: Ireland
rbi.notes: Closed to new applications from 15 February 2023. Previously offered four investment options (enterprise, fund, REIT, endowment) with minimum €500,000–€2,000,000. No active programme currently.

rbi.name: Israel
rbi.notes: Available ONLY to US citizens (and their key employees and immediate family) under Israeli Government Resolutions 1528 (March 2014) and 2243 (January 2017). Allows temporary residence and work in Israel to develop and manage a business. The investor must hold at least 50% stake in the business. No fixed minimum investment amount is stated in the official procedure; practical guidance suggests approximately NIS 800,000-1,000,000 (~USD 220,000-275,000). Initial visa period: 2 years, renewable annually with no stated maximum while business requirements are met. Does not provide a direct path to permanent residency or citizenship.

rbi.name: Italy
rbi.program_name: Investor Visa for Italy (Italy Golden Visa)
rbi.notes: Officially introduced by Law 232/2016 (2017 Budget Law). Administered by the Investor Visa for Italy Committee (IV4I) under MIMIT (Ministry of Enterprises and Made in Italy). Four investment pathways: (1) EUR 250,000 in an Italian innovative startup; (2) EUR 500,000 in an Italian limited liability company; (3) EUR 1,000,000 as a philanthropic donation to a public interest initiative; (4) EUR 2,000,000 in Italian government bonds. Initial investor visa valid for 2 years. Residence permit valid 2 years, renewable for 3 years. No minimum physical presence requirement. Long-term residence (permanent residence) available after 5 years of maintaining the investment. Path to citizenship via standard naturalization after 10 years of lawful residence. Program suspended for Russian and Belarusian nationals; as of March 2024, suspension extended to non-EU citizens holding dual citizenship with Russian or Belarusian passports. Processing: Nulla Osta issued within 30 days by the Committee; investment must be completed within 3 months of arrival in Italy.

rbi.name: Jamaica
rbi.notes: Jamaica offers permanent residence to foreign investors; the official PICA page and official consular sources confirm the investor category exists but do not state a specific minimum investment amount on the publicly available pages. The Jamaica Embassy Brussels site lists 'foreign investors in Jamaica' as an eligible category. Processing: minimum 6 months; applicants receive an initial 3-month entry visa, renewable annually for 3 years, after which a residence visa is issued. After 5 years of residency, naturalization to citizenship is possible. A work permit is still required separately. Sources: pica.gov.jm/immigration/permanent-residence, jamaica-brussels.be/permanent-residence/, embassyofjamaica.org/visitors/jamaican_residency.htm

rbi.name: Jamaica
rbi.notes: Foreign retirees who have resided in Jamaica for over 3 years may apply for permanent residence. Evidence of pension or financial means required. Processing minimum 6 months. Source: jamaica-brussels.be/permanent-residence/ (official Embassy of Jamaica, Belgium site)

rbi.name: Jamaica
rbi.notes: Foreign nationals with a minimum of 5 years of unbroken employment in Jamaica may apply for permanent residence. Source: jamaica-brussels.be/permanent-residence/

rbi.name: Japan
rbi.notes: Allows foreign nationals to manage or operate businesses in Japan. As of October 2025, minimum capital or total investment raised from JPY 5 million to JPY 30 million. Also requires: at least 1 full-time employee resident in Japan with Japanese language ability, and applicant must have either 3+ years business management experience or a master's/doctoral degree in a related field, plus a business plan reviewed by a specialist. Path to permanent residence depends on points and conduct. Path to citizenship is standard naturalization (5 years residence). Source: Immigration Services Agency / Baker McKenzie analysis of ISA announcement August 2025.

rbi.name: Japan
rbi.notes: Points-based system. Foreign nationals scoring 70+ points (academic background, professional career, annual income) are admitted as Highly Skilled Foreign Professionals. Those scoring 80+ points are eligible for permanent residence after just 1 year of residence. Three activity categories: (i) Advanced Academic Research, (ii) Advanced Specialized/Technical, (iii) Advanced Business Management. Source: MOFA/ISA.

rbi.name: Japan
rbi.notes: Introduced April 2023. Granted to foreign nationals meeting high academic/income standards without needing to calculate HSP points. For professionals/researchers: master's degree or higher (or 10+ years experience) AND annual income of at least JPY 20 million. For business managers: 5+ years management experience AND annual income of at least JPY 40 million. Eligible for permanent residence after 1 year. Source: Immigration Services Agency of Japan (J-Skip PDF).

rbi.name: Jordan
rbi.notes: Residency granted for 5 years, renewable, upon purchase of one property exclusively from a real estate developer valued >= JOD 200,000 per Department of Lands and Survey appraisal. Property must be retained 5 years without sale or mortgage. Residency covers investor and family members. This pathway does NOT lead to citizenship under the July 2025 reforms. Commissioner of Minister of Interior at the Ministry of Investment authorized to renew residency after technical committee review. Applications via Ministry of Investment e-Services Portal. Re-validation 2026-06-27: invest.jo returned HTTP 403; amounts kept as previously confirmed.

rbi.name: Jordan
rbi.notes: Annual residency granted within 14 working days for investors carrying out economic activity in sectors under the Investment Environment Regulation Law, or holding senior management positions (chairman, board member, general manager, director general, or CEO) in a Jordan-based investment. Covers investor and family (spouse, male children under 30, unmarried daughters of any age, parents). Not available for commercial sector (apply via MoI). No minimum investment amount stated on official page. Applications via Ministry of Investment e-Services portal. Re-validation 2026-06-27: invest.jo returned HTTP 403; kept as previously confirmed.

rbi.name: Kazakhstan
rbi.notes: Effective April 30, 2025. Foreign nationals who invest a minimum of USD 300,000 in the charter capital of Kazakh companies or in local publicly traded securities may apply electronically for an investor multiple-entry visa and subsequently obtain a residence permit for up to 10 years. Applications via vmp.gov.kz. Path to citizenship available only through discretionary naturalization after 5 years of continuous legal residency; dual citizenship is not permitted.

rbi.name: Kenya
rbi.program_name: Class G Permit - Specific Trade, Business or Consultancy
rbi.notes: Issued to a person who intends to engage, alone or in partnership, in a specific trade, business, consultancy or profession in Kenya. Requires documentary proof of capital to be invested of at least USD 100,000. Processing fee: KShs 20,000 (non-refundable); Issuance fee: KShs 250,000 per year. EAC Member States citizens: Gratis. Path to permanent residence or citizenship not stated verbatim on the official page.

rbi.name: Kenya
rbi.program_name: Class A Permit - Prospecting and Mining
rbi.notes: Issued to a person who intends to engage in prospecting for minerals or mining in Kenya. Requires proof of funds for investment of at least USD 100,000, plus necessary prospecting/mining rights and licenses. Processing fee: KShs 20,000 (non-refundable); Issuance fee: KShs 500,000 per year. EAC Member States citizens: Gratis.

rbi.name: Kosovo
rbi.program_name: Temporary Residence Permit for Business/Employment (Entrepreneur Route)
rbi.notes: Foreign nationals who register and operate a business in Kosovo may apply for a temporary residence permit for employment/business purposes under Law 08/L-296 on Foreigners. No minimum investment amount is set by law. Continuous 5 years of temporary residence leads to permanent residence eligibility. No golden visa or investor-specific fast-track exists.

rbi.name: Kuwait
rbi.program_name: Long-Term Investor Residency – Real Estate Route
rbi.notes: Foreign nationals who purchase property in Kuwait may qualify for a 10-year renewable residency permit under Article 7 of the Executive Regulations of the Law on the Residence of Foreigners. Effective date: 23 December 2025. No fixed minimum investment amount specified; applications reviewed case-by-case. Does not lead to permanent residency or citizenship. Source: KPMG Flash Alert 2025-272 citing Kuwait News Agency (official government media) and Ministry of Interior.

rbi.name: Kuwait
rbi.notes: Foreign nationals who establish or invest in a qualifying business in Kuwait may obtain a 15-year renewable residency permit under Article 7 of the Executive Regulations of the Law on the Residence of Foreigners. Must comply with Kuwait Direct Investment Promotion Authority (KDIPA) Law No. 116 of 2013. Criteria include technology transfer, economic diversification support, job creation for Kuwaiti nationals. Projects on the Cabinet's Negative List (oil/gas, media, certain manufacturing) are excluded. No fixed minimum investment amount; case-by-case review. Effective date: 23 December 2025. Does not lead to permanent residency or citizenship. Fee: KD 10 per month per Ministerial Decision No. 2249/2025.

rbi.name: Kyrgyzstan
rbi.notes: Issued to foreign investors or heads of foreign investment companies contributing to the Kyrgyz economy. Minimum 10 million KGS for visa valid up to 5 years; minimum 20 million KGS for visa valid up to 10 years. Eligible sectors include manufacturing, industry, agriculture, banking, energy, education, medicine, engineering and construction, ICT. Family members (spouse, minor children, dependent parents) may receive F-type family visa. Does not directly confer residency or citizenship. Official application channel is the evisa.e-gov.kg portal.

rbi.name: Laos
rbi.program_name: Investor Visa (NI-B2) / Business Visa for Foreign Investors
rbi.notes: Business visa for foreign investors legally approved by the Government of Lao PDR. Requires investment license, concession registration, or enterprise registration. Annual renewals for stay permit cards (3-month, 6-month, or 12-month options at 300,000/600,000/1,200,000 kip respectively). Long-term stay permits (3-5 years) only for concession holders with 10+ year government agreements. Eligible categories: foreign investors, stockholders, directors, deputy directors, technical officers and family members. Managed by the Investment Promotion and Management Committee (IPMC) / investlaos.gov.la.

rbi.name: Latvia
rbi.notes: Two tiers: (1) EUR 50,000 minimum for companies with 50 or fewer employees and annual turnover/balance at or below EUR 10 million; (2) EUR 100,000 minimum for companies with more than 50 employees and annual turnover/balance above EUR 10 million. In both cases, up to 10 foreign investors per company allowed; each must also pay EUR 10,000 into the State budget. Grants temporary residence permit. Pathway to citizenship requires 5 years of residence and naturalization process (not automatic via investment). Page last updated April 22, 2022 on pmlp.gov.lv; amounts confirmed via live fetch. PENDING LEGISLATIVE CHANGE: Under the new immigration law passed by Saeima on 11 June 2026 (not yet promulgated as of 29 June 2026 - returned by President Rinkevics), share capital permits would remain available but validity would be reduced from 5 years to 2 years, and renewed on same basis. The EUR 50k/100k thresholds and EUR 10,000 state budget payment would remain. Source: cobalt.legal/news-cases/new-immigration-law-latvia-employers-investors-temporary-residence-holders/

rbi.name: Latvia
rbi.program_name: Residence Permit for Person with Subordinate Liabilities to Credit Institution
rbi.notes: Minimum EUR 280,000 in subordinate liabilities to a Latvian credit institution for a minimum 5-year term. First-time permit applicants must pay EUR 25,000 into the State budget. Grants temporary residence permit. Citizenship only via standard naturalization (5 years residence, language, etc.). Confirmed via live fetch of pmlp.gov.lv/en/investments. PENDING ABOLITION: Latvia's Saeima passed amendments on 11 June 2026 to abolish this route from 1 January 2027, but President Rinkēvičs returned the law for reconsideration before the spring session closed 18 June 2026. The law is NOT yet promulgated; this route remains available until further notice.

rbi.name: Latvia
rbi.notes: Acquisition of interest-free government bonds designated for special purposes with nominal value of EUR 250,000. Applicant must pay EUR 38,000 into the State budget upon receiving first temporary residence permit. Bond acquisition occurs after a positive decision on the permit application. Citizenship only via standard naturalization. Confirmed via live fetch. PENDING ABOLITION: Latvia's Saeima passed amendments on 11 June 2026 to abolish this route from 1 January 2027, but President Rinkēvičs returned the law for reconsideration before the spring session closed 18 June 2026. The law is NOT yet promulgated; this route remains available until further notice.

rbi.name: Latvia
rbi.notes: For real estate acquired from 1 July 2016. Minimum EUR 250,000 property value in Riga, Jurmala or specified municipalities (Adazi, Babite, Baldone, Carnikava, Garkalne, Ikskile, Kekava, Marupe, Olaine, Ropazi, Salaspils, Stopini). For other regions: up to two properties, combined EUR 250,000 minimum. Minimum cadastral value: EUR 80,000 (single) or EUR 40,000 each (two). Must pay 5% of real estate purchase value into State budget on first permit. Non-cash payment required. Agricultural and wooded land excluded. Citizenship only via standard naturalization. Confirmed via live fetch (page last updated April 22, 2022). PENDING ABOLITION: Latvia's Saeima passed amendments on 11 June 2026 to abolish this route from 1 January 2027, but President Rinkēvičs returned the law for reconsideration before the spring session closed 18 June 2026. The law is NOT yet promulgated. This route remains available until further notice; verify current status with PMLP before advising clients.

rbi.name: Lebanon
rbi.notes: Requires a blocked bank account of at least 150,000,000 LBP at a Lebanese bank (statement covering at least 3 months, bank-signed). Also requires lease contract or title deed, investment contracts, commercial register extract, and professional license. Annual residence permit with mandatory health insurance for foreigners. A 'permanent residence' category exists on the General Security site but its eligibility criteria are not published online. No confirmed path from investor residency to permanent residence or citizenship found in official sources.

rbi.name: Lesotho
rbi.notes: Business permit is one of the categories of residence permits issued by the Lesotho Department of Immigration Services. Minimum investment amount not specified on official page. After 5+ years of lawful residence, non-citizens may apply for citizenship.

rbi.name: Lesotho
rbi.notes: General residence permit valid for 2 years. Categories include missionaries, business, joining relative, spouse joining spouse, returning former citizens, doctors/nurses, teachers. Minimum requirements not specified on official page.

rbi.name: Lesotho
rbi.notes: Indefinite (permanent) residence permit available. Application criteria and minimum requirements not specified on official page. Source: https://www.homeaffairs.gov.ls/immigration/

rbi.name: Liberia
rbi.notes: All foreign nationals wishing to remain in Liberia beyond 90 days must apply for a Resident Permit via rp.lis.gov.lr. This is a general residence permit, not an investment-based golden visa. Fees (new application): Non-African Citizen USD 750; Non-ECOWAS African Citizen USD 600; ECOWAS Citizen USD 150. Renewal: Non-African USD 350; Non-ECOWAS African USD 300; ECOWAS Citizen USD 100. Processing time: up to 2 weeks after in-person biometric appointment. No minimum investment required; this is a standard residence permit. No investment-based path to PR or citizenship defined on the official portal.

rbi.name: Libya
rbi.program_name: Investor Residence Visa (Investment Promotion Law No. 9, 2010)
rbi.notes: Article 12(7) of Investment Promotion Law No. 9 of 2010 (published by the Economic Development Authority at ejraat.gov.ly) grants approved foreign investors 'residence visas renewable for 5 years, the duration of the project, and multiple exit/re-entry visas'. No minimum investment amount is specified in the law text for this visa benefit; it applies to investment projects approved under the law. No path to permanent residence or citizenship is specified. Does not apply to oil and gas projects (Article 27). This is a residence benefit tied to an active investment project, not a standalone golden visa program.

rbi.name: Liechtenstein
rbi.program_name: Residence Permit (B) Draw for EEA Nationals - With Gainful Employment
