rbi.program_name: EU/EFTA Residence Permit (B Permit) – Financially Independent Persons
rbi.notes: EU/EFTA citizens can obtain a B permit (5-year renewable) if they can prove sufficient financial means and adequate health/accident insurance. After 5 years on B permit, eligible to apply for C permit (permanent residence). Ordinary naturalization requires 10 years total residence and C permit. Source: SEM B EU/EFTA permit page.

rbi.name: Taiwan
rbi.notes: Minimum USD 200,000 investment required as stipulated in 'Regulations on the Operation of Foreign Investors or Representatives of Foreign Corporations Applying for Resident Visas'. Proof of investment issued by competent central government authority required. Processing time: 8 working days for domestic applications.

rbi.name: Taiwan
rbi.program_name: Alien Permanent Resident Certificate (Plum Blossom Card) - Business Investment
rbi.notes: Investment of NTD 15 million in a profitable ROC business, creating employment for 5 or more ROC nationals, maintained for 3 consecutive years. Not subject to 183-day/year residency requirement. Application fee: NTD 10,000. Dual ROC citizenship not permitted.

rbi.name: Taiwan
rbi.program_name: Alien Permanent Resident Certificate (Plum Blossom Card) - Government Bonds
rbi.notes: Purchase of ROC central government bonds with face value exceeding NTD 30 million, held for 3 consecutive years. Not subject to 183-day/year residency requirement. Application fee: NTD 10,000.

rbi.name: Taiwan
rbi.notes: Initial 2-year validity, extendable in 2-year increments. For renewal: annual gross revenue of at least NTD 3 million OR average over 3 years, OR operating expenses at least NTD 1 million/year, OR employment of 3+ full-time ROC nationals. Processing: 30 working days initial, 22 working days for extension. Apply via Foreign Professionals Online Application Platform.

rbi.name: Tanzania
rbi.notes: Class A permit for investors (self-employed, directors/shareholders of registered companies). Categories: A-1 Professional Artist Investor (USD 1,000 fee), A-2 Diaspora Investors (USD 1,000 fee), A-3 Other Sector/Industry Investors (USD 3,000 fee), A-4 Refugee Investors (USD 1,500 fee). Minimum investment capital not stated on the page - references minimum stipulated in the Investment Act. Requires TIC or ZIPA registration for investors.

rbi.name: Tanzania
rbi.program_name: Residence Permit Class C-2 - Retired Persons
rbi.notes: For persons retired in Tanzania or outside Tanzania with assured income to sustain themselves and dependents. Age must be 55 or above. Permit fee: USD 500 (USD 250 for EAC citizens and diaspora). Re-entry pass USD 50.

rbi.name: Tanzania
rbi.program_name: Residence Permit Class C-11 - Buyer of Real Estate
rbi.notes: For persons who buy houses in real estate but are not entitled to other available permit categories. Requires proof that value of purchased property is not less than USD 100,000. Requires letter of recommendation/qualification from Zanzibar Investment Promotion Authority (ZIPA) for Zanzibar or Tanzania Investment Centre (TIC) for Mainland. Certificate of occupancy/Title deed and tax clearance required. Permit fee: USD 500.

rbi.name: Tanzania
rbi.notes: Class B for foreigners with specific skills not readily available in local labor market. B-1 Specific employment (USD 2,000 fee), B-2 Diaspora employment (USD 500 fee), B-3 Short-term employment up to 6 months (USD 500), B-4 Refugee employment (USD 500). Requires Work Permit from Labour Commissioner.

rbi.name: Thailand
rbi.notes: 10-year renewable visa (5-year initial permission to stay, extendable another 5 years). Four categories: (1) Wealthy Global Citizens - min USD 1 million in global assets + USD 500,000 investment in Thailand (government bonds, company stock, or property); (2) Wealthy Pensioners - age 50+, income USD 80,000/year or USD 40,000/year + USD 250,000 Thai investment; (3) Work-from-Thailand Professionals - min income USD 80,000/year, employed by overseas company; (4) Highly-Skilled Professionals - min income USD 80,000/year, working in targeted industries. Visa issuance fee: THB 50,000 per person per 10 years. Processing: qualification endorsement ~20 working days. Benefits include 17% flat personal income tax (category 4), exemption from 4-Thai-to-1-foreigner employment ratio, 1-year reporting cycle, fast-track airport service. LTR amounts confirmed via ltr.boi.go.th (official BOI domain).

rbi.name: Thailand
rbi.program_name: Thailand Privilege Card (formerly Thailand Elite Visa)
rbi.notes: State enterprise program operated by Thailand Privilege Card Co., Ltd. (sole shareholder: Tourism Authority of Thailand). Rebranded from Thailand Elite Visa in October 2023. Multiple membership tiers: Bronze (THB 650,000, 5-year visa, limited period offer), Gold (THB 900,000, 5-year visa with Privilege Points), Diamond, Reserve. Multiple-entry visa granting residency rights for 5–20+ years depending on tier. No income or investment proof required. One-time fee. No path to permanent residency or citizenship through this program.

rbi.name: Timor-Leste
rbi.notes: Valid 2 years, renewable. Eligibility: professional employment, foreign spouses (married 2-5 years to Timorese), family reunification, human trafficking victims, exceptional circumstances. Fee: USD $100 issuance and renewal. Temporary permit holders become eligible for Permanent Residence after 6+ years.

rbi.name: Timor-Leste
rbi.notes: No expiration. Eligibility: 10+ consecutive years legal residency; OR dependent minor children of nationals; OR spouse of Timorese citizen (5+ years marriage); OR temporary permit holder for 6+ years. Requirements: no serious criminal convictions, demonstrated financial stability and housing, positive economic or social contribution. Fee: USD $100 issuance. Law: Migration Law 11/2017.

rbi.name: Togo
rbi.notes: Togo offers three tiers of residence permit for all foreigners wishing to establish themselves in Togo: (1) Temporary residence permit (1 year, 200,000 XOF); (2) Ordinary residence permit (3 years, 500,000 XOF); (3) Privileged residence permit (5 years, 800,000 XOF). Student variants: 1-year at 100,000 XOF; 3-year at 250,000 XOF. No specific investor/golden-visa tier was found. Self-employed foreigners must also provide business registration documents. Processing time 30–45 days. No explicit minimum investment amount required.

rbi.name: Tonga
rbi.notes: Available to persons with Tongan ancestry, former Tongan citizenship, or marriage to a Tongan national. Not an investment program. Fee: USD 115 (adults), USD 54.50 (minors). No investment amount required. Duration and path to PR not specified on official page.

rbi.name: Tonga
rbi.notes: For non-Tongan passport holders seeking retirement in Tonga. Requires proof of minimum annual income of TOP 10,000 from an overseas pension or fund. No capital/property investment required. Application fee: USD 345. Visa valid for 2 years or more, renewable. Work, study, and business activities are prohibited. Overstay penalty: TOP 1,500. Not an investment program but a passive-income residency pathway.

rbi.name: Trinidad and Tobago
rbi.notes: Foreign nationals may apply for permanent residence after 5 years of continuous lawful residence. Pathways include employment (work permit holders), family connections (parent/grandparent sponsorship or marriage to a citizen/resident), and investment. No specific minimum investment amount found on official sources. Categories: 5(3) - 5 years continuous residence; 6(1)a - work permit holders or CSME Certificate holders; 6(1)b - parental/grandparental sponsorship; 6(1)c - marriage to a citizen or resident.

rbi.name: Turkey
rbi.notes: Investors meeting CBI investment thresholds (e.g. min USD 400,000 real estate, or USD 500,000 other routes) receive short-term residence permit valid up to 5 years (renewable). After 8 years continuous residence a long-term (indefinite) residence permit may be obtained. Investors may also apply directly for citizenship. Source: invest.gov.tr

rbi.name: Turkey
rbi.notes: Requires 8 years of continuous legal residence in Turkey. Granted for indefinite period. Holders receive rights comparable to Turkish citizens except voting and military service. Source: en.goc.gov.tr (Presidency of Migration Management)

rbi.name: Turkmenistan
rbi.notes: The Law of Turkmenistan on Foreign Investments grants foreign investors who fully own enterprises with foreign investments the right to permanent residence in Turkmenistan. No specific minimum investment threshold is stated in this provision. The invest.gov.tm site had an expired SSL certificate at time of research; the law text is also available via UNCTAD at investmentpolicy.unctad.org/investment-laws/laws/539. The practical implementation, application procedures, and minimum investment amounts for this provision are not published on any accessible official page.

rbi.name: Uganda
rbi.program_name: Entry Permit – Investor Classes (B, C, D, E)
rbi.notes: Uganda offers several investor-oriented Entry Permit classes for foreign shareholders. Class B1: shareholders of companies in Agriculture. Class B2: Agro-processing (6 months: USD 400; 12 months: USD 400; 24 months available). Class C1/C2: prospecting/mining of minerals. Class D: general trade. Class E: manufacturing. Class F: specific professions. These are residence-linked permits tied to active investment in Uganda companies. No explicit minimum investment amount is stated on the official page. No formal golden visa or RBI pathway to permanent residence or citizenship is documented on official sources.

rbi.name: Uganda
rbi.program_name: Entry Permit – Class H (Ordinary Resident / Independent Means)
rbi.notes: Class H is issued to persons who have an assured income derived from sources outside Uganda and undertake not to accept employment of any kind in Uganda. No minimum income amount stated on official page.

rbi.name: Ukraine
rbi.notes: Foreigners who are founders, participants, or beneficial owners of Ukrainian legal entities with an ownership share of not less than 100,000 EUR (at the National Bank of Ukraine official exchange rate on the date of investment) are eligible for a temporary residence permit valid for 2 years (renewable). The 100,000 EUR may be contributed in monetary form, property, or securities. Processing: 15 working days. Issued by State Migration Service of Ukraine. Path to citizenship: After obtaining immigration permit and 5 years of continuous legal residence, citizenship by admission is possible (requires renunciation of foreign citizenship).

rbi.name: Ukraine
rbi.notes: Foreign nationals who have made foreign investment in the Ukrainian economy in foreign convertible currency equivalent to at least USD 100,000 may obtain an immigration permit (quota-based). The immigration permit is valid for 1 year from issuance and entitles holders to permanent residence upon obtaining a permanent residence permit. Processing: up to 1 year from submission. Source: dmsu.gov.ua official immigration permit page.

rbi.name: United Arab Emirates
rbi.notes: 10-year renewable residency. Options: (1) Company investment/shares valued at min AED 2 million; (2) Local bank deposit (Sukuk or investment bonds) of min AED 2 million; (3) Annual tax contribution of min AED 250,000. No sponsor required. Family sponsorship included. Does not lead to citizenship.

rbi.name: United Arab Emirates
rbi.notes: 5-year renewable residency for real estate investment (10-year per GDRFA route for fully-owned properties). Property must be fully owned, minimum value AED 2,000,000. Processing: 2 days. Service fee: AED 2,790 (GDRFA Dubai route).

rbi.name: United Arab Emirates
rbi.notes: 5-year renewable residency for entrepreneurs with innovative/technical projects. Requires a certified auditor letter proving project value is no less than AED 500,000, plus approval from a recognised business incubator or relevant emirate authority. Confirmed per live ICP Golden Residency page (June 2026). Note: a prior validation note (June 2026) incorrectly stated the commercial-license route required AED 2 million capital - this has been corrected; the ICP page threshold for entrepreneurs is AED 500,000 project value.

rbi.name: United Arab Emirates
rbi.notes: 5-year renewable self-sponsored residency. Requires valid UAE employment contract, skill levels 1-3 per MOHRE occupational classification, minimum bachelor's degree, and monthly salary of AED 15,000 or more.

rbi.name: United Arab Emirates
rbi.notes: 5-year renewable self-sponsored residency. Requires freelancing/self-employment permit from MOHRE, minimum bachelor's degree or specialized diploma, and annual freelance income of at least AED 360,000 over past two years.

rbi.name: United Arab Emirates
rbi.notes: 10-year renewable residency for individuals who have made exceptional contributions to environmental protection and sustainability inside or outside UAE. Categories include: environmental influencers, scientists/researchers, environmental investors/entrepreneurs, inventors/innovators, elite specialists, members of international organisations/companies/NGOs, and global award winners. No fixed minimum investment amount confirmed on official u.ae page - prior AED 1 million figure for 'investors' category is unconfirmed on the live official page and has been removed. No sponsor required.

rbi.name: United Kingdom
rbi.notes: This route is CLOSED to new applications as of 17 February 2022. Existing holders may still extend or apply for ILR. Previously required £2 million investment in UK government bonds, share capital or loan capital in active UK companies. Not a new route - listed for completeness only.

rbi.name: United States
rbi.notes: The EB-5 program grants lawful permanent residency (green card) to investors who invest $1,050,000 in a new commercial enterprise (or $800,000 in a Targeted Employment Area (TEA) or infrastructure project) and create or preserve 10 permanent full-time jobs for qualified U.S. workers. Investment amounts automatically adjust on January 1, 2027, and every 5 years thereafter (CPI-based). Two pathways: (1) Direct investment (I-526 petition); (2) Regional Center investment (I-526E petition) - Regional Center Program authorized through September 30, 2027. After receiving conditional permanent residency, investors file to remove conditions after 2 years. Naturalization to U.S. citizenship is possible after 5 years of permanent residency. USCIS assigns I-526 and I-526E petitions on a first-in, first-out (FIFO) basis. Dual citizenship is recognized under U.S. law.

rbi.name: United States
rbi.program_name: EB-5 Immigrant Investor Program - TEA/Infrastructure Rate
rbi.notes: Reduced minimum investment of $800,000 applies when the investment is in a Targeted Employment Area (TEA - defined as a rural area or area with unemployment at least 150% of the national average) or an infrastructure project. Established by the EB-5 Reform and Integrity Act of 2022 (effective March 15, 2022). Next automatic CPI adjustment: January 1, 2027. Both the $1,050,000 and $800,000 thresholds are confirmed unchanged for FY2026.

rbi.name: United States
rbi.notes: Nonimmigrant temporary visa for nationals of treaty countries who invest a 'substantial amount of capital' in a U.S. business (no fixed minimum specified in law; must be proportional to the total cost of the enterprise). Must own at least 50% of the enterprise or possess operational control. Does NOT directly lead to permanent residency or citizenship; it is a temporary nonimmigrant status renewable indefinitely while the investment continues. Only available to nationals of countries with a qualifying bilateral investment treaty with the US. See travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/us-visas/employment/treaty-trader-investor-visa-e.html for treaty country list.

rbi.name: Uruguay
rbi.notes: Temporary residency for stays of more than 180 days and less than 2 years. Categories include workers/entrepreneurs (requires employment letter with contract details), students (enrollment proof and financial support), and religious (church credential and proof of livelihood). After 3 years of legal residency (cumulated), citizenship can be requested. No specific minimum investment amount required.

rbi.name: Uruguay
rbi.notes: Permanent residency for non-Mercosur nationals intending to reside permanently in Uruguay. Must regularize situation through the National Department of Migration. No minimum investment required. After 3 years of legal residency, citizenship may be requested.

rbi.name: Uruguay
rbi.notes: Granted to nationals born or naturalized in Mercosur member and associate states (Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay, Venezuela, Bolivia, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Guyana, Suriname). Includes foreign family members of Uruguayan nationals. After 3 years of legal residency, citizenship may be requested.

rbi.name: Uruguay
rbi.notes: Available to Mercosur and associated country nationals with 5+ years of citizenship. Duration: 2 years, renewable once for additional 2 years. Renewal must be requested 90 days before expiration. No minimum investment required.

rbi.name: Uruguay
rbi.notes: Established under Decree 238/022. Duration: 6 months, renewable for additional 6 months (12 months total). Eligibility: self-employed or employed by foreign companies. Must first enter as regular tourist. Requirements: online application form, affidavit of financial self-sufficiency, clean criminal record (for extension), vaccination certificate from Uruguay. No minimum income threshold specified on official page. Can transition to temporary or permanent residency. Contact: dnm-hip@minterior.gub.uy.

rbi.name: Uzbekistan
rbi.notes: 5-year residence permit via one-off donation of USD 250,000 for main applicant; USD 150,000 per additional family member (spouse, children, parents). No nationality restrictions. No requirement to form a business or purchase real estate. Introduced by Presidential Decree No. UP-67 of April 18, 2025; effective June 1, 2025. Path to citizenship not confirmed officially.

rbi.name: Uzbekistan
rbi.program_name: Residence Permit via Business Investment - Standard
rbi.notes: 3-year renewable residence permit for investment of USD 250,000 in a company registered in Uzbekistan. Based on amendments to Presidential Decree No. UP-5611.

rbi.name: Uzbekistan
rbi.program_name: Residence Permit via Business Investment - Large Scale
rbi.notes: 10-year renewable residence permit for investment of USD 3,000,000 in a business engaged in production of goods or services. Based on amendments to Presidential Decree No. UP-5611.

rbi.name: Uzbekistan
rbi.program_name: Residence Permit via Real Estate - Tashkent/Tashkent Region
rbi.notes: Residence permit via real estate investment of USD 300,000 in Tashkent city or Tashkent region. Based on amendments to Presidential Decree No. UP-5611.

rbi.name: Uzbekistan
rbi.program_name: Residence Permit via Real Estate - Major Cities
rbi.notes: Residence permit via real estate investment of USD 200,000 in cities of Samarkand, Bukhara, Namangan, Andijan, Fergana, or Khorezm. Based on amendments to Presidential Decree No. UP-5611.

rbi.name: Uzbekistan
rbi.program_name: Residence Permit via Real Estate - Other Regions
rbi.notes: Residence permit via real estate investment of USD 100,000 in other regions including Republic of Karakalpakstan. Based on amendments to Presidential Decree No. UP-5611.

rbi.name: Vanuatu
rbi.program_name: Business Investor Visa (formerly Foreign Investor Residence Visa)
rbi.notes: For individuals who have been granted a Foreign Investment Approval Certificate by VFIPA, a certificate of registration from VFSC, or a business license from relevant authorities. Duration: 3 years, multiple entry, renewable. Fee: 206,000 VUV. Can change status to Direct Investor Visa or Permanent Investor Visa. Source: evisa.gov.vu/visas

rbi.name: Vanuatu
rbi.notes: For individuals who have deposited a bond into a nominated Government bank account for a term of 8 years and provided proof of sufficient funds to cover ongoing living expenses. Duration: 8 years, multiple entry. Fee: 309,000 VUV. Can change to Investor Visa or Leasehold Owner Visa. Source: evisa.gov.vu/visas

rbi.name: Vanuatu
rbi.notes: For foreign investors who have been residing lawfully and continuously in Vanuatu for at least 10 years and are maintaining ownership and management of their business. Duration: Indefinite, multiple entry. Fee: 3,090,000 VUV. Source: evisa.gov.vu/visas

rbi.name: Vanuatu
rbi.notes: For non-citizens intending to invest in Vanuatu who are in the phase of setting up a business while communicating with VFIPA and VFSC. Duration: 1 year, multiple entry. Fee: 51,500 VUV. Extendable. Can change status to Business Investor Visa. Source: evisa.gov.vu/visas

rbi.name: Vanuatu
rbi.notes: Leasehold Holder Visa: For non-citizens with leasehold ownership of property certified to be worth VT 10,000,000 or more, and income of at least VT 250,000 per month per person (max 1,000,000 VUV). Duration: 12 months, multiple entry. Fee: 59,330 VUV. Must reside physically in Vanuatu. Can change to investor visa. Source: evisa.gov.vu/visas

rbi.name: Vanuatu
rbi.notes: For non-citizens aged 50 or above proposing to retire in Vanuatu. Duration: 10 years, multiple entry. Fee: 309,000 VUV. Extendable. Cannot engage in employment, commercial, or business activities. Source: evisa.gov.vu/visas

rbi.name: Vanuatu
rbi.notes: Permanent residency visa granted for a period not exceeding 10 years. Fee: 206,000 VUV for individuals; 463,500 VUV for family of 4; 100,000 VUV per additional child. Extendable. Requires valid passport copy and police clearance. Cannot engage in employment, commercial, or business activities. Source: evisa.gov.vu/visas

rbi.name: Venezuela
rbi.notes: Investor transient visa (TR-I) for foreign nationals who can demonstrate a materialized productive investment in Venezuela. Applicant must hold at least 20% ownership in a registered Venezuelan company or equivalent capital contribution. Visa granted for 3 years (multiple entry, no stay limit), extendable up to 2 additional years. After this, can apply for Resident status (5-year validity). Path to citizenship after 10 years continuous residency (5 years if married to Venezuelan national). No minimum investment amount is specified on the official consular pages. Applications must be submitted at a Venezuelan embassy or consulate.

rbi.name: Vietnam
rbi.notes: DT visa is governed by Law No. 47/2014/QH13 (Law on Entry, Exit, Transit and Residence of Foreigners). Four tiers: DT1 (>=100 billion VND or priority sectors, up to 5-year visa, 10-year TRC), DT2 (50-100 billion VND or encouraged sectors, up to 5-year visa, 5-year TRC), DT3 (3-50 billion VND, 3-year visa, 3-year TRC), DT4 (<3 billion VND, 1-year visa). Min_amount shown is DT3 lower threshold (3 billion VND). Permanent residence is possible after qualifying period for scientists/experts with ministerial recommendation, or foreigners sponsored by Vietnamese family after 3+ continuous years. Processing ~5 working days.

rbi.name: Zambia
rbi.notes: Issued to a foreigner (above 18 years) establishing or investing in a business in Zambia. Requires proof of personal investment of USD 250,000 for a new business or USD 150,000 if joining an existing company. Requires Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Minimum Capital/Share Capital, Investment License from ZDA (if available), and proof of property ownership or lease. After holding an Investors Permit for more than 3 years, the holder may qualify for a Residence Permit (permanent residence).

rbi.name: Zambia
rbi.notes: Confers permanent residence. Eligible categories include: holders of an Employment Permit for a continuous period exceeding 10 years; holder of Investor's Permit for more than 3 years; holder of Spouse Permit for at least 5 years; persons born from a citizen; retirees showing proof of sufficient funds (pension, irrevocable annuity, retirement account). A residence permit ceases to be valid if the holder is absent from Zambia for any period in excess of twelve months.

rbi.name: Zimbabwe
rbi.notes: The Investor Residence Permit is issued for 12 months (renewable annually). Application fee: USD 500 (non-refundable); USD 300 per dependent. Required documents include a completed I.F.5 form, project proposal, police clearance (not older than six months), medical radiological certificate, banking history and proof of funds. The minimum investment threshold (previously cited as USD 100,000 or USD 1,000,000 depending on track) could NOT be confirmed from the official zimimmigration.gov.zw page, which was directly accessed in this validation. Those thresholds have been removed from structured fields pending official confirmation. Path to permanent residence and citizenship years are not stated on the official page.

fastTrack.name: Albania
fastTrack.program_name: Unique Permit for Digital Mobile Workers
fastTrack.eligibility: Remote workers employed by or freelancing for companies/clients established outside Albania. Must have valid employment or service contract with a foreign entity and sufficient income to cover accommodation and living expenses in Albania.
fastTrack.processing_time: Up to 12 weeks (maximum) from date of application
fastTrack.notes: Available via the e-Albania portal (service code 15146). Application submitted entirely online. Introduced in 2022 under Law No. 79/2021 'On Foreigners'. Combines residence and work authorization in a single biometric card.

fastTrack.name: Albania
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign researchers undertaking scientific research at Albanian research institutions or universities. Based on Article 50 of Law No. 79/2021.
fastTrack.notes: Based on Article 50 of Law No. 79/2021 'On Foreigners'. Available via e-Albania portal.

fastTrack.name: Albania
fastTrack.program_name: Job Seeking / Entrepreneurship Permit for Researchers and Graduates
fastTrack.eligibility: Researchers and highly qualified graduates seeking employment or establishing a business in Albania. Based on Article 51 of Law No. 79/2021.
fastTrack.notes: Based on Article 51 of Law No. 79/2021 'On Foreigners'. Provides a pathway for graduates and researchers to seek employment or start a business in Albania.

fastTrack.name: Andorra
fastTrack.program_name: Residència per a nòmada digital (Digital Nomad Residency)
fastTrack.eligibility: Individuals who work remotely for employers or clients based outside Andorra using telecommunications and technology, without requiring a specific geographic location. Annual quota: 50 permits per year for digital nomads specifically. If the 50-permit digital nomad quota is exhausted, additional permits may still be granted up to a combined ceiling of 100 permits shared with the entrepreneurship programme quota.
fastTrack.notes: Introduced by Llei 42/2022 del 1 de desembre, d'economia digital, emprenedoria i innovació (Digital Economy, Entrepreneurship and Innovation Law), with implementing regulations from 2023. Annual quota of 50 permits for digital nomads; a combined ceiling of 100 applies across both the digital nomad and entrepreneurship categories. Exempt from the €50,000 AFA non-refundable contribution (unlike passive residents). No obligation to incorporate an Andorran entity or register with social security. Minimum stay: 90 days per calendar year. Private health and disability insurance required. No work for Andorran clients/employers permitted. Permit duration: 2 years initially, first renewal 2 years, second renewal 3 years, subsequent renewals 10 years.

fastTrack.name: Andorra
fastTrack.eligibility: Entrepreneurs participating in the entrepreneurship programme promoted by the Ministry in charge of the economy. Annual quota: 50 permits per year for entrepreneurship specifically, with a combined ceiling of 100 permits shared with the digital nomad quota.
fastTrack.notes: Governed by Llei 42/2022. Requires prior authorization from the Ministry of Economy. Annual quota of 50 permits for entrepreneurship; a combined ceiling of 100 applies across both the entrepreneurship and digital nomad categories. Exempt from €50,000 AFA contribution provided the business project has been validated by a government-recognised entity under the digital economy/innovation/technological entrepreneurship regulatory criteria.

fastTrack.name: Antigua and Barbuda
fastTrack.eligibility: Programme closed to new applications as of November 15, 2025. Previously required remote work capability and demonstrated minimum annual income of US$50,000 for each year of the 2-year stay. Valid medical insurance and police clearance were required.
fastTrack.notes: The Antigua and Barbuda NDR Programme was officially discontinued effective November 15, 2025 per an official government announcement (ab.gov.ag). Previously: fees were US$1,500 (single applicant), US$2,000 (couple), US$3,000 (family of 3 or more); granted special-resident authorisation valid for up to 2 years; included income tax exemption on foreign-sourced income.

fastTrack.name: Argentina
fastTrack.program_name: Digital Nomad Transitional Residence - Residencia Transitoria como Nómada Digital
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals from countries that do not require a tourist visa to enter Argentina, who provide remote services using digital or telecommunications means to individuals or legal entities domiciled abroad
fastTrack.processing_time: In-person process; standard migration fee schedule applies
fastTrack.notes: Established by DNM Disposition No. 758/2022. Duration: 180 days, renewable once for an additional 180 days (total up to 12 months). Requires signed application, CV, proof of remote work activity (contracts, company endorsement, income receipts), and at least one professional reference. In-person application only; not available via the RADEX online system. Includes perks: discounts on transportation, hotels, coworking spaces, educational and cultural activities.

fastTrack.name: Argentina
fastTrack.eligibility: Nationals of MERCOSUR member or associate states (Brazil, Paraguay, Uruguay, Bolivia, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Peru, Suriname)
fastTrack.notes: Provides temporary establishment in Argentina for up to 2 years. Requires valid passport (6+ months validity, 2 blank pages), photographs, application form, proof of address, certificate of good conduct (age 16+), and consular fee (USD/EUR 200 equivalent). Consular interview required. Under the MERCOSUR Residency Agreement framework.

fastTrack.name: Australia
fastTrack.eligibility: Exceptionally talented individuals who have an internationally recognised record of exceptional and outstanding achievement in an eligible area. The Department must invite applicants - submission of an Expression of Interest (EOI) is required first. Eligible areas include AgriFood Tech, Space, FinTech, MedTech, CyberSecurity, Resources Technology, Quantum, and others per the current NIV priorities list.
fastTrack.processing_time: Varies; applications processed in accordance with Skilled Visa processing priorities.
fastTrack.notes: Permanent visa. Replaced the Global Talent Independent Program (GTI) / former Distinguished Talent Visa (858), launched 6 December 2024. Must submit an EOI; Department must invite before application. Nominator is mandatory. The salary threshold is linked to the Fair Work High Income Threshold (FWIT): from 1 July 2026 the FWIT is AUD 190,100 (increased from AUD 183,100 which applied from 1 July 2025). This figure is subject to annual indexation on 1 July each year.

fastTrack.name: Australia
fastTrack.eligibility: Skilled workers with an occupation on the eligible skilled occupations list, minimum 65 points in the points test. Must submit EOI via SkillSelect and receive an invitation.
fastTrack.processing_time: Varies; processed in accordance with annual migration planning levels and invitation rounds.
fastTrack.notes: Permanent visa with no sponsorship or nomination required. Points assessed on age, education, English language ability, and work experience. Cannot guarantee invitation even if minimum 65 points are met.

fastTrack.name: Australia
fastTrack.program_name: Business Innovation and Investment (Provisional) visa - Entrepreneur Stream (subclass 188) [CLOSED]
fastTrack.eligibility: CLOSED to new applications as of 31 July 2024. Previously required funding agreement from a third party (e.g. venture capital) or an Entrepreneurs' Programme grant. Must be nominated by a state/territory government or Austrade.
fastTrack.processing_time: Visa stay up to 4 years and 3 months (provisional). Existing applications only.
fastTrack.notes: CLOSED to new applications as of 31 July 2024. Path to permanent residence via subclass 888 Entrepreneur Stream remains open for existing holders.

fastTrack.name: Australia
fastTrack.program_name: Business Talent (Permanent) visa - Venture Capital Entrepreneur Stream (subclass 132) [CLOSED]
fastTrack.eligibility: CLOSED to new applications as of 31 July 2024. Previously for people who sourced venture capital funding from a member of the Australian Investment Council (AIC) for a high-value business concept.
fastTrack.processing_time: Permanent visa granted upon approval. Existing applications only.
fastTrack.notes: CLOSED to new applications as of 31 July 2024. Refunds of VAC available for applicants who withdrew on or after 31 July 2024. Previously required nomination by Austrade.

fastTrack.name: Austria
fastTrack.program_name: Red-White-Red Card – Very Highly Qualified Workers
fastTrack.eligibility: Minimum 70 points on the Austrian points system. Requires tertiary education degree, work experience, language skills. Must secure a qualifying job offer.
fastTrack.processing_time: AMS assessment within 3 weeks; overall processing time not specified on official source.
fastTrack.notes: Points-based: 40 pts for qualifications (PhD/habilitation maximum), 20 pts for work experience, 10 pts for language, 20 pts for age, 10 pts for Austrian studies. Minimum threshold: 70 points.

fastTrack.name: Austria
fastTrack.eligibility: University degree (min. 3 years), binding job offer for min. 6 months, salary at least equal to average gross annual salary for full-time employees, labor market test.
fastTrack.processing_time: Not specified on official source; one-stop-shop procedure with AMS.
fastTrack.notes: EU-wide instrument, implemented in Austria. Card issued for 24 months.

fastTrack.name: Austria
fastTrack.eligibility: Innovative business, coherent business plan, min. 50% equity, min. €30,000 capital, min. 50 points on points system.
fastTrack.processing_time: AMS macroeconomic benefit review within 3 weeks.
fastTrack.notes: Min. €30,000 company capital required with 50% equity stake. Extra 10 points for additional €50,000 capital. Card valid up to 24 months. Maximum 85 points total across all categories.

fastTrack.name: Austria
fastTrack.eligibility: Age 18–30 years. Available to nationals of: Argentina, Australia, Canada, Chile, Hong Kong, India, Israel, Japan, New Zealand, South Korea, Taiwan, United States of America.
fastTrack.notes: Bilateral Working Holiday Programme agreements with 12 countries. Primary purpose is holiday with incidental work/training permitted. Not a permanent residence or fast-track-to-citizenship pathway.

fastTrack.name: Azerbaijan
fastTrack.eligibility: Nationals of countries eligible for Azerbaijan e-visa (as listed at evisa.gov.az/countries)
fastTrack.processing_time: 3 hours (regardless of holidays and non-working days)
fastTrack.notes: The ASAN Visa urgent service processes single-entry e-visa applications within 3 hours for any eligible nationality. Standard processing takes 3 working days. The visa is valid for 30 days stay in Azerbaijan.

fastTrack.name: Bahamas
fastTrack.eligibility: Remote workers and students working/studying for employers/institutions outside the Bahamas
fastTrack.notes: Launched October 2020, the BEATS program allowed remote workers and students to live and work remotely in the Bahamas for up to 12 months (renewable twice for up to 3 years total). No minimum income requirement, but applicants needed income from outside the Bahamas. The program was suspended in early 2022. No replacement program has been confirmed on official sources as active. Referenced in official press release at https://www.immigration.gov.bs/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/BMOTA-BEATS-_Press_Release-_FINAL_10.29-converted.pdf. Note: The Special Permit listed on immigration.gov.bs is NOT a nomad/travel visa - it is exclusively for persons previously deported or on the Restricted List.

fastTrack.name: Bahamas
fastTrack.program_name: Expedited Permanent Residence for High-Value Real Estate Investment
fastTrack.eligibility: Investors purchasing residential real estate valued at BSD $1.5 million or more
fastTrack.processing_time: Speedy/expedited consideration - could not be re-confirmed on live immigration.gov.bs page as of 2026 re-verification
fastTrack.notes: Previously documented that persons purchasing a residence for BSD $1.5 million or more receive speedy consideration for their permanent residence applications. The live immigration.gov.bs page (re-checked 2026) only states the USD $1.0 million minimum without mentioning a BSD $1.5 million expedited tier. This item could not be re-confirmed and source_official has been set to false. May still exist as internal policy.

fastTrack.name: Bahrain
fastTrack.eligibility: Entrepreneurs, researchers/scientists, artists/creatives, innovators (technology/business), championship-winning athletes, and individuals with exceptional leadership or community service achievements. Subject to specialized committee review.
fastTrack.notes: Part of the Bahrain Golden Residency program. No specific investment threshold for the talent category - approved based on merit and committee review.

fastTrack.name: Barbados
fastTrack.eligibility: Remote workers, freelancers, and entrepreneurs who work location-independently for companies or individuals outside Barbados. Minimum annual income of USD $50,000. Individuals and families qualify. Participants may not accept employment from or offer services to persons or entities carrying on business in Barbados.
fastTrack.notes: Program introduced by the Barbados Government on June 30, 2020. Cabinet approved renewal of the Welcome Stamp Visa until December 31, 2026 at its meeting of October 26, 2023. Valid for 12 months; renewable. Individual fee: USD $2,000; Family fee: USD $3,000 (non-refundable, due within 28 days of approval). Welcome Stamp holders are not subject to Barbados income tax for the 12-month period (17.5% VAT on goods/services still applies). Application portal: barbadoswelcomestamp.bb/applynow (Form C-5 under the Immigration Act). Official government page confirmed at foreign.gov.bb.

fastTrack.name: Belarus
fastTrack.program_name: Hi-Tech Park (HTP) - Visa-Free and Simplified Residence for IT/Tech Talent
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals who are founders or employees of companies that are residents of the Belarus Hi-Tech Park (HTP). Company must be engaged in software development, IT services, or high-tech R&D and registered as a legal entity in Belarus.
fastTrack.notes: Key immigration benefits: (1) Visa-free entry for foreign workers and founders of HTP companies with temporary stay up to 180 days; (2) Simplified temporary residence permit process; (3) No requirement to obtain special work permits when employing foreigners. HTP residency confers additional tax and customs benefits. Official HTP site: park.by

fastTrack.name: Belgium
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals with higher education qualifications or high professional skills, employed by a Belgian employer under a Single Permit application. Identified with code B29 on the visa/permit.
fastTrack.processing_time: 4 months from admissibility (extendable); region makes work authorization decision while Immigration Office decides residence
fastTrack.notes: EU Blue Card holders benefit from family reunification without proof of sufficient means of subsistence. Can combine EU-wide residency across Schengen states for long-term resident status (minimum 2 years in Belgium immediately before application). Applied via Single Permit procedure by employer.

fastTrack.name: Belgium
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals conducting scientific research in Belgium under a hosting agreement with a recognized research institution.
fastTrack.notes: Listed as a separate category on the IBZ work themes page. Requires hosting agreement with recognized research organization. Long-term mobility option also available for researchers already authorized in another EU member state.

fastTrack.name: Belgium
fastTrack.eligibility: Managers, specialists, or trainee employees being transferred within a multinational enterprise to a Belgian entity for more than 90 days.
fastTrack.notes: Listed as 'Worker ICT' category on the IBZ work themes page. Separate procedure from the standard Single Permit.

fastTrack.name: Belgium
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country national graduates of Belgian higher education institutions who wish to seek employment or start a business after completing their studies.
fastTrack.notes: Allows graduates a period to look for work or start self-employed activity in Belgium before converting to a work or entrepreneur permit.

fastTrack.name: Belize
fastTrack.eligibility: Citizens or permanent residents of EU, UK, USA, or Canada who are employed outside Belize; minimum annual income of USD $75,000 for individuals or USD $100,000 for couples/families; clear criminal record check (no more than 6 months old); travel insurance with minimum coverage of US $50,000; notarized banking reference and account statement
fastTrack.processing_time: A few weeks (no fixed timeline stated officially)
fastTrack.notes: Allows remote workers to reside in Belize for up to 180 days. Waives work permit for participant and student permits for dependent children. Fee: BZD $500 per adult, BZD $200 per child under 18. Fee paid upon airport arrival. Apply via email to Belize Immigration Department: visas@immigration.gov.bz or secretary@immigration.gov.bz. Administered via Belize Tourism Board and Immigration Department partnership. Not a path to permanent residence. Program confirmed active as of June 2026 re-verification.

fastTrack.name: Bhutan
fastTrack.program_name: Gelephu Mindfulness City (GMC) Digital Nomad Residence Programme
fastTrack.eligibility: Remote workers, freelancers, entrepreneurs, and professionals working for entities established outside Bhutan. Must be able to work remotely. No mandatory minimum income requirement if annual visa fee is paid.
fastTrack.processing_time: Online application; final decision by Gelephu Mindfulness City Authority (GMCA)
fastTrack.notes: Launched in February 2026 by the Gelephu Mindfulness City Authority (GMCA), a special administrative zone authority of Bhutan's government, in partnership with private operator NomadClub. Application fee: USD 2,800/year (non-refundable). Mandatory deposit of USD 10,000 in TER tokens (a Solana blockchain gold-backed digital token issued by DK Bank) - fully refundable on exit. Visa valid 12 months, renewable for up to 24 months total. Residents may travel throughout Bhutan but must pay USD 100/day Sustainable Development Fee outside GMC. The application portal (digitalgmc.com) is operated by NomadClub (private), not a .gov.bt domain; source_official is therefore false despite GMCA's government backing.

fastTrack.name: Botswana
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-citizens who wish to work in Botswana for reward, or invest in Botswana for profit. Requires waiver from Department of Labour and Social Security, or copies of work and residence permits, confirmation of employment, and relevant qualifications.
fastTrack.notes: Official gov.bw page describes a Work Permit giving non-citizens permission to work in Botswana for reward or to invest for profit. A Point-Based System (PBS) for work permits is referenced in official Botswana Government communications, but a dedicated accessible official web page with full PBS details was not available. The gov.bw sub-page returned HTTP 500 during June 2026 re-validation.

fastTrack.name: Brazil
fastTrack.program_name: Digital Nomad Visa (VITEM XIV - Nômade Digital)
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals who work remotely for foreign companies or clients outside Brazil, using information and communication technology. Must demonstrate minimum monthly income of USD 1,500 or available savings of at least USD 18,000. Valid passport, criminal background check (apostilled), health insurance with minimum USD 30,000 coverage required.
fastTrack.processing_time: 15-30 business days (with assistance); 30-60 business days (self-filed); some consulates up to 3-6 months
fastTrack.notes: Based on Normative Resolution RN 45/2021. Visa code VITEM XIV. Initial validity 1 year, extendable for 1 more year (maximum 2 years total residence under this category). Application fees: R$168.13 for in-country applications (MigranteWeb). Income must be from foreign-paying sources. Confirmed across multiple official MRE consulate pages (Helsinki, New York, London, Amsterdam, Houston, San Francisco, Zagreb). After meeting residency requirements, may transition to permanent residency and eventually naturalization.

fastTrack.name: Brazil
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign retirees or pensioners receiving monthly income from foreign sources. Minimum income threshold required.
fastTrack.notes: VITEM XIV category also covers retirees and pensioners. Official quick guide available from portaldeimigracao.mj.gov.br. Minimum income amount not confirmed verbatim from official source.

fastTrack.name: Brazil
fastTrack.program_name: Expedited Temporary Visa/Residence for Mercosur and CPLP Nationals
fastTrack.eligibility: Nationals of Mercosur member/associate states and CPLP (Community of Portuguese-Speaking Countries) member states
fastTrack.processing_time: Expedited under Portaria Interministerial MJSP/MRE nº 40/2023
fastTrack.notes: Brazil expedited temporary visas and residence permits for Mercosur and Portuguese-language country migrants under Portaria Interministerial MJSP/MRE nº 40, of September 1, 2023 (CPLP) and a separate Portaria in October 2024 covering Mercosur nationals.

fastTrack.name: Brunei
fastTrack.eligibility: Brunei citizens categorized as business people; requires letter of support from Ministry of Finance and Economy, Ministry of Primary Resources and Tourism, Brunei Chamber of Commerce, or Brunei Young Entrepreneurs Association
fastTrack.notes: ABTC (KUPA) holders have access to fast-track immigration lane at Brunei International Airport. Card is valid for 5 years. First application fee: BND$100.00; Renewal: BND$50.00. This is an outbound facilitation card for Bruneian citizen business travellers, not an inbound visa scheme.

fastTrack.name: Bulgaria
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals (non-EU/EEA/Swiss) who work remotely for employers or businesses registered outside the EU/EEA/Switzerland. Three eligible categories: (1) employees of companies registered outside EU/EEA/Switzerland, (2) entrepreneurs/managers owning 25%+ of a company registered abroad, (3) self-employed remote workers with at least 1 year of prior remote operation. Minimum average annual income of EUR 31,000 (50x the minimum monthly wage as of January 2025) for the prior calendar year. Must have valid health insurance and proof of accommodation in Bulgaria.
fastTrack.notes: Introduced through amendments to the Foreigners in the Republic of Bulgaria Act, approved by the Bulgarian Parliament in June 2025. The Council of Ministers adopted the implementing regulations on 10 December 2025 and applications began being accepted from 20 December 2025. The permit is valid for 1 year and may be extended once for an additional year (total maximum 2 years). Holders may not work for Bulgarian companies or clients based in Bulgaria. Administered by the Ministry of Interior.

fastTrack.name: Cabo Verde
fastTrack.eligibility: Persons working remotely for a company or entity outside Cabo Verde. Required documents: passport, criminal record from country of origin, proof of employment/contract with remote employer, proof of income, proof of accommodation in Cabo Verde, medical certificate.
fastTrack.notes: Listed on the official National Police / e-Residencia portal (e-portaldef.gov.cv) under Visa types. The application portal was listed as 'Em manutenção' (under maintenance) at the time of research (June 2026). No duration or income threshold stated on the official page.

fastTrack.name: Cameroon
fastTrack.eligibility: All ordinary passport holders eligible to apply for a Cameroon visa (same eligibility as standard short-stay visa)
fastTrack.notes: Express processing option available through the official evisacam.cm portal (MINREX) at an additional fee. Standard short-stay visa costs XAF 100,000 / approx. EUR 152; express short-stay costs XAF 150,000 / approx. EUR 229 (diplocam.cm confirmed 2026-06-29). Long-stay normal XAF 150,000; long-stay express XAF 200,000 per diplocam.cm. Standard processing is 72 hours (3 working days). Referenced in Decree No. 2023/147 of 02 March 2023.

fastTrack.name: Canada
fastTrack.program_name: Express Entry – Federal Skilled Worker Program
fastTrack.eligibility: Skilled workers with at least 1 year continuous paid full-time work experience (or equivalent part-time: 1,560 hours) in a NOC TEER 0, 1, 2, or 3 occupation; language proficiency; education; minimum 67 CRS points
fastTrack.processing_time: 6 months (service standard for 80% of complete applications)
fastTrack.notes: Canada's flagship points-based skilled worker permanent residence pathway. Candidates create an online profile, enter the pool, and receive Invitations to Apply (ITA) through rounds of invitations. Category-based selection rounds for 2026 prioritize healthcare/social services, trades, and STEM occupations.

fastTrack.name: Canada
fastTrack.eligibility: At least 1 year of skilled work experience in Canada in NOC TEER 0, 1, 2, or 3; language proficiency
fastTrack.processing_time: 6 months (service standard for 80% of complete applications)
fastTrack.notes: For those with recent Canadian work experience. Part of the Express Entry system.

fastTrack.name: Canada
fastTrack.program_name: Express Entry – Federal Skilled Trades Program
fastTrack.eligibility: Skilled trade workers with qualifying job offer or certificate of qualification; at least 2 years paid full-time work experience in a skilled trade within 5 years before applying; language proficiency
fastTrack.processing_time: 6 months (service standard for 80% of complete applications)
fastTrack.notes: For tradespeople such as carpenters, plumbers, electricians. Part of the Express Entry system.

fastTrack.name: Canada
fastTrack.program_name: Global Skills Strategy (GSS) – 2-Week Work Permit Processing
fastTrack.eligibility: Workers in NOC TEER 0 (management) or TEER 1 (university degree required) occupations; employer must qualify; biometrics submitted within 2 weeks of instruction letter
fastTrack.processing_time: 2 weeks (goal for 80% of eligible complete applications)
fastTrack.notes: Fast-track temporary work permit processing for highly skilled workers. Canada aims to process 80% of eligible complete GSS work permit applications within 2 weeks. Applies to both LMIA-required and LMIA-exempt positions at TEER 0 and TEER 1 levels.

fastTrack.name: Canada
fastTrack.eligibility: Youth aged 18-35 (18-30 in some countries) from 35+ partner countries; must hold valid passport from eligible country; meet health and character requirements
fastTrack.notes: Working holiday open work permit allowing youth to work for most employers anywhere in Canada. Also includes Young Professionals and International Co-op/Internship categories. Pools for 2026 season are open. Participating countries include Australia, France, Germany, UK, Japan, Korea, Ireland and many others.

fastTrack.name: Chile
fastTrack.eligibility: Australian nationals aged up to 31 years
fastTrack.notes: Bilateral Working Holiday Agreement between Chile and Australia. Allows young Australian nationals to live and work in Chile temporarily. Age limit up to 31 years. Australia was also removed from the DS 359 visa-required list (effective Sep 2025) due to international reciprocity, meaning Australians now also enter visa-free as tourists for up to 90 days.

fastTrack.name: Chile
fastTrack.eligibility: New Zealand nationals aged up to 30 years
fastTrack.notes: Bilateral Working Holiday Agreement between Chile and New Zealand. Allows young New Zealand nationals to live and work in Chile temporarily. Age limit up to 30 years.

fastTrack.name: China
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreigners classified as 'high-level talents or whose skills are urgently needed in China'; must obtain Certification documents confirming qualifications from competent Chinese government authorities and a Confirmation Letter for High-level Foreign Talents from an inviting organization.
fastTrack.notes: China's dedicated visa category for high-level foreign talent. Offers more favorable terms than standard work visas. Application hotline: 12367.

fastTrack.name: China
fastTrack.program_name: K Visa (Young Science and Technology Professionals)
fastTrack.eligibility: Young science and technology professionals meeting qualifications set by relevant Chinese authorities. No mandatory domestic employer or invitation letter required, unlike other visa types.
fastTrack.processing_time: Streamlined application process; specific days not stated on official page
fastTrack.notes: New visa category effective October 1, 2025. Offers more convenience in number of permitted entries, validity period, and duration of stay compared to China's 12 ordinary visa types. Holders may participate in education, culture, science and technology exchanges, as well as entrepreneurial and business activities.

fastTrack.name: China
fastTrack.eligibility: Outstanding talents, scientific research talents, cultural and educational talents, healthcare and medical talents, legal talents, and other talents working in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, all pilot free trade zones nationwide. Requires relevant certification from competent talent authorities.
fastTrack.notes: Effective November 5, 2025, expanded from 3 initial regions to include entire Yangtze River Delta, Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, and all pilot free trade zones. Grants multiple-exit-entry endorsement to/from Hong Kong SAR or Macao SAR with validity of 1–5 years; 30 days max stay per visit. In Hetao Shenzhen-Hong Kong Science and Technology Innovation Cooperation Zone, 3-year endorsements may be obtained without talent certificates.

fastTrack.name: Colombia
fastTrack.program_name: Digital Nomad / Remote Worker Visa (V - Nómada Digital)
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreigners who provide remote work or telecommuting services exclusively for foreign companies (as independent contractor or employee), or who start a digital content or IT venture of interest to Colombia. Must hold passport from a visa-exempt nationality (per Resolution 5488 of 2022) or apply for a V visa if nationality is not exempt. Minimum income: 3x Colombia's SMMLV per month (approx. COP 5,252,715 / USD 1,400 at 2026 rates). Must have health insurance covering Colombia.
fastTrack.processing_time: Officially up to 30 calendar days; in practice 10-15 business days
fastTrack.notes: Created under Resolución 5477 of 2022. Visa-exempt nationalities can enter without a visa and stay under Entry Permission for up to 90 days for digital nomad activities. For longer stays, a Visitor (V) visa for digital nomads can be issued for up to 2 years. Income requirement is indexed annually to Colombia's SMMLV. Official Cancillería page: https://www.cancilleria.gov.co/v/nomadadigital and Migración Colombia: https://www.migracioncolombia.gov.co/es/informacion-para-extranjeros/visas/visas-para-nomadas-digitales

fastTrack.name: Costa Rica
fastTrack.program_name: Nómadas Digitales (Digital Nomad) – Temporary Stay Permit
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals who provide paid remote services to a natural person or legal entity located outside Costa Rica using digital or telecommunication technologies. Must earn minimum USD 3,000/month (USD 4,000/month if including dependents) from outside Costa Rica, documented over the prior year.
fastTrack.notes: Established under General Law of Migration and Foreigners Article 256 and Law 10008 (Item 11 bis). Duration: 1 year, renewable for a further year. Government application fee: USD 100 (or equivalent in colones, paid to Bank of Costa Rica account 001-0242480-0). Health insurance covering full stay with minimum USD 50,000 coverage required. Applications via online TramiteYa platform or in person at DGME offices. Digital nomad permit holders are exempt from paying taxes and customs duties on electronic devices for professional use.

fastTrack.name: Croatia
fastTrack.program_name: EU Blue Card - Highly Qualified Worker
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals with higher education diploma (or equivalent professional experience for ICT roles), employment contract in Croatia for at least 1 year, salary at least 1.5x average gross annual salary in Croatia
fastTrack.notes: No labor market test required for EU Blue Card. Valid for up to 48 months (as of 2025 amendments, up from previous 24 months). Highly qualified ICT professionals may use work experience instead of formal education qualification. Accelerated biometric card processing available for additional fee.

fastTrack.name: Croatia
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU/EEA/Swiss nationals working remotely via digital technology for a foreign employer or own foreign-registered company. Cannot provide services to Croatian clients. Minimum monthly income EUR 3,622.50.
fastTrack.notes: Application via Croatian diplomatic missions (for visa-required nationals) or online/police station (for visa-exempt nationals). Fee at embassy: EUR 55.74 (temporary stay) + EUR 93.00 (visa D) or EUR 41.14 (biometric card). Fee at police station: EUR 46.45 + EUR 41.14.

fastTrack.name: Cyprus
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country (non-EU/EEA) nationals who work remotely using telecommunications technology for employers or clients located abroad. Maximum of 500 permits total.
fastTrack.processing_time: Within 3 months of arrival applicant must submit for temporary residence permit at Migration Department Nicosia
fastTrack.notes: Minimum monthly net income of EUR 3,500 (after taxes/contributions); increased by 20% for a spouse/partner and 15% per child. Residence granted for 1 year, renewable for up to 2 further years. Maximum 500 permits. Family members may reside but cannot work or perform economic activity in Cyprus.

fastTrack.name: Cyprus
fastTrack.program_name: Business Facilitation Unit (BFU) Fast-Track Highly Qualified Employees Scheme
fastTrack.eligibility: Highly skilled third-country nationals employed by companies registered with the Business Facilitation Unit (Companies of Foreign Interests). No labour market test required. Valid until 31 December 2026.
fastTrack.notes: Companies registered with the BFU (Ministry of Energy, Commerce and Industry) can freely employ any number of highly skilled third-country nationals without undergoing a labour market test. Applications processed by the Civil Registry and Migration Department within one month. Companies gain tax and other benefits for staff. Eligible until December 31, 2026.

fastTrack.name: Cyprus
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals (non-EU/EEA) with a third-level education qualification or equivalent professional experience, holding a valid work contract in Cyprus in eligible sectors (ICT, pharmaceuticals for research purposes, shipping excluding captains/crew). Minimum gross annual salary EUR 43,632.
fastTrack.processing_time: Applications accepted from July 7, 2025; standard processing timeframe not specified on official page
fastTrack.notes: Launched July 7, 2025. Minimum gross annual salary set at EUR 43,632. No maximum quota. Eligible sectors per Ministerial Decree: ICT, pharmaceuticals (for research purposes only), shipping (excluding ship captains and crew). Provides EU-wide intra-EU mobility rights (excluding Denmark and Ireland). Family reunification permits equal in duration to Blue Card. Enables accumulation of periods of residence across member states for EU long-term resident status. Application form MBCEU1 available on the Migration Department website.

fastTrack.name: Cyprus
fastTrack.program_name: Fast-Track Naturalisation for Highly Skilled Employees
fastTrack.eligibility: Highly skilled foreign employees of Companies of Foreign Interests (registered with BFU) with legal residence in Cyprus. Must meet amended Civil Registry Law criteria.
fastTrack.processing_time: Maximum 8 months (via fast-track channel with EUR 5,000 fee)
fastTrack.notes: Amendments gazetted December 19, 2023, reduced the previous 7-year standard residency requirement to 3-4 years for highly skilled workers of designated companies. Fast-track naturalisation capped at 8 months processing with a EUR 5,000 fee. Access via the Civil Registry and Migration Department.

fastTrack.name: Czechia
fastTrack.eligibility: Highly qualified IT and marketing professionals. Two categories: (1) employees of a foreign company working remotely in Czechia who remain employed abroad; (2) freelancers holding Czech business license in IT or marketing. Available to nationals of: Australia, Brazil, India, Israel, Japan, Canada, South Korea, Mexico, New Zealand, Singapore, UK, USA, and Taiwan. Applicants must not have held a valid Czech long-term visa or residence permit within the preceding year.
fastTrack.notes: Established by Czech Government Decree No. 475 of June 28, 2023. Confirmed active as of July 2025 per MPO website. Administered by Ministry of Industry and Trade (digitalnomad@mpo.gov.cz). Family members (spouse, registered partner, children) may apply simultaneously. Inclusion valid for maximum 1 year. No legal entitlement to participation. Long-term visa or residence permit issued after approval.

fastTrack.name: Czechia
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals in positions classified as CZ-ISCO main classes 1-3 (managerial, professional, technical). Employer must have operated in Czech Republic for at least 2 years, settled financial obligations, and employ minimum 3 people. Salary must meet average income for relevant CZ-ISCO sub-group or Blue Card minimum. Sectors: manufacturing, services, public sector (excluding medical).
fastTrack.notes: Administered by Ministry of Industry and Trade (vysocekvalifikovani@mpo.gov.cz) or Ministry of Health for healthcare (programzdravotnictvi@mzcr.cz). Inclusion valid for 1 year. Enables priority employee card application at Czech embassies/consulates abroad. Family members included. No legal entitlement to participation. Contact for investors: afc-visa@czechinvest.gov.cz.

fastTrack.name: Czechia
fastTrack.eligibility: Statutory representatives, managers and key specialists of significant Czech and foreign investors, research organisations, technological companies and start-ups. Employees in intra-corporate transfer (managerial/specialist) or newly hired in CZ-ISCO classes 1-3. Workers from all third countries.
fastTrack.notes: Administered by Ministry of Industry and Trade. Programme modified June 1, 2026 - expanded provisions for Ukrainian citizens with specific residency and documentation requirements. Contact: klicovypersonal@mpo.gov.cz (investors), programklicovy@czechinvest.org (research/tech/start-ups). Inclusion valid for 1 year; subsequent additions require only application form and salary declaration. Benefits include 30-day visa processing, priority submission at Czech embassies abroad, family member inclusion, and simplified documentation.

fastTrack.name: Czechia
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals with completed higher vocational or university education of at least 3 years. Must work in a position requiring high qualifications (CZ-ISCO 1-3) with a work contract of at least 1 year. Salary must be at least 1.5 times the average gross salary in the Czech Republic.
fastTrack.notes: Long-term residence permit enabling third-country citizens to stay and work in Czechia for more than 3 months in a highly qualified position. Administered by Ministry of the Interior. Also documented at ipc.gov.cz and mv.gov.cz.

fastTrack.name: Denmark
fastTrack.eligibility: Must be employed by a SIRI-certified company; job must meet salary and standards of one of five tracks (Pay Limit, Supplementary Pay Limit, Short-Term, Researcher, Educational)
fastTrack.processing_time: 1 month standard; up to 3 months for supplementary track with additional info required
fastTrack.notes: Five tracks: (1) Pay Limit - DKK 552,000/year minimum salary (2026 confirmed); (2) Supplementary Pay Limit - DKK 446,000/year minimum (2026 confirmed); (3) Short-Term - max 90 days in 365-day rolling period; (4) Researcher - must have specific research-related tie to the individual; (5) Educational - for highly qualified training. Processing fee DKK 6,810 (2026 rate confirmed). Employer must be SIRI-certified. Updated income statistics applicable from 1 April 2026 per SIRI notice.

fastTrack.name: Denmark
fastTrack.program_name: Positive List for People with Higher Education
fastTrack.eligibility: Must have job offer in a profession on the official Positive List (updated 1 January and 1 July each year); salary and employment terms must meet Danish standards
fastTrack.notes: Updated twice yearly (1 January and 1 July). As of 1 January 2026, the Positive List for Higher Education includes 183 job titles; the Positive List for Skilled Work includes 57 job titles. Processing fee DKK 6,810. No employer certification required (unlike Fast-Track). Managed by SIRI.

fastTrack.name: Denmark
fastTrack.eligibility: Must have job offer in a skilled profession on the official Positive List; salary must correspond to Danish professional standards; employer must meet apprenticeship obligations
fastTrack.notes: Updated twice yearly (1 January and 1 July). As of 1 January 2026, includes 57 skilled job titles experiencing labor shortages. Employer must demonstrate meeting apprenticeship targets. Salary paid to Danish bank account required. Processing fee DKK 6,810.

fastTrack.name: Denmark
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign entrepreneur with innovative business idea approved by Danish Business Authority expert panel; must be full or partial owner and actively participate in management; teams of up to 3 people may apply together
fastTrack.notes: Maximum 75 permits per year. Business cannot be routine trade (restaurant, retail, import/export without innovation). Must demonstrate sufficient funds for first year (DKK 153,240 at 2025 level for single person without family). Initial permit valid up to 2 years; renewable for up to 3 years at a time. Processing fee DKK 3,060 (subject to annual update per SIRI fee notice January 2026).

fastTrack.name: Dominican Republic
fastTrack.eligibility: Management or technical staff of a foreign company operating in the Dominican Republic
fastTrack.notes: Temporary residence for management staff and/or foreign technicians of investment companies. Permit valid for 1 year, renewable. Source: migracion.gob.do.

fastTrack.name: Ecuador
fastTrack.program_name: Temporary Residence Visa for Remote Work (Visa Nómada / Rentista para Trabajo Remoto)
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals working remotely for employers or clients domiciled abroad; own a company or work for foreign legal or natural persons in a remote, digital, or telework capacity. Citizens of approximately 183 countries eligible. Income requirement: minimum 3 times the Unified Basic Salary (SBU) per month (~USD 1,446/month in 2026). Valid health insurance covering Ecuador required.
fastTrack.processing_time: Standard online application through eVISAS portal; typical processing within weeks; official page does not specify exact processing time
fastTrack.notes: Official visa category is 'Visa de Residencia Temporal Rentista para Trabajo Remoto' (Digital Nomad Visa). Duration: 2 years, renewable for additional 2 years. Application fee: USD 50; grant fee: USD 400. No Ecuador income tax on income earned abroad. Additional USD 250/month income required per accompanying dependent. Applications via online eVISAS portal at serviciosdigitales.cancilleria.gob.ec.

fastTrack.name: Ecuador
fastTrack.program_name: Temporary Residence Visa for Professional Services / Autonomous Work
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign professionals providing independent services, consulting, or professional activities in Ecuador. Requires work authorization from the Ministry of Labor or relevant authority.
fastTrack.processing_time: Not specified in official sources reviewed
fastTrack.notes: Category available under the LOMH framework for independent professionals. Specific income/qualification thresholds reference official ministerial requirements.

fastTrack.name: El Salvador
fastTrack.program_name: Special Entry Permit (Permiso Especial de Ingreso – PEI)
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals who require a visa to enter El Salvador but cannot obtain one through normal consular channels (no Salvadoran embassy in country of residence, force majeure, or other unforeseen circumstances)
fastTrack.processing_time: Not specified on official page; notification of approval/denial by email
fastTrack.notes: Applied online at https://elsalvadorpei.migracion.gob.sv/. Fee: USD 100. Applicant creates an account, completes the form, uploads required documents, and pays online. Approval, conditional approval, denial, or cancellation is communicated by email. Contact: +503 7070-0663 / atencion.usuarios@migracion.gob.sv. Service page published November 14, 2023.

fastTrack.name: Estonia
fastTrack.program_name: Digital Nomad Visa (D-Visa for Remote Workers)
fastTrack.eligibility: Remote workers employed by companies registered outside Estonia, owners of companies registered abroad, or freelancers working primarily for foreign clients. Minimum monthly net income of EUR 4,500 (EUR 150/day benchmark). Must be able to work independently and remotely.
fastTrack.notes: Long-stay D-Visa allowing remote workers to stay in Estonia for up to 1 year (365 days in 12 consecutive months). Application submitted at nearest Estonian Embassy. State fee EUR 120. A short-stay C-visa option covers up to 90 days. Distinct from e-Residency (which provides digital identity without physical stay rights). For full visa rules also see: https://vm.ee

fastTrack.name: Estonia
fastTrack.program_name: EU Blue Card (Highly Qualified Worker Residence Permit)
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU/EEA nationals with a university/college diploma (3+ years programme) or 5 years of equivalent professional experience. Must have a valid employment contract with an Estonian employer paying at least 1.5x the average gross monthly salary (or 1.24x for shortage occupations). Employer must obtain permission from Estonian Unemployment Insurance Fund.
fastTrack.processing_time: Up to 90 days for decision; residence permit card issued within 30 days after approval
fastTrack.notes: Issued for duration of employment contract plus 3 months, maximum 27 months initially. Renewable for up to 4 years and 3 months per cycle. Excludes immigration quota for ICT sector and start-up employees. A2 Estonian language proficiency required after 5 years.

fastTrack.name: Estonia
fastTrack.eligibility: Open to entrepreneurs worldwide. Does not grant physical residency rights in Estonia.
fastTrack.processing_time: Variable; card activated within 24 hours of pickup
fastTrack.notes: Estonia's government-issued digital identity for global entrepreneurs. Provides remote access to Estonia's e-services and the ability to start and manage an EU company 100% online. Does NOT confer physical residency, citizenship, or the right to live in Estonia. Over 110,000 e-residents as of programme data. Launched 2014.

fastTrack.name: Finland
fastTrack.eligibility: Coming to Finland for expert duties requiring special expertise; must have higher education degree or equivalent expertise through work experience; confirmed employment; salary at least EUR 3,937/month (2026); first residence permit only (not extension); must not already be in Finland
fastTrack.notes: Salary threshold confirmed at EUR 3,937/month for 2026 per migri.fi/en/income-requirement. Fringe benefits not counted. Employer must add terms of employment within 2 working days via Enter Finland for Employers. Application fee (online): EUR 530 (first permit). Permit valid up to 2 years.

fastTrack.name: Finland
fastTrack.program_name: Fast Track for EU Blue Card
fastTrack.eligibility: Highly qualified employment; higher education degree (minimum 3 years) or 5 years professional experience at equivalent level; employment contract minimum 6 months; salary at least EUR 3,937/month (2026); first residence permit only
fastTrack.notes: EU Blue Card valid maximum 2 years (or duration of employment + 3 months, whichever shorter). Salary threshold confirmed at EUR 3,937/month for 2026 per migri.fi (same threshold as Specialist). No labour market test required. Application fee online: EUR 380 (per EC immigration portal). D visa can be applied simultaneously for immediate travel.

fastTrack.name: Finland
fastTrack.eligibility: Founder or co-founder of growth-oriented startup; must have positive Eligibility Statement from Business Finland (valid max 4 months at time of application); first residence permit only; cannot be in Finland already
fastTrack.notes: Fast track not possible if identity not proven within 5 working days, if further information is needed, or if requirements are not met. Business Finland eligibility statement processing ~1 month average. Permit valid 2 years.

fastTrack.name: Finland
fastTrack.program_name: Fast Track for Specialist and Manager (ICT)
fastTrack.eligibility: Intra-corporate transferees (specialists and managers within a multinational company); confirmed assignment in Finland
fastTrack.notes: Part of Finland's fast track service for work-based residence permits. First permit only.

fastTrack.name: France
fastTrack.program_name: Talent Passport - Qualified Employee (Passeport Talent - Salarie qualifie)
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU/EEA/Swiss nationals with a Master's degree (or equivalent) and employment contract in France with annual gross salary of at least EUR 39,582 (as of August 2025). Also covers employees of innovative companies (JEI) and intra-company transferees with 3 months seniority.
fastTrack.processing_time: 4 months (implicit refusal if no response within 4 months)
fastTrack.notes: Multi-year residence card valid up to 4 years. No separate work authorization required. Family members (spouse and children) eligible for 'Passeport Talent Famille' permit. Administrative cost: EUR 350 (EUR 300 tax + EUR 50 stamp duty). Applications submitted fully online via administration-etrangers-en-france.interieur.gouv.fr.

fastTrack.name: France
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU nationals with at least 3 years of higher education and employment contract with annual gross salary of at least EUR 59,373.
fastTrack.processing_time: 30 days for EU Blue Card holders from other EU states; 4 months for new applicants
fastTrack.notes: EU Blue Card category within the Talent Passport framework. Higher salary threshold than standard qualified employee category. Valid up to 4 years.

fastTrack.name: France
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU nationals with a Master's degree plus a hosting agreement with a French research institution. Minimum resources: EUR 2,200/month.
fastTrack.notes: Faster processing (60 days) compared to other Talent Passport categories. Valid for the duration of the hosting agreement up to 4 years.

fastTrack.name: France
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU/EEA/Swiss nationals developing an innovative project in France, recognized as innovative by a public organization (DRIEETS). Minimum financial resources equivalent to minimum wage (SMIC). Must be selected by a partner incubator/accelerator for the expedited French Tech Visa pathway.
fastTrack.processing_time: Not specified; standard Talent Passport timelines apply
fastTrack.notes: Issues 'Talent - Innovative Project' residence permit valid up to 4 years. Family eligible for accompanying status with work rights. After 5 years of regular residence, eligible for permanent residence. From 1 January 2026, B2 French language level required for naturalization.

fastTrack.name: France
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU nationals recruited by innovative startups in France recognized by the Ministry of Economy and Finance. Annual gross salary at least EUR 39,582 (as of August 2025).
fastTrack.processing_time: Not specified; standard Talent Passport timelines apply
fastTrack.notes: Fast-track within the Talent Passport framework specifically for innovative company employees. Issues 'Talent' residence permit valid up to 4 years. Family eligible.

fastTrack.name: France
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU medical or pharmacy professionals with a license to practice in France. Annual salary at least EUR 41,386.48.
fastTrack.notes: Part of the Talent Passport framework. Valid up to 4 years.

fastTrack.name: France
fastTrack.program_name: Talent Passport - Person of International Renown
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU nationals with established national or international renown in their field. Minimum resources: EUR 22,404.20.
fastTrack.notes: Part of the Talent Passport framework. Valid up to 4 years. No minimum salary threshold, but proof of reputation required.

fastTrack.name: Georgia
fastTrack.eligibility: Citizens of visa-free countries (approximately 96 nationalities) who are remote workers, freelancers, full-time employees, or business owners working for foreign employers. Minimum income USD 2,000/month or USD 24,000 in savings required. Health insurance required.
fastTrack.notes: Program was launched in 2020 during COVID-19. Allows visa-free nationals to formalize a 360-day stay in Georgia as a remote worker. As of June 2025, Georgia passed amendments requiring mandatory work permits for foreign nationals (including remote workers) starting March 1, 2026, which may affect the program's status. Official program page appears to have been removed from active government portals; geoconsul.gov.ge/en/news/16 referenced but content not directly accessible. Current status uncertain as of June 2026.

fastTrack.name: Germany
fastTrack.eligibility: University degree holders or third-country nationals with specific professional experience; employment contract or binding job offer for at least 6 months; minimum gross annual salary of EUR 50,700 (general occupations) or EUR 45,934.20 for shortage occupations (STEM, IT, medicine, engineers, scientists, teachers, physicians, IT specialists with 3+ years experience). Shortage occupations have reduced salary thresholds.
fastTrack.processing_time: Varies; initial residence permit issued for 4 years (or duration of contract plus 3 months if shorter)
fastTrack.notes: Settlement permit (permanent residence) accessible after 27 months of employment with pension contributions; reduced to 21 months with B1-level German language proficiency. Spouses granted immediate, unlimited work permission without German language requirement for family reunification.
