Salary thresholds verified June 2026: EUR 50,700 general / EUR 45,934.20 shortage occupations.

fastTrack.name: Germany
fastTrack.program_name: Fast-Track Procedure for Skilled Workers (Section 81a AufenthG)
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country skilled workers sponsored by a German employer. Employer initiates process at the local immigration authority (Auslaenderbehorde), signs cooperation agreement, and pays fee. Employer-held power of attorney enables faster processing of recognition, employment approval, and visa issuance.
fastTrack.processing_time: Accelerated compared to standard procedure; minimum 4 weeks indicated for visa stage
fastTrack.notes: Fee of EUR 411 charged to employer. Based on Section 81a of the Residence Act. Covers recognition of foreign professional qualifications, Federal Employment Agency approval, and visa issuance in an accelerated coordinated procedure. Source domain make-it-in-germany.com is the official German government portal for skilled immigration.

fastTrack.name: Germany
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU nationals who either (1) hold a foreign qualification recognised in Germany, or (2) score at least 6 points in the points system (based on qualifications, work experience, language skills, age, Germany ties). Must demonstrate sufficient financial resources (blocked bank account with min. EUR 1,091 net/month or declaration of commitment). German language knowledge at A1 level required.
fastTrack.notes: Introduced under the new Skilled Immigration Act (Fachkraefteeinwanderungsgesetz). Allows entry to Germany to search for qualified employment without a pre-existing job offer. Initial duration for job search; if a concrete job offer is received but a regular work permit cannot yet be issued, an Opportunity Card extension (up to 2 years) is available providing access to qualified employment.

fastTrack.name: Germany
fastTrack.program_name: Skilled Immigration Act (Fachkraefteeinwanderungsgesetz) - Skilled Worker Residence Permit
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals with a recognized foreign vocational or academic qualification and a concrete employment offer. Expanded under 2023 reform to include experience-based skilled workers (without formal recognition in some cases) and a points-based pathway.
fastTrack.processing_time: Standard procedure; fast-track option available via Section 81a
fastTrack.notes: 2023 Skilled Immigration Act expanded access for skilled workers from non-EU countries. Path to settlement permit (permanent residence) after 4 years; reduced to 21-27 months for EU Blue Card holders. Citizenship path reduced to 5 years for particularly integrated individuals under the 2024 citizenship reform.

fastTrack.name: Greece
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU/EEA/Swiss nationals who work remotely for employers or clients based entirely outside Greece. Must demonstrate monthly income of at least €3,500 (net) or €4,200 with a dependent spouse, or €4,830 with additional dependents. Must have comprehensive private health insurance.
fastTrack.processing_time: 2-4 weeks (initial national visa); 1-3 months (residence permit after arrival)
fastTrack.notes: Introduced under Law 4825/2021, updated by Law 5038/2023. Initial visa valid 12 months (Type D). Upon arrival, can apply for a 2-year Digital Nomad Residence Permit renewable every 2 years. Application fee approximately €1,000 (visa) plus €150 per family member. Eligible holders may benefit from a 50% income tax reduction for up to 7 years.

fastTrack.name: Greece
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals with an employment contract in Greece for a qualified position of minimum 1 year, with specialized professional qualifications and salary at least 1.5x the average gross annual remuneration in Greece.
fastTrack.processing_time: Not specified in official source; requires application to Ministry of Migration before national visa expires
fastTrack.notes: EU Blue Card grants 2-year validity (or contract duration plus 3 months, whichever shorter) and was extended to 3 years under 2026 immigration reforms. Minimum salary threshold: 1.5x average gross annual remuneration per Greek Statistics Authority data. After 5 years of continuous legal residence, holders may apply for long-term residence permit. Subject to admission cap.

fastTrack.name: Greece
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals who will work for a registered tech startup in Greece. Salary must be at least 1.6x the national average gross salary. Immediate work authorization granted.
fastTrack.notes: Introduced by immigration reforms effective 6 February 2026. Valid 12 months. Tech Visa holders cannot change employers; immigration status lapses if employment ends. Can be converted to EU Blue Card if standard eligibility requirements are met. Law reference: 2026 immigration reform legislation.

fastTrack.name: Greece
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals with at minimum a Master's degree (or PhD/Postdoc) from institutions ranked on at least two international university ranking lists. No job offer required at entry.
fastTrack.notes: Introduced by immigration reforms effective 6 February 2026. Valid 12 months. Allows entry to Greece to search for employment. Does not grant work authorization initially; upon securing employment, holder can transition to appropriate work and residence permits or EU Blue Card. Law reference: 2026 immigration reform legislation.

fastTrack.name: Grenada
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-nationals (excluding OECS Protocol Member State citizens) who earn at least EC$100,000 per year (approx. USD 37,000) from outside Grenada. Must not work for or offer services to any person or business in Grenada. Applicant must have a valid passport, health insurance, and a clean police certificate.
fastTrack.notes: Established under the Remote Employment Act, Act No. 3 of 2021. Permit is valid for up to 1 year and is renewable annually. Application fee: USD 1,500 (individual); USD 2,000 (individual + up to 3 dependants); USD 200 per additional dependant. Renewal fee: USD 1,400 (individual); USD 1,900 (individual + up to 3 dependants). Permit holders are exempt from Grenada income tax on income earned outside Grenada. Conditional duty exemptions apply to household effects (up to EC$75,000 c.i.f.) and one motor vehicle. Dependants cannot enrol in public educational institutions. Permit holders are deemed non-residents for citizenship and voting purposes. Income requirement and fee structure confirmed consistent with 2025 sources.

fastTrack.name: Guatemala
fastTrack.program_name: Temporary Residency for Intellectuals, Researchers, and Scientists (Residencia Temporal para Intelectuales, Investigadores y Científicos)
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals with documented qualifications to practice as intellectuals, researchers, or scientists under Article 75(e) of the Migration Code (Código de Migración, Decreto 44-2016)
fastTrack.processing_time: Not specified in official regulation; standard IGM processing applies
fastTrack.notes: Article 19 of Reglamento de Residencias Guatemaltecas (Acuerdo IGM-016-2025). Requirements: documentation certifying qualifications as intellectual, researcher, or scientist; updated Guatemalan guarantor certification; valid contract. Residency is temporary and tied to the contract. Extensions require proof of continued contract. Not a fast-track in the sense of expedited processing, but represents a recognized skilled talent category distinct from general employment.

fastTrack.name: Guyana
fastTrack.eligibility: CARICOM nationals who qualify as skilled workers: university graduates (bachelor's or equivalent including ACCA), musicians and artistes, sports persons, media workers, registered nurses, trained teachers, artisans with Caribbean Vocational Qualifications, associate degree holders. Also covers self-employed and service providers.
fastTrack.notes: Under the CARICOM Single Market and Economy (CSME) / Revised Treaty of Chaguaramas. Qualified CARICOM nationals can move and work in Guyana without a work permit. A Free Movement of Skills Certificate is issued. Fee in Guyana: G$1,500.00. Participating nations: Antigua and Barbuda, Barbados, Belize, Dominica, Grenada, Guyana, Jamaica, St. Lucia, St. Kitts and Nevis, St. Vincent and the Grenadines, Suriname, Trinidad and Tobago. (Bahamas, Montserrat, Haiti excluded.)

fastTrack.name: Hungary
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals with tertiary education or 3+ years relevant professional experience (within past 7 years for ICT/executive roles) working in a position requiring high-level qualifications. Minimum salary: HUF 883,671/month (2025); HUF 1,001,048/month (2026). Healthcare roles: HUF 706,937/month (2025); HUF 800,838/month (2026).
fastTrack.processing_time: 70 days standard; 30 days for existing EU Blue Card holders from other EU member states
fastTrack.notes: Initial validity up to 4 years, renewable for up to 4 years at a time. Employment restrictions apply during first year. 2026 salary thresholds apply retroactively to 2025-initiated applications with 2026 decisions. Healthcare 2026 threshold updated to HUF 800,838.

fastTrack.name: Hungary
fastTrack.program_name: White Card – Residency for Digital Nomads
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals with verified employment relationship or company ownership outside Hungary, working remotely from Hungary using digital technology. Must not pursue any gainful activity in Hungary or hold shares in Hungarian companies. Minimum net monthly income: EUR 3,000 for at least 6 months prior to entry.
fastTrack.notes: Initial validity: maximum 1 year. Extendable once for additional 1 year (total maximum 2 years). White Card holders CANNOT obtain a national residence card (permanent residence). Family reunification is not available for White Card holders (except for children born during the permit's validity). Must have resided in Hungary for at least 90 days within any 180-day period before extension application.

fastTrack.name: Hungary
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals pursuing self-employed activities or serving as chief executive of a business organization. Self-employed must demonstrate annual income exceeding 24 times the current minimum wage (via tax authority certification). Business executives: organization must employ at least 5 Hungarian/EEA nationals full-time for 6 consecutive months, or demonstrate sufficient income.
fastTrack.notes: Initial permit: maximum 1 year. Extendable up to 2 additional years (total maximum 3 years from first issuance). Holders CANNOT obtain a national residence card (permanent residence). Family reunification restricted for first year after issuance.

fastTrack.name: Iceland
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EEA nationals hired by Icelandic employers for specialist/expert roles requiring university-level or technical qualifications. Employer must demonstrate the role is necessary and the applicant is the best fit.
fastTrack.notes: An expedited application for qualified professionals (specialist employees) is processed within 30 days provided all supporting documents have been submitted. The expedited option currently applies only to the main applicant and not to family members. Official program on work.iceland.is, operated by the Directorate of Immigration.

fastTrack.name: Iceland
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EEA nationals who are visa-exempt to enter Schengen and have not received an Icelandic long-term visa in the past 12 months. Must work remotely for a foreign employer or be self-employed abroad. Monthly income must be at least ISK 1,000,000 (ISK 1,300,000 if applying with spouse/partner or dependent children under 18). Must hold valid international health insurance.
fastTrack.processing_time: 3–4 weeks from receipt of complete application
fastTrack.notes: Iceland's Long-Term Visa for Remote Work (application form L-802). Allows up to 180 days in Iceland for remote workers employed by foreign companies or self-employed abroad. Applicants from outside Schengen receive full 180-day validity; applicants already in Schengen may receive up to 90 days. Application fee: ISK 12,200 (~USD 88). Only issued once per 12-month period. Applications submitted by post to Directorate of Immigration, Dalvegur 18, 201 Kópavogur. Not a residence permit - holder cannot obtain an Icelandic ID number. Source corroborated by work.iceland.is (official Promote Iceland / government portal).

fastTrack.name: India
fastTrack.program_name: Fast Track Immigration – Trusted Traveller Programme (FTI-TTP)
fastTrack.eligibility: Indian Nationals and Foreign Nationals holding OCI (Overseas Citizen of India) Card. Minimum age 7 years. Passport valid for at least 6 months. ECR (Emigration Check Required) passport holders are ineligible.
fastTrack.processing_time: Approximately one month after biometric enrollment
fastTrack.notes: Provides expedited immigration clearance at 13 Indian international airports via dedicated e-gates using biometric technology. No enrollment fee (gratis service). Registration valid for 10 years or until passport expiration, whichever is earlier. Airports with e-Gates: Delhi, Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Kolkata, Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Cochin, Lucknow, Amritsar, Calicut, Trivandrum, Trichy. Biometric enrollment available at 31 international airports. Under the Citizenship (Amendment) Rules, 2026, new OCI applicants must sign a biometric consent form to opt into FTI-TTP during OCI registration.

fastTrack.name: Indonesia
fastTrack.program_name: Golden Visa Indonesia - Global Talent Category
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals with globally recognized talent, expertise, or achievement in fields valuable to Indonesia's economy
fastTrack.notes: Part of the Golden Visa framework (E28C). Categories include global talent, personage, repatriation (former Indonesian citizens), and IKN (Nusantara Capital) investor. Specific financial thresholds for talent category were referenced on imigrasi.go.id but not enumerated separately from investment categories on available pages.

fastTrack.name: Indonesia
fastTrack.program_name: E33G Visa Rumah Kedua Pekerja Jarak Jauh (Remote Worker / Digital Nomad Visa)
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals employed by a company established outside Indonesia, with minimum annual income of USD 60,000 and minimum savings/expenses of USD 2,000
fastTrack.notes: 1-year stay, extendable. No local sponsor required. Must not receive compensation from Indonesian entities. Fee: Rp 7,000,000. Apply via evisa.imigrasi.go.id.

fastTrack.name: Ireland
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EEA nationals in occupations on the Critical Skills Occupations List (ICT, engineering, technology, etc.); minimum salary €40,904/year (some roles require €68,911+); minimum 2-year job offer; relevant degree or higher; employer must be registered with Irish Revenue Commissioners.
fastTrack.processing_time: Applications must be submitted at least 12 weeks before employment start date; processed strictly in date order. Current processing dates published at enterprise.gov.ie.
fastTrack.notes: No Labour Market Needs Test required. Permit holders can apply for permission to reside and work without an employment permit after completion. Family reunification available. After 5 years continuous residency, eligible for long-term residence. Pathway to citizenship (naturalisation) opens after 5 years residence. Employment Permits Act 2024 governs current rules.

fastTrack.name: Ireland
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EEA nationals with an innovative business proposal (not retail/catering/personal services); minimum €50,000 funding from personal resources, loan, business angel, venture capital, or Irish state agency grant; additional €30,000 per additional co-founder. Business must have potential to create 10 jobs and €1 million in sales within 3–4 years.
fastTrack.processing_time: Applications considered quarterly by an evaluation committee.
fastTrack.notes: Successful applicants receive 2-year residence permission to reside and work in Ireland full-time in the business. Visa-required nationals receive multiple-entry visa. Programme established in 2012 and continues operating. Guidelines updated September 2023.

fastTrack.name: Ireland
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EEA nationals in occupations not on the exclusions list; subject to Labour Market Needs Test unless exempt.
fastTrack.processing_time: Processed in date order; current processing dates at enterprise.gov.ie.
fastTrack.notes: One of nine permit types under Employment Permits Act 2024. Other types include Intra-Company Transfer, Dependant/Partner/Spouse, Contract for Services, Reactivation, Internship, Sport and Cultural, and Exchange Agreement permits.

fastTrack.name: Israel
fastTrack.program_name: Visas for Foreign High-Tech Experts Incentive Program
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign high-tech experts employed or contracted by Israeli high-tech companies authorized by the Israel Innovation Authority. Expert's salary must be at least double the average wage in Israel.
fastTrack.processing_time: Expedited - work permit can be issued within a few business days for recognized high-tech companies
fastTrack.notes: Launched in 2018 by the Israel Innovation Authority together with the Population and Immigration Authority. Short-term track: up to 90 days through an expedited process. Long-term track: work permit valid up to 1 year, extendable by another year. Maximum stay under long-term working visa for experts: up to 63 months.

fastTrack.name: Israel
fastTrack.program_name: Innovation Visa (B/2 Innovation Visa for Foreign Entrepreneurs)
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign entrepreneurs in the technological field seeking to develop innovative ideas in Israel under the support of the Israel Innovation Authority
fastTrack.notes: Pilot program developed by Israel's Ministry of Economy in collaboration with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Population and Immigration Authority, and the National Authority of Innovation. Grants a B/2 innovation visa for up to 2 years.

fastTrack.name: Italy
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU entrepreneurs residing outside Italy who intend to establish an innovative startup in Italy. Business must meet Italian Startup Act criteria: incorporated within 5 years, registered office in Italy, primary activity in development/production/commercialisation of high-tech products/services, R&D expenditure >= 15% of costs/turnover, team of at least 1/3 with PhD or 2/3 with master's degree.
fastTrack.notes: Fully digital, free, bilingual (Italian/English). Issues a self-employment visa valid 1 year, renewable for 2 years. Related program 'Italia Startup Hub' for non-EU nationals already in Italy with valid permits. Applications via portal italiastartupvisa@mise.gov.it.

fastTrack.name: Italy
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU nationals with a higher education degree (or post-secondary professional qualification with 3+ years of study, or 5+ years professional experience). Must have a binding employment contract of at least 6 months. Annual gross salary must be at least EUR 33,500 (2024 threshold, between 1x and 1.6x average gross annual salary in Italy).
fastTrack.notes: EU Blue Card issued for 2 years (or duration of employment contract + 3 months if shorter). Quota-exempt. Employer must apply at Single Desk for Immigration (Sportello Unico per l'Immigrazione) at the relevant Prefettura. Italy applies a labour market test before issuing nulla osta. Fee: EUR 50 issuance + EUR 30 postal kit + EUR 16 tax stamp + EUR 30.46 issuance cost.

fastTrack.name: Italy
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU highly specialised workers who work remotely. Two categories: (1) Digital Nomads: freelancers/self-employed; (2) Remote Workers: employees of foreign companies working entirely remotely. Must demonstrate minimum annual income of EUR 24,789 (as of 2024, calculated as 3x the Italian minimum annual healthcare exemption threshold). Must have valid health insurance (minimum EUR 30,000 coverage). Must hold university degree or equivalent professional qualification relevant to their field.
fastTrack.notes: Officially introduced by Law 25/2022 (Art. 6-quinquies of Legislative Decree 286/1998) and operationalised by Interministerial Decree of 29 February 2024, published in Official Gazette on 4 April 2024. Not subject to annual immigration quotas (decreto flussi). Initial permit valid 1 year, renewable locally at Questura. Spouse and minor children (under 18) can be sponsored once in Italy. Applications at Italian consulates/embassies abroad.

fastTrack.name: Jamaica
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals offered employment in Jamaica by a Jamaican employer who can demonstrate a genuine need for foreign skills; administered by Ministry of Labour and Social Security
fastTrack.notes: Jamaica's Ministry of Labour and Social Security administers work permits including a Special Skills Work Permit category. Not a standalone fast-track visa but the primary pathway for skilled foreign workers. Source: mlss.gov.jm/departments/work-permit/

fastTrack.name: Japan
fastTrack.eligibility: Graduates (within 5 years) of universities ranked in the top 100 by at least 2 of 3 major rankings (QS, THE, ARWU). As of January 2025, 94 universities qualify. Minimum savings of JPY 200,000 at time of application. Age 18+.
fastTrack.notes: Designated Activities No. 51 (worker), No. 52 (dependent). Allows stay of up to 2 years for job hunting or entrepreneurship preparation in Japan without a pre-arranged job offer. Introduced April 2023 alongside J-Skip. Employment in adult entertainment establishments not permitted. Source: MOFA and Consulate-General of Japan in Denver.

fastTrack.name: Japan
fastTrack.eligibility: Nationals of visa-exempt countries/regions (approximately 70 countries). Must be employed by or provide services to entities/organizations established outside Japan. Annual income of at least JPY 10 million. Must hold sufficient private medical insurance (minimum JPY 10 million per person). Cannot work for Japanese entities.
fastTrack.notes: Launched March 31, 2024. Designated Activities No. 53 for worker, No. 54 for accompanying spouse/child. Maximum stay of 6 months; must wait 6 months before reapplying for the same status. Entry by air or sea (including scheduled ferries Japan–Busan or Japan–Shanghai). Does not permit engagement with Japanese employers or clients. Source: MOFA Japan.

fastTrack.name: Japan
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals supported by designated Japanese municipalities for starting a business in Japan. Spouse and children of the entrepreneur are also eligible.
fastTrack.notes: Visa applicant must conform to the conditions provided by Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry Order. Application requires Certificate of Eligibility (COE). Allows foreign entrepreneurs to reside in Japan to prepare for business start-up with support from a designated municipality. Source: MOFA Japan.

fastTrack.name: Japan
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals with specific industry skills and knowledge. Covers 14 specified industry sectors. Must pass skills and Japanese language tests (SSW1) or have Technical Intern Training experience. SSW2 available in select sectors.
fastTrack.notes: Specified Skilled Worker No. 1 (SSW1): up to 5 years, no family accompaniment in most sectors. Specified Skilled Worker No. 2 (SSW2): indefinitely renewable, family accompaniment permitted, path to permanent residence. Source: MOFA Japan.

fastTrack.name: Kazakhstan
fastTrack.program_name: Digital Nomad Residency (IT Professional Permanent Residence - B9-1)
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign IT professionals (software development, cybersecurity, UI/UX, DevOps, and related fields) who obtain a petition from the Ministry of Digital Development / Astana Hub confirming qualification; requires IIN and digital signature (EDS) from a Kazakhstan embassy prior to applying
fastTrack.notes: Pilot project launched March 2025. Grants permanent residence permit (duration not explicitly stated on official page). Most of the application process is remote; applicant must buy or rent property in Kazakhstan and provide a medical certificate at final stages. Application processed via eGov.kz after obtaining petition from Ministry of Digital Development / Astana Hub.

fastTrack.name: Kazakhstan
fastTrack.eligibility: Digital professionals and entrepreneurs working remotely for foreign employers; minimum stable monthly income of USD 3,000; requires tax declarations, criminal record clearance, health insurance
fastTrack.notes: Multiple-entry visa valid for up to 1 year; extendable for an additional year from within Kazakhstan. Introduced 2025 by Ministry of Foreign Affairs together with other talent visa categories.

fastTrack.name: Kazakhstan
fastTrack.program_name: Permanent Residence Visa for Skilled Professionals (B9)
fastTrack.eligibility: Highly skilled professionals in in-demand fields: medicine, science, education, innovation, and creative arts
fastTrack.notes: Grants a permanent residence permit (up to 10 years). Introduced 2025 as part of Kazakhstan's talent attraction initiative.

fastTrack.name: Kenya
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals who work remotely within Kenya for a company registered outside Kenya: under employment contract, as shareholder or business representative of a foreign company, or self-employed serving clients outside Kenya. Must provide bank statements or payslips for last 3 months proving income.
fastTrack.notes: Permit issued for 1 or 2 years, renewable. Processing fee: USD 200 (non-refundable); Issuance fee: USD 1,000 per year. Applications accepted from April 2025 per official eFNS portal. Apply via https://fns.immigration.go.ke.

fastTrack.name: Kuwait
fastTrack.eligibility: Skilled foreign professionals, consultants, and small-scale entrepreneurs seeking to work in Kuwait without a traditional kafala employer sponsor. Specific profession lists and income thresholds pending final regulations as of June 2026.
fastTrack.processing_time: Not yet officially specified; program announced February 2026 with rollout expected within approximately 2 months of announcement; official regulations had not been published as of June 2026.
fastTrack.notes: Announced by Sheikh Fahad Al-Yousef Al-Sabah, First Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Interior, on 17 February 2026. Annual fee of KD 750–1,000. Marks a shift away from the kafala (employer-sponsor) residency model. Full eligibility criteria, documentation requirements, and family sponsorship rules had not been published as of June 2026. Nationals of Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Iran, Iraq, Pakistan, and Yemen were flagged as excluded from e-visa-based routes generally; applicability to this permit pending confirmation.

fastTrack.name: Kyrgyzstan
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals working remotely in ICT, software development, data and web services, AI and robotics, media and digital arts, gaming, e-sports, and related fields. Must provide proof of remote contracts and evidence of income. Citizens of eligible nations (both visa-exempt CIS/EAEU members and visa-required nationals may apply).
fastTrack.notes: Status established by Presidential amendments to the Law on External Labor Migration (October 9, 2024); permanent procedure codified by Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 241 of April 30, 2025 (in force 15 days after official publication). Initial grant for up to 1 year, renewable annually. DN status holders exempt from compulsory residence registration for up to 60 days; no Kyrgyz work permit required while status is valid. Processing time confirmed at 5 working days per the official evisa.e-gov.kg portal (prior record stated 7 business days - corrected to 5 working days per official source).

fastTrack.name: Latvia
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals with a higher education qualification and an employment contract in Latvia. Standard salary threshold: EUR 1,916/month; reduced threshold EUR 1,532/month for professions in short supply under Cabinet Regulation No. 108.
fastTrack.processing_time: 10 working days (standard fee EUR 100) or 4 working days (expedited fee EUR 200)
fastTrack.notes: Valid for up to 5 years. Holders retain Blue Card status if unemployed for no more than 3 consecutive months. Favorable long-term residence conditions after 5 years of Blue Card holding across EU. State fee: EUR 100 for 10-working-day review or EUR 200 for 4-working-day review. Official page last updated April 22, 2022; processing times and fees confirmed from earlier source checks.

fastTrack.name: Latvia
fastTrack.program_name: Long-Stay Visa for Remote Work (Digital Nomad Visa)
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals employed by an OECD-registered employer or self-employed in an OECD country, able to work remotely. Minimum monthly gross salary/income of EUR 4,213 (2.5x average monthly gross wage). Health insurance minimum EUR 42,600 liability coverage required. Minimum 6 months employment with current employer (for employees).
fastTrack.notes: Visa issued for 1 year. No right to local employment in Latvia. Page confirmed updated 11 February 2026 on official pmlp.gov.lv. Income threshold and insurance amounts confirmed via live fetch.

fastTrack.name: Latvia
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals intending to create or develop innovative products in Latvia. Must submit a descriptive application about the innovative product and a 3-year business plan. Subsistence requirement: EUR 500/month.
fastTrack.notes: Grants temporary residence permit for startup activity. PMLP has produced an official video guide for the application process. No minimum investment amount specified for this category.

fastTrack.name: Liechtenstein
fastTrack.program_name: Short-term Residence Permit (L) for Qualified Specialists - Non-EEA Nationals
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EEA and non-Swiss nationals who are managers, specialists, or other qualified employees who have completed an apprenticeship or have many years of professional experience. Must be sponsored by a Liechtenstein company.
fastTrack.notes: L permit allows residence for a maximum of 12 months, extendable once for up to 6 months upon proof of extraordinary need. Application is made by the Liechtenstein employer through the Migration and Passport Office (APA). No dedicated digital nomad, startup, or fast-track talent visa found on official llv.li sources.

fastTrack.name: Lithuania
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU/EEA nationals who are founders or key personnel of an innovative startup. Must obtain confirmation from the Lithuanian Innovation Agency (Inovacijų agentūra) that the startup activity is innovative and involves new technologies or significant innovations for Lithuania's economic/social development. Applicant must have necessary qualifications, funding, and a business plan.
fastTrack.processing_time: Application via MIGRIS; within 4 months must personally submit petition with biometric data and original documents.
fastTrack.notes: Permit issued for 2 years initially. Renewable for up to 3 additional years upon confirmation from the Innovation Agency. Applicant must establish the enterprise and commence activities specified in founding documents within 120 days of permit issuance.

fastTrack.name: Lithuania
fastTrack.eligibility: Higher education diploma OR at least 5 years of equivalent professional experience (for ICT: at least 3 years of relevant professional experience in the last 7 years). Must have a job offer from a Lithuanian employer for at least 6 months. Salary must be at least 1.5x average monthly gross wage (for high-value-added/shortage occupations: 1.2x average monthly gross wage).
fastTrack.notes: Permit duration: 36 months or duration of employment contract plus 3 months (whichever is shorter). Fee: EUR 160 initial/renewal; EUR 320 expedited. After 18 months in Lithuania on EU Blue Card, may apply for EU Blue Card in another member state. Path to permanent residence: 5 years of continuous residence.

fastTrack.name: Luxembourg
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals with a valid employment contract of at least 6 months for highly qualified work in Luxembourg, with an annual gross salary of at least EUR 65,652 (set by Grand-Ducal regulation), and documented high professional qualifications or proof of meeting requirements for the relevant regulated/non-regulated profession.
fastTrack.processing_time: Maximum 3 months for temporary authorization to stay from the Ministry of Home Affairs; residence permit application must be submitted within 3 months of arrival.
fastTrack.notes: Permit valid for 4 years (or duration of employment contract plus 3 months if shorter). Not subject to mandatory labour market testing (faster than standard worker permits). Path to long-term residence after 5 years of regular EU residence as an EU Blue Card holder, with the last 2 years in Luxembourg. Salary threshold: EUR 65,652 gross annual (confirmed via guichet.public.lu re-fetch June 2026, page last updated March 3 2026). Note: the new EU Blue Card Directive was transposed by Luxembourg via Act of June 4 2024 (announced July 2024); the directive links the threshold to the average gross annual salary (set by Grand-Ducal regulation), which currently equals EUR 65,652. Other changes under the 2024 transposition: minimum employment contract reduced from 12 to 6 months; unrestricted labour market access after 12 months (previously 2 years); enhanced EU mobility rights.

fastTrack.name: Malawi
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals taking up specified employment in Malawi
fastTrack.notes: Permit issued before entering Malawi for the purpose of taking up specified employment. Applied online via epermit.gov.mw. No fast-track or talent-specific criteria published on the official site.

fastTrack.name: Malawi
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals working on development activities in Malawi from sponsors (country/agency)
fastTrack.notes: Allows foreign nationals working on development activities in Malawi from sponsors (country/agency). Applied online via epermit.gov.mw.

fastTrack.name: Malaysia
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals (all nationalities except Israel) aged 18+. Tech Talent/Profession: minimum USD 24,000 annual income from non-Malaysian sources. Non-Tech Talent/Profession: minimum USD 60,000 annual income from non-Malaysian sources. Must have active contract of 3+ months duration with foreign/non-Malaysian employer.
fastTrack.processing_time: Not specified on official MDEC page
fastTrack.notes: Issued as a Professional Visit Pass (Pas Lawatan Ikhtisas). Duration: 3–12 months initial stay, renewable for up to additional 12 months (max 24 months total). Fee: MYR 1,000 for main applicant, MYR 500 per dependent. Programme operated by Malaysia Digital Economy Corporation (MDEC).

fastTrack.name: Malaysia
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals employed by Malaysian companies for skilled/professional positions. Applications through Xpats Gateway (MDEC-registered companies) or ESD.
fastTrack.notes: Categories I, II, and III based on salary level. Managed through Expatriate Services Division (ESD). Fee: MYR 800 + 6% SST = MYR 848 for Employment Pass. Salary thresholds revised effective June 2026. Succession plan mandate introduced June 2026.

fastTrack.name: Malaysia
fastTrack.eligibility: Highly-skilled foreign professionals meeting talent criteria set by Immigration Department.
fastTrack.notes: Long-term residence pass for talent. Listed on imi.gov.my main services/pass page. Specific eligibility and financial criteria not fully detailed on pages accessible during research.

fastTrack.name: Malta
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU nationals with offer for a managerial or highly technical position, OR startup roles endorsed by Malta Enterprise. Minimum annual gross salary: €45,000. Must provide certified qualifications, warrants or proof of work experience. Employer must advertise the role for at least 2 weeks within 2 months prior to application.
fastTrack.processing_time: 5 working days from complete application submission
fastTrack.notes: Initial permit valid 1 year; renewable up to 3 years. Fee: €600 first application, €150/year renewal. Managed by Identità (formerly Identity Malta).

fastTrack.name: Malta
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU nationals not meeting KEI criteria. Minimum annual gross salary: €30,000. Requires MQF Level 6+ qualification OR lower-level qualification plus 3+ years relevant experience (proven via contracts/references).
fastTrack.processing_time: Not specified (standard Single Permit process applies)
fastTrack.notes: Regulated by Identità.

fastTrack.name: Malta
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU nationals with advanced professional qualifications and high-salary job offers in EU countries including Malta.
fastTrack.notes: Issued under EU Blue Card Directive. Managed by Identità.

fastTrack.name: Malta
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU, non-EEA, non-Swiss startup founders, co-founders, and core employees. Startup must be registered no longer than 7 years globally. Must engage in eligible sectors (manufacturing, software, health/biotech, eco, other innovative activities). Minimum paid-up share capital of €25,000 (plus €10,000 per additional co-founder beyond 4, max 6 co-founders). Core employees must earn at least €30,000 gross annually. Business plan must be approved by Malta Enterprise.
fastTrack.notes: Founders/co-founders receive a 3-year permit renewable for 5 further years. Core employees receive a 3-year permit renewable for 3 further years. Application fee: €750/adult applicant for 3-year permit + €300 residence card issuance fee + €690 Jobsplus employment licence. Ineligible: nationals/close ties to Afghanistan, North Korea, Iran, DRC, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan, Yemen, Venezuela. Jointly administered by Residency Malta Agency and Malta Enterprise.

fastTrack.name: Mauritius
fastTrack.eligibility: Nationals from 180+ countries including the US, UK, Canada, Australia, France, Germany, Japan, Singapore, UAE and most European nations. Applicant must not enter the Mauritius labour market; main place of business and source of income must be outside Mauritius; must have proof of long stay plans and sufficient travel and health insurance.
fastTrack.processing_time: Online application; visa issued by email after review
fastTrack.notes: Valid for a period exceeding 6 months up to 1 year, renewable. For stays over 180 days in a calendar year. Free of charge (no processing fee). Citizens from countries not on the eligible list may apply online during a tourist visa stay. Administered by EDB Mauritius. No specific minimum income requirement stated. CORRECTION: Prior record stated 'approximately 130 countries'; updated to 180+ per official EDB page verified June 2026.

fastTrack.name: Mexico
fastTrack.program_name: Temporary Resident Visa (Remote Worker / Digital Nomad pathway)
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals with income from sources outside Mexico. Must demonstrate: monthly income of at least approximately $3,737.95 USD for the past 6 months OR savings of approximately $73,257.65 USD for the past 12 months (amounts derived from UMA-based thresholds reported by official consulates). Must apply at a Mexican consulate abroad before entering Mexico.
fastTrack.processing_time: Same day to 10 business days at consulate
fastTrack.notes: Mexico has no separately named 'digital nomad visa'. Remote workers use the standard Temporary Resident Visa (Residente Temporal). Income must come from outside Mexico. No minimum physical presence requirement. Renewable annually up to 4 years total. After 4 years can apply for Permanent Residency.

fastTrack.name: Moldova
fastTrack.program_name: Digital Nomad Visa (Remote Work Residence Permit)
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals working remotely for foreign companies (employees, independent contractors, or shareholders/partners of foreign companies). Minimum income: 18 forecasted average salaries of Moldova per year for the preceding 6 months (approximately 3x national average monthly salary per month; estimated ~€2,700–2,800/month for 2026). Valid health insurance and proof of accommodation required.
fastTrack.notes: Introduced via Law 144/2025, entered into force 20 September 2025. Administered by General Inspectorate for Migration (IGM) under Ministry of Internal Affairs. Duration: up to 2 years (initial period up to 2 years, renewable following the same procedure). Government fee governed by Law on state fees no. 213 of 31.07.2023. Applications: in person at IGM Chisinau or via representative. Income must derive exclusively from remote work for foreign entities.

fastTrack.name: Moldova
fastTrack.eligibility: Technology specialists intending to carry out IT activities in Moldova.
fastTrack.processing_time: Standard consular processing (not specified in days on official source)
fastTrack.notes: Long-stay Type D visa subtype for IT specialists. Allows entry and stay up to 90 days, after which temporary residence permit may be required.

fastTrack.name: Mongolia
fastTrack.program_name: K7 Work and Holiday Visa (for Australian nationals)
fastTrack.eligibility: Australian citizens only; issued electronically via e-visa system
fastTrack.notes: Special work and holiday visa category (K7) available electronically to Australian nationals under bilateral arrangement, as part of Mongolia's e-visa expansion per Government Resolution No. 107 of 2024.

fastTrack.name: Montenegro
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreigners employed or working electronically for a foreign company, or own a company not registered in Montenegro. Must provide: proof of financial means (income of at least 3x Montenegro minimum wage, approximately EUR 1,800–2,400/month), accommodation, health insurance covering Montenegro, valid travel document (3+ months beyond permit period), no criminal conviction exceeding 6 months imprisonment.
fastTrack.processing_time: Within 40 days from submission of complete application
fastTrack.notes: Permit duration: initial up to 2 years; first extension: up to 2 additional years; new permit may be requested 6 months after expiration. Family reunification: close family members (spouses, minor children under 18) may join permit holders. Application submitted in person at the Ministry of Interior office in applicant's municipality of residence. Programme announced under 'Programme for Attracting Digital Nomads in Montenegro until 2025 with Action Plan for 2022' extended through 2026. Long-stay Type D visa category covers digital nomads. Official portal: digitalnomads.gov.me.

fastTrack.name: Namibia
fastTrack.notes: Introduced October 2022. Allows remote workers, freelancers, and self-employed professionals to live and work remotely in Namibia for 6 months (non-renewable; must wait 12 months before reapplying). Income requirement: min USD 2,000/month for applicant; USD 1,000/month for accompanying spouse; USD 500/month per child. Fee: NAD 3,300 payable upon approval. Cannot seek or take up local employment. Administered by NIPDB; applications via the Ministry of Home Affairs portal.

fastTrack.name: Nepal
fastTrack.program_name: Digital Nomad Visa (Announced, not yet launched)
fastTrack.eligibility: Remote workers earning at least USD 1,500/month or holding USD 20,000 in savings, with health insurance of USD 100,000 valid in Nepal
fastTrack.processing_time: Not yet officially launched as of June 2026
fastTrack.notes: Nepal announced plans to introduce a 5-year multiple-entry digital nomad visa as part of its Economic Reform Implementing Work Plan (May 2025). The visa is intended to allow remote workers to live and work in Nepal for up to one year initially, renewable annually. As of June 2026, no official launch page exists on immigration.gov.np or any official government domain; the program is NOT yet in effect. Not counted as an active fast-track program.

fastTrack.name: Netherlands
fastTrack.eligibility: Must have employment contract with an IND-recognised sponsor; salary must meet minimum thresholds (gross per month, valid from 1 January 2026): reduced criterion €3,122/month (for recent graduates/researchers, within 3 years of graduation/permit expiry); under 30 years old €4,357/month; 30 years or older €5,942/month. Healthcare professionals must be BIG-registered if in listed professions.
fastTrack.notes: Salary thresholds (gross per month, valid from 1 January 2026 - thresholds update annually each 1 January): reduced criterion €3,122; under-30 €4,357; 30+ years €5,942. Only IND-recognised employers may apply. Permit valid up to 5 years. Application fee €423. Path to permanent residence after 5 years. Source: ind.nl/en/required-amounts-income-requirements.

fastTrack.name: Netherlands
fastTrack.eligibility: Higher education diploma (minimum 3 years) relevant to role, OR 5 years of relevant professional experience at higher education level (3 years for IT professionals within 7 years). Employment contract minimum 6 months with Dutch-based employer. Salary thresholds (gross per month, valid from 1 January 2026): standard €5,942/month; recent graduates (within 3 years) €4,754/month.
fastTrack.processing_time: 30 days (recognised sponsors / long-term mobility); 45 days (certain existing permit holders); 90 days (all others)
fastTrack.notes: Salary thresholds (gross per month, valid from 1 January 2026 - thresholds update annually each 1 January): standard €5,942; reduced for recent graduates €4,754. Foreign diplomas evaluated by Nuffic. Path to permanent residence may be accelerated (under 5 years) for Blue Card holders. Permit valid up to 5 years. Application fee €423. Source: ind.nl/en/required-amounts-income-requirements.

fastTrack.name: Netherlands
fastTrack.program_name: Orientation Year for Highly Educated Migrants (Zoekjaar)
fastTrack.eligibility: Must have completed an accredited bachelor's/master's/post-master's degree at a Dutch institution, OR an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master, OR a master's/doctoral from a top-200 ranked institution (Times Higher Education, QS, Shanghai), within 3 years before application. Also available to recent research permit holders. Must not have previously held an orientation year permit.
fastTrack.notes: Permits free work during the 1-year validity. Permit is not extendable. Application fee €254 (exempt for Turkish, San Marinese, and Israeli nationals). Foreign diplomas evaluated by Nuffic. Designed to allow graduates and researchers to find employment in the Netherlands as a stepping stone to a highly skilled migrant or Blue Card permit.

fastTrack.name: Netherlands
fastTrack.eligibility: For highly skilled migrants where the European Blue Card does not apply; based on national Dutch immigration rules rather than EU directive.
fastTrack.notes: Parallel to the EU Blue Card scheme, the Netherlands operates its own national highly skilled migrant scheme. Salary thresholds and requirements similar to those of the Highly Skilled Migrant permit. Designed to complement the EU Blue Card framework.

fastTrack.name: Netherlands
fastTrack.eligibility: Available to nationals of Japan (max 200/year), South Korea (max 200/year), Argentina (max 100/year), Uruguay (max 100/year), Hong Kong (max 100/year), Taiwan (max 100/year), Australia (no fixed quota), Canada (no fixed quota), New Zealand (no fixed quota). Must be aged 18–30 at time of application. Must have return ticket or funds for return ticket and sufficient funds for the stay.
fastTrack.processing_time: Approximately 2–3 weeks after arrival for permit card
fastTrack.notes: Annual quota applies for Japan, South Korea, Argentina, Uruguay, Hong Kong, and Taiwan. Australia, Canada, and New Zealand nationals have no fixed quota and do not need an MVV - they apply upon arrival. As of April 2026, Japan quota for 2026 was exhausted (7 April 2026); South Korea quota still available. From 1 April 2026, pre-registration no longer required - applicants must apply for permit directly. Allows free work in Netherlands during stay. Not extendable.

fastTrack.name: New Zealand
fastTrack.program_name: Green List - Straight to Residence Visa (Tier 1)
fastTrack.eligibility: Must have a job offer or current employment in a Tier 1 Green List role with an accredited employer. Must be aged 55 or younger. Must earn at least NZD $35.00/hour (the 2025 median wage) or the specified rate for the Tier 1 role. Position must be permanent or fixed-term for at least 12 months (or consecutive 6-month contracts). Must speak and understand English, be in good health, and have good character.
fastTrack.notes: Provides immediate resident visa for Tier 1 Green List occupations (globally in-demand, nationally significant, in ongoing shortage). Permanent Resident Visa available after 2 consecutive years. New Zealand citizenship available after 5 years of residence. Application fee from NZD $6,450. The Green List is regularly updated; ten trades occupations were added to Work to Residence pathway on 18 August 2025. Wage threshold confirmed at NZD $35.00/hour (2025 median wage) as of March 2026.

fastTrack.name: New Zealand
fastTrack.program_name: Green List - Work to Residence Visa (Tier 2)
fastTrack.eligibility: Must have a job offer or current employment in a Tier 2 Green List occupation with an accredited employer. Must meet qualification, registration, and wage requirements for the specific role. Position must be full-time (at least 30 hours per week), genuine, and permanent or at least 12-month fixed term.
fastTrack.notes: Work visa that provides a pathway to residence. Eligible for residence application after meeting work requirements. Part of the Green List pathway for in-demand occupations.

fastTrack.name: New Zealand
fastTrack.eligibility: Must have an acceptable skilled job with an accredited employer (at least 30 hours/week, permanent or 12+ month fixed term, or consecutive 6-month contracts). Must meet one of: occupational registration requiring 2+ years training, bachelor's degree or higher, or income at 1.5x the median wage. Must accumulate 6 skilled resident points based on qualification level and New Zealand work experience. PhD/doctorate holders or those earning 3x median wage qualify immediately. Master's degree or 5-year registration: 5 points + 1 year NZ experience. Honours degree or 2x median wage: 4 points + 2 years NZ experience. Bachelor's degree, postgraduate certificate, or 1.5x median wage: 3 points + 3 years NZ experience.
fastTrack.notes: Points-based system. No substantive eligibility changes noted on the official page as updated March 2, 2026. The prior record noted a future change effective 24 August 2026 reducing maximum required NZ work experience from 3 years to 2 years for bachelor's degree holders - this change was not confirmed on the official page fetched in June 2026 and is therefore moved to gaps.

fastTrack.name: New Zealand
fastTrack.eligibility: Must be aged 55 or younger. Must demonstrate exceptional talent in arts, sport, or culture with international reputation. Must secure an acceptable sponsor providing accommodation and financial support, and backing from a New Zealand organization of national repute in the field. Must be in good health and of good character.
fastTrack.notes: Work visa valid up to 30 months. After 2 years of active engagement in the declared field, applicant may apply for the Talent (Arts, Culture, Sports) Resident Visa. Application fee from NZD $1,630. Partners and dependent children cannot be included in the work visa but may be added in the subsequent residence application.

fastTrack.name: Nigeria
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals with specialized knowledge, abilities, and technical know-how deemed highly relevant to current and future needs of the Nigerian economy. Requires letter of recommendation from the Nigerian Skills Gap Assessment (under ITF), vetted credentials and CV/skill profile, and police report from place of residence.
fastTrack.notes: Permanent Residence Visa (PRV) category. Stay duration: 5 years, multiple entry (residence permit), extendable. Holder is permitted to work and reside in Nigeria. Falls under the Nigerian Immigration Service's Permanent Residence framework.

fastTrack.name: Nigeria
fastTrack.program_name: Business – Frequently Travelled Business Executives Visa (F4C)
fastTrack.eligibility: High-profile business travelers who invest at least USD 250,000 in Nigeria. Requires proof of investment from a recognized agency, invitation letter, and CAC documentation for the host company.
fastTrack.notes: Short Visit Visa (Embassy) valid for 1 year with multiple entries; each stay capped at 30 days. Employment not permitted. This is a short-stay visa category (not a residence permit). It is a prerequisite for applying for the Investor Visa Permanent Residence categories (N3A/N3B).

fastTrack.name: Norway
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU/EEA nationals with completed vocational training (3+ years upper secondary) or university/college degree, or special qualifications through 6+ years professional experience. Must have a concrete full-time (or at least 80%) job offer from a Norwegian employer. Pay and conditions must meet Norwegian standards.
fastTrack.processing_time: No official fast-track scheme. Processing may be extended for vocational qualifications from Bangladesh, China, India, Iran, Kosovo, Nepal, Pakistan, Türkiye, and Vietnam. As of February 2026, applicants must obtain an employer confirmation code before submitting applications (fraud-prevention measure).
fastTrack.notes: Permits for vocational-level positions granted up to 1 year; for university-level positions up to 3 years. No annual quotas or caps. Path to permanent residence in 3 years. If job is lost, holder may remain up to 6 months to seek new employment. Minimum income threshold is NOK 341,373 per year pre-tax.

fastTrack.name: Norway
fastTrack.eligibility: Skilled workers who recently graduated from Norwegian education or are researchers. Must have sufficient financial support of at least NOK 28,448 per month. Must have higher education degree or vocational training.
fastTrack.processing_time: Not specified on official page; see UDI waiting times page.
fastTrack.notes: Duration: maximum 1 year. Period does NOT count toward permanent residence. Cannot be self-employed. Can work full or part-time in any job while seeking skilled employment. If job offer received during processing, application can be converted to skilled worker status at no extra cost.

fastTrack.name: Pakistan
fastTrack.eligibility: Citizens of all countries (BVL and non-BVL); intent to conduct business or invest in Pakistan, particularly in priority sectors such as mining and gold industries. SIFC recommendation letter may be required.
fastTrack.notes: Issued under the Special Investment Facilitation Council (SIFC) framework. Short-term: single-entry up to 6 months; long-term: multiple-entry up to 5 years (extendable by 2 years). Operated alongside SIFC Investor Visa to attract foreign investment in priority sectors.

fastTrack.name: Panama
fastTrack.program_name: Short-Stay Visa as a Remote Worker (Visa de Corta Estancia como Trabajador Remoto)
fastTrack.eligibility: Must work for a foreign transnational company or be a self-employed remote worker performing functions with effects abroad; minimum annual income of B/. 36,000 (USD 36,000) from foreign sources; must not work for Panamanian companies or clients inside Panama.
fastTrack.processing_time: Applied at Special Processing Window of SNM; applicant must already be in Panama territory. Processing time not specified on official sources.
fastTrack.notes: Created by Executive Decree 198 of May 7, 2021. Grants right to work remotely in Panama. Maximum initial stay of 9 months, renewable once for a further 9 months (total 18 months maximum). Applicant must be present in Panama to apply. Also referenced on ProPanama official investment promotion agency site (propanama.gob.pa). Foreign-source income is not subject to Panamanian income tax under Panama's territorial tax system.

fastTrack.name: Papua New Guinea
fastTrack.eligibility: Nationals from VOA-eligible countries; businesses in Oil and Gas, Mining, and major corporate/agricultural companies sponsoring foreign workers with recognised qualifications and skills not available locally. Maximum 4 uses per year.
fastTrack.notes: 30-day single entry per use, maximum 4 times per year. Available online (eVisa) for nationals from eligible countries. Confirmed in 2025 ICA handbook as one of the 21 eVisa classes.

fastTrack.name: Papua New Guinea
fastTrack.eligibility: Passport holders of APEC economies participating in the ABTC scheme who have been pre-approved by their home economy and have PNG code on the reverse of their ABTC.
fastTrack.notes: ABTC holders with 'PNG' code on card may enter PNG without a separate visa for business trips for a minimum of 59 days per visit. Card is valid for 5 years from first issue. For business travel only, not tourism. 19 full participating economies plus USA and Canada as transitional members. Confirmed via live ICA APEC page.

fastTrack.name: Peru
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals who work remotely for companies domiciled outside Peru. Introduced by Decreto Legislativo 1582 (November 2023).
fastTrack.processing_time: Not yet implemented as of June 2026
fastTrack.notes: Announced in November 2023 and incorporated into Peru's Migration Law via Decreto Legislativo 1582. Would allow up to 365 days stay with renewal. However, the updated TUPA published September 2025 made no reference to this category, meaning the Digital Nomad Visa has not been implemented and applications are not yet accepted. Regulations are still pending.

fastTrack.name: Philippines
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals aged 18+ who work remotely via digital technologies exclusively for overseas clients or employers. Must be from countries offering reciprocal digital nomad visas to Filipinos and maintaining a Philippine Foreign Service Post. Minimum income: USD 24,000/year. Must have valid health insurance. Clean criminal record required.
fastTrack.notes: Authorized by Executive Order No. 86, s. 2025 (signed April 24, 2025). Allows stay up to 1 year, renewable for another year. Foreign-sourced income not subject to Philippine taxation. Implementing rules and regulations by Bureau of Immigration were pending as of the last official access date. Application through Bureau of Immigration website or Philippine embassies/consulates once IRR published.

fastTrack.name: Philippines
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals whose employment will generate at least 10 jobs for Filipinos. Issued by Bureau of Immigration.
fastTrack.notes: Listed under Special Visas on the Bureau of Immigration website. Specific requirements and processing details not published on official web pages accessed.

fastTrack.name: Poland
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU nationals with a valid work contract of at least 1 year for highly qualified employment (higher education degree or 5 years relevant professional experience); gross monthly salary of at least PLN 9,519.23
fastTrack.processing_time: Maximum 60 days from submission of complete application
fastTrack.notes: The EU Blue Card is a single permit for residence and work; no separate work permit needed. Permit issued for the duration of the employment contract plus 3 months, up to a maximum of 3 years. Application fee: PLN 440. Minimum gross monthly salary threshold: PLN 9,519.23 (as confirmed on the European Commission EU immigration portal). Labour market test applies in Poland. Source also: https://home-affairs.ec.europa.eu/policies/migration-and-asylum/eu-immigration-portal/eu-blue-card/eu-blue-card-poland_en

fastTrack.name: Poland
fastTrack.eligibility: Originally for IT/ICT specialists and entrepreneurs (initially from Belarus, later expanded to Georgia, Russia, Ukraine, Moldova, Armenia); required a partnership with a Polish company or founding own business in Poland. D23 visa type granted without separate work permit.
fastTrack.processing_time: Approximately 2-5 weeks for visa; ~30 days for company verification
fastTrack.notes: Program is SUSPENDED – Minister of Foreign Affairs suspended MFA participation on 26 January 2024 due to concerns about inadequate verification of beneficiary companies and misuse of visas. No new visas or recommendations are being issued. Visas already issued remain valid. The MFA intends to develop streamlined standard business visa procedures as an alternative. See: https://www.gov.pl/web/diplomacy/statement-on-suspending-mfa-participation-in-poland-business-harbour-programme

fastTrack.name: Portugal
fastTrack.program_name: D8 Digital Nomad / Remote Work Visa
fastTrack.eligibility: Remote workers (both salaried employees and self-employed/freelancers) earning income from sources outside Portugal. Minimum income: 4x the national minimum monthly guarantee remuneration for the preceding 3 months (approx. EUR 3,480/month as of 2025 based on minimum wage). Valid employment/service contract or proof of services required.
fastTrack.processing_time: Not specified on official page; consular appointment required
fastTrack.notes: Established under Article 60(2)(c) of the Foreigners Law (Law 102/2017). Two visa options: (1) Temporary Stay Visa (up to 1 year, for short-term remote work); (2) Residency Visa D8 (valid 4 months with 2 entries - holder must apply for 2-year residence permit with AIMA within Portugal). The residency permit is renewable and can lead to permanent residency (5 years) and citizenship. Minimum stay for maintaining D8 residence permit is 183 days/year.

fastTrack.name: Portugal
fastTrack.eligibility: Entrepreneurs from non-Schengen countries wishing to establish an innovative tech-based startup in Portugal. Must enrol in a certified incubator (from the National Network of Incubators - RNI), sign an incubation contract, and receive IAPMEI certification. Project must have potential to achieve EUR 325,000 turnover or asset value within 5 years post-incubation. Applicant must hold minimum EUR 5,146.80 in bank account.
fastTrack.processing_time: Not specified on official IAPMEI page; residency visa valid 4 months + 90-day extension for AIMA residence permit application
fastTrack.notes: Managed by IAPMEI (Instituto de Apoio às Pequenas e Médias Empresas e à Inovação). Governed by Article 60(2)(c) of the Foreigners Act (Law 102/2017). Application submitted through IAPMEI online platform. Contact: startup.visa@iapmei.pt / +351 213 836 237.

fastTrack.name: Portugal
fastTrack.eligibility: Highly qualified and specialized workers recruited by IAPMEI-certified Portuguese companies or startups, who are non-Schengen area nationals. Workers must hold at minimum ISCED 2011 Level 6 (bachelor's degree) or Level 5 (higher vocational education) with 5 years of specialised technical experience. Proficiency in Portuguese, English, French, or Spanish required. Certified companies issue a digital Liability Note; workers present this at consular posts to qualify for a highly skilled worker residence visa/permit.
fastTrack.processing_time: Simplified/fast-track process via company-issued digital Liability Note
fastTrack.notes: Managed by IAPMEI. Companies must be certified under the Tech Visa program. Certified companies can recruit up to 50% of total workforce via Tech Visa (80% for companies in remote/peripheral areas). A mandatory minimum wage applies to Tech Visa workers. Program allows faster access to highly skilled worker residence visa or permit.

fastTrack.name: Portugal
fastTrack.eligibility: Specialized technical professionals seeking employment in Portugal
fastTrack.processing_time: Not yet operational - awaiting regulation of Article 57-A of the Foreigners Law
fastTrack.notes: Visa category exists in Portuguese legislation (Article 57-A of the Foreigners Law) but was not yet available at consular offices as of the official page's last update. Not currently accepting applications.

fastTrack.name: Romania
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals employed in a highly qualified job in Romania under an individual employment contract of indefinite or fixed duration of at least 6 months with a Romanian employer. Requires proof of higher professional qualifications.
fastTrack.processing_time: 30 days from submission (extendable by 15 days). EU Blue Card holders from other EU member states: 15 days.
fastTrack.notes: After 12 months of legal employment as a highly qualified worker in Romania, EU Blue Card holders are exempt from work permit requirements for subsequent employment. Stay can be extended up to 2 years for highly skilled workers. Employer pays a fee equivalent to 100 EUR. EU Blue Card status is not revoked solely due to unemployment if the period does not exceed 3 consecutive months.

fastTrack.name: Romania
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals with a valid employment contract with a Romanian employer. Various subcategories: permanent employee, seasonal worker, posted/deployed worker, ICT worker, trainee, cross-border worker, au pair.
fastTrack.processing_time: 30 days from submission (extendable by 15 days for seasonal workers).
fastTrack.notes: Combines work permit and residence permit in a single document. Employer fee: 100 EUR equivalent for permanent/skilled/deployed/trainee categories; 25 EUR for seasonal workers and change of employer. Residence permit for employment can be extended for successive periods of up to 1 year (or 2 years for highly skilled workers).

fastTrack.name: Russia
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals with specialized skills; minimum quarterly salary of RUB 750,000 (effective March 1, 2024); employer must file with Ministry of Internal Affairs
fastTrack.processing_time: 14–30 business days; exempt from standard labor quotas
fastTrack.notes: Work permit valid up to 3 years (duration of contract); unlimited extensions without leaving Russia. Employer-sponsored; employer submits application to MVD with employment contract.

fastTrack.name: Russia
fastTrack.program_name: Skilled Worker Visa (New Pathway, effective April 15, 2026)
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals in science, economics, industry, education, culture, business, or sports; no Russian language test required; no immigration quota
fastTrack.notes: Presidential Decree No. 883 (December 2025). Effective April 15, 2026. Eligible candidates can obtain 3-year temporary residency or apply directly for Permanent Residency. Application submitted through authorized agency digitally from home country; approved applicants receive 1-year business visa with immediate work rights. Family members included.

fastTrack.name: Rwanda
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign start-up founders and innovative entrepreneurs and their dependents
fastTrack.notes: 2-year entrepreneurship visa allowing foreign startup founders to start a business in Rwanda. Based on Investment Promotion and Facilitation Law No. 006/2021 of 8 February 2021. Detailed in RRA Investment Incentives document (August 2023) Section XVII (Talent Attraction Incentives). No dedicated application portal found on migration.gov.rw or irembo.gov.rw.

fastTrack.name: Rwanda
fastTrack.eligibility: Qualifying international students from qualifying higher institutions of learning
fastTrack.notes: 2-year talent visa commencing from the date of completion of studies for qualifying international graduates. Detailed in RRA Investment Incentives document (August 2023) Section XVII. No dedicated application portal found on migration.gov.rw or irembo.gov.rw.

fastTrack.name: Rwanda
fastTrack.eligibility: Qualifying remote workers in priority professional fields
fastTrack.notes: 2-year visa allowing qualifying remote workers to live in Rwanda and legally work for an employer registered abroad or their own company. Detailed in RRA Investment Incentives document (August 2023) Section XVII. No dedicated application portal found on migration.gov.rw or irembo.gov.rw at time of research.

fastTrack.name: Rwanda
fastTrack.program_name: Skilled Worker Permit – Occupations on Demand (H1)
fastTrack.eligibility: Skilled workers whose occupation appears on the official Occupations on Demand List (ODL) published by the Directorate General of Immigration
fastTrack.notes: Temporary resident permit (H1) for skilled workers on the Occupations on Demand List. No labour market test required (unlike the H2 sponsored category). A job-search visa (V4) of 90 days at USD 50 is also available for workers on the ODL to seek employment before applying for an H1 permit.

fastTrack.name: Rwanda
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign tourists intending to visit Rwanda, Kenya, and Uganda
fastTrack.notes: USD 100; valid 90 days with multiple entries covering Rwanda, Kenya and Uganda. Available on arrival, online via irembo.gov.rw, or at Rwandan diplomatic missions abroad. Formally classified as visa type V11 on the official visitors-visa page.

fastTrack.name: Saint Lucia
fastTrack.program_name: Don't Just Visit, Live It - Digital Nomad / Remote Work Visa
fastTrack.eligibility: Remote workers, freelancers employed by or self-employed with clients outside Saint Lucia, and students enrolled in remote learning programs. No minimum income requirement stated. All nationalities eligible (subject to visa requirements). Valid passport with at least 6 months validity.
fastTrack.notes: Launched March 2021. Valid for 1 year. Single-entry (EC$125 / approx. USD 47) or multiple-entry (EC$190 / approx. USD 70). No local income tax obligation for income sourced abroad. Apply by emailing completed form and documents to visaoffice@police.govt.lc. Administered by Royal Saint Lucia Police Force Immigration Department. Note: the official non-immigrant visa service page (govt.lc) does not reference the 'Live It' branding by name; routing is through the standard immigration portal. The program is referenced in secondary government press sources but no dedicated official landing page found under *.govt.lc or *.gov.lc.

fastTrack.name: San Marino
fastTrack.eligibility: Legal representatives, partners, and employees of qualifying high-tech startups registered in San Marino
fastTrack.notes: Duration: 1 year, renewable. Annual cap of 100 permits. Legal basis: Law 118/2010 and Law 115/2017. Holders are not entitled to free public healthcare. Governed by startup.sm, the official San Marino agency for economic development.

fastTrack.name: Saudi Arabia
fastTrack.eligibility: Exceptional professionals in scientific, healthcare, research, and executive leadership fields. Points-based system; salary thresholds from SAR 14,000–80,000/month depending on specialization. Requires endorsement and demonstrated exceptional expertise.
fastTrack.notes: In October 2024, Saudi Arabia's Health Minister granted Premium Residency to 2,645 exceptional healthcare professionals from 56 countries under this program. Application fee SAR 4,000.

fastTrack.name: Saudi Arabia
fastTrack.program_name: CODE (Coding Institute for Digital Excellence) Premium Residency - MCIT
fastTrack.eligibility: Tech professionals and digital talent invited or sponsored through the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology's CODE program.
fastTrack.notes: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT) offers a premium residency pathway for tech talent through the CODE institute. Specific eligibility criteria are detailed on the MCIT/CODE official pages.

fastTrack.name: Saudi Arabia
fastTrack.eligibility: Multinational companies establishing regional headquarters in Saudi Arabia. Eligible employees and executives may obtain facilitated residency.
fastTrack.notes: Administered by the Ministry of Investment (MISA). Companies relocating or establishing RHQ in Saudi Arabia and their qualifying employees benefit from expedited residency and work permit processes.

fastTrack.name: Serbia
fastTrack.program_name: Digital Nomads / Remote Workers Temporary Residence
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals working remotely for foreign employers or as self-employed individuals; must demonstrate proof of employment/contracts with foreign companies and sufficient funds
fastTrack.processing_time: Average 19 working days (as reported post-2024 reform)
fastTrack.notes: Serbia introduced tax incentives for digital nomads and a pathway via temporary residence permit (self-employment or employment basis). Not a dedicated branded 'digital nomad visa' - uses standard Visa D or temporary residence framework under the 2023 Law on Foreigners. Official welcome portal describes Serbia as committed to attracting digital nomads but does not publish a specific income threshold on the main digital nomad page.

fastTrack.name: Serbia
fastTrack.program_name: Single Temporary Residence and Work Permit
fastTrack.eligibility: Foreign nationals employed in Serbia under employment or other contracts; intra-company transferees, independent professionals, trainees, self-employed
fastTrack.notes: Unified single permit covering both residence and work rights. Issued for up to 36 months. Applications submitted exclusively electronically via welcometoserbia.gov.rs portal. Introduced under 2023 Law on Foreigners amendments effective February 2024.

fastTrack.name: Seychelles
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-Seychellois who have secured employment or are self-employed in Seychelles. Employer must first obtain approval from the Ministry of Employment and Social Affairs. Application should be submitted at least one week before the employee is due to start work.
fastTrack.notes: The GOP allows a foreign national to reside and work in Seychelles either as an employee or self-employed person. Processing fee: SCR 1,000; Permit fee: SCR 500 per month or part thereof, payable upfront for the full permit duration. Holders of a Permanent Residence Permit by Investment are exempt from GOP fees. No dedicated digital nomad, startup, talent, or remote-worker permit was found on any official government source as of June 2026.

fastTrack.name: Singapore
fastTrack.eligibility: Fixed monthly salary of at least S$30,000 for 12 consecutive months with an established company (market cap US$500M+ or annual revenue US$200M+), OR prospective employment at S$30,000/month with an established Singapore company, OR outstanding achievements in sports, arts and culture, or academia/research assessed holistically by MOM
fastTrack.notes: Personalised pass for top talent across all sectors. 5-year validity, renewable for further 5-year periods. No employer sponsorship required. Pass holders can concurrently be employed, run businesses, be directors, or be consultants in multiple Singapore companies. Renewal requires average S$30,000/month salary over 5 years in Singapore OR operating a Singapore company employing at least 5 locals at prevailing EP minimum salary. From January 2027, a new ONE Pass (AI and Tech) track will be introduced (replacing Tech.Pass) allowing salary criterion to be met through a combination of cash and non-cash components (e.g. ESOPs) - confirmed in COS 2026 foreign workforce policy factsheet.

fastTrack.name: Singapore
fastTrack.eligibility: Last drawn fixed monthly salary of at least S$22,500 in the last 1 year, AND at least 5 cumulative years of leadership experience in the past 10 years in a technology company valued at US$500M+ or that raised US$30M+ in funding, OR a venture capital firm managing US$500M+ AUM. 500 places available on first-come, first-served basis.
fastTrack.notes: 2-year validity, renewable once for another 2 years (maximum 4-year total). No employer sponsorship required. Holders can start and operate companies, be an employee, consultant or director in multiple Singapore companies, and mentor start-ups. Tech.Pass is currently still active (as of June 2026) but will be replaced by the ONE Pass (AI and Tech) track from January 2027 per COS 2026 announcement.

fastTrack.name: Singapore
fastTrack.eligibility: Must register a private limited company with ACRA with at least 30% ownership that is venture-backed or owns innovative technologies. Must meet at least one entrepreneurial track record criterion: raised minimum SGD 100,000 from a single funding round; supported by government-recognized or internationally-renowned incubator/accelerator; previously founded and sold a technology business; holds registered IP providing significant competitive advantage; maintains active research collaboration with Singapore institutions; owns IP registered with an approved national IP institution.
fastTrack.notes: Administered by Ministry of Manpower (MOM). Targets serial entrepreneurs, high-calibre innovators, and experienced investors wanting to operate in Singapore. Certain businesses ineligible (coffee shops, bars, massage parlours, employment agencies, geomancy businesses). EntrePass holders are eligible for PR through the Professionals/Technical Personnel and Skilled Worker scheme administered by ICA.

fastTrack.name: Singapore
fastTrack.eligibility: Candidates must earn at least S$5,600 a month (minimum as of 2025; higher for older, more experienced candidates - up to S$10,700/month at age 45+ for non-financial services, S$11,800/month for financial services). Must pass Complementarity Assessment Framework (COMPASS) unless salary exceeds S$22,500/month. COMPASS evaluates salary relative to local benchmarks, qualifications, diversity, and support for local employment.
fastTrack.notes: Singapore's primary work pass for professionals, managers, executives and technicians (PMETs). Requires employer sponsorship. Holders may eventually apply for PR after residing in Singapore. Current minimum: S$5,600/month (general sectors, age 23 base) up to S$10,700/month (age 45+); S$6,200/month (financial services, age 23 base) up to S$11,800/month (age 45+). From 1 January 2027 (new applications), minimum qualifying salary increases to S$6,000/month base (general sectors) or S$6,600/month base (financial services); renewal threshold increases apply from 1 January 2028.

fastTrack.name: Slovakia
fastTrack.program_name: EU Blue Card – Highly Qualified Worker Fast Track
fastTrack.eligibility: Third-country nationals with a university degree (bachelor, master, or PhD) or equivalent higher professional qualifications and a valid employment contract or binding job offer of at least 6 months. Salary must be at least 1.2 times the average monthly wage in Slovakia. No labour market test required as of 15 July 2024.
fastTrack.notes: Administered in Slovakia under Act No. 404/2011. Employer must report vacancy to the Labour Office on or before the application date. No quota limits. Card valid for up to 5 years. Digital immigration platform for online applications became fully operational on 18 February 2026.

fastTrack.name: Slovakia
fastTrack.eligibility: Legal entities or individuals holding a Certificate of Significant Investment from the Slovak Ministry of Economy, approved by Slovak Government as in the public interest.
fastTrack.processing_time: Approximately 30 days (versus standard 90 days for regular business residence)
fastTrack.notes: The Certificate of Significant Investment (issued by Ministry of Economy in cooperation with SARIO) unlocks significantly faster processing for temporary and permanent residence permit applications. Minimum investment thresholds for this certificate could not be confirmed from official published pages during June 2026 validation; contact cudzinec@mhsr.sk or SARIO for current criteria.

fastTrack.name: Slovenia
fastTrack.program_name: Temporary Residence Permit for Digital Nomads
fastTrack.eligibility: Non-EU/EEA nationals who work remotely for a company or clients registered outside Slovenia, or are self-employed abroad.
