The transitional government publishes no standalone online work-visa application, and the Ministry of Social Affairs and Labor has no English-language work-permit page, so official_url points to the government entry-visa page that sets out the work-permission requirement.

SYR.name: E-Visa (Not Yet Operational)
SYR.purpose: Online electronic visa application system for foreign nationals wishing to visit Syria, announced but not yet launched.
SYR.notes: Syria launched an official e-visa platform (evisa.sy) in 2024. As of June 2026 the platform has SSL certificate errors and is not operational — confirmed again on 2026-06-29. CultureRoad Travel (March 2026) states it 'is no longer operational.' No fee, validity, or application details are available.

TCD.name: e-Visa Touristique (Tourist e-Visa) - Standard
TCD.purpose: Short-stay visa for tourism, sightseeing, and leisure visits to Chad. Applied for online via the official evisa.td platform.
TCD.notes: The note-circulaire (evisa.td/articles/11) explicitly references 15-day and 30-day visa durations and states 'extension of visa is authorised only once for visas of 15 and 30 days.' The 30-day option is the standard tourist stay. Exact fee not published in publicly-accessible pages of evisa.td; set by Arrêté conjoint n°033/PR/PM/MFBEPCI/MSPI/2026. Must apply at least 7 days before travel and no more than 60 days in advance. Yellow fever vaccination certificate required at immigration. All visitors must register with police within 72 hours of arrival. Processing may be extended during high-volume periods.

TCD.name: e-Visa Touristique (Tourist e-Visa) - Express
TCD.purpose: Fast-track short-stay visa for tourism, sightseeing, and leisure visits to Chad with 72-hour processing.
TCD.notes: Express processing track confirmed in evisa.td/articles/11 (note-circulaire): '72 heures' turnaround. Same conditions as standard tourist e-Visa. Fee set by Arrêté conjoint n°033/PR/PM/MFBEPCI/MSPI/2026 - exact amount not published in publicly-accessible portal pages. Applications must be submitted at least 7 days before travel.

TCD.name: e-Visa d'Affaires (Business e-Visa) - Standard
TCD.purpose: Short-stay visa for business meetings, conferences, commercial activities, and professional visits to Chad.
TCD.notes: The evisa.td platform explicitly states it 'covers all visa categories' (all visa categories per the new tariff grid). Business visas require invitation letter from a Chadian company/organisation, and depending on the inviting entity type (private individual, private company, public institution, international organisation) different supporting documents are required per the note-circulaire. Notarised and legalised invitation is required for private invitees. Exact fee set by Arrêté conjoint n°033/PR/PM/MFBEPCI/MSPI/2026 - not published publicly. Must apply 7-60 days in advance.

TCD.name: e-Visa d'Affaires (Business e-Visa) - Express
TCD.purpose: Fast-track business visa for commercial visits to Chad with 72-hour processing.
TCD.notes: Express track (72 hours) confirmed in the note-circulaire. Same documentation requirements as standard business e-Visa. Fee amount not published publicly.

TCD.name: e-Visa de Transit (Transit e-Visa)
TCD.purpose: Short-stay visa permitting transit through Chad en route to a third country.
TCD.notes: Transit is one of the standard visa purposes processed through evisa.td. The note-circulaire references 15-day visas as one of the two standard durations (alongside 30-day). Transit visas most commonly correspond to the 15-day stay. Exact fee set by Arrêté conjoint n°033/PR/PM/MFBEPCI/MSPI/2026 - not publicly disclosed. Note: aggregators mention a 48-hour airside transit exemption but this is NOT confirmed on any official Chad government page and is not recorded here.

TCD.name: Visa Diplomatique / de Courtoisie (Diplomatic/Courtesy Visa)
TCD.purpose: Visa issued to holders of diplomatic passports and courtesy visa recipients; remains under the exclusive jurisdiction of the Chadian Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
TCD.notes: Explicitly excluded from the evisa.td online platform per the article on new tariffs: 'Les visas diplomatiques et de courtoisie relèvent de la compétence exclusive du Ministère des Affaires Étrangères' (Diplomatic and courtesy visas fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs). The Chad Embassy Paris 2019 document (ambatchadparis.fr) states visa is free ('gratuit') for holders of Diplomatic or Service passports. Additionally, Circulaire 002/MSPI/SG/2017 grants visa-free entry (no visa required) to holders of diplomatic passports from 20 specific countries. These are processed through Chadian embassies and missions abroad, not through evisa.td.

TCD.name: Visa de Longue Durée / Visa de Résidence (Long-Stay / Residence Visa)
TCD.purpose: Visa for foreigners intending to reside in Chad for extended periods, including for work, study, family reunification, or other long-term purposes.
TCD.notes: The evisa.td platform states it covers 'all visa categories' under the new tariff decree. Long-stay and residence permits are distinct from short-stay tourist/business e-visas and would fall under separate categories within the same platform. The note-circulaire references 'work contracts' and 'employment documentation' as supporting documents, indicating work/long-stay visa categories exist within the system. Specific fee, validity, and duration details for long-stay visas are not published in the publicly-accessible pages of evisa.td. The Arrêté conjoint n°033/PR/PM/MFBEPCI/MSPI/2026 governs all fees.

TGO.name: Visa Touristique (Tourist Visa)
TGO.purpose: Permits foreign travelers to visit Togo for tourism or to participate in meetings, conferences, salons, or seminars by invitation.
TGO.notes: Fee varies by duration and entry type: 1–15 days single entry 25,000 XOF (~$42 USD); 1–15 days multiple entry 35,000 XOF (~$58 USD); 16–30 days multiple entry 45,000 XOF (~$75 USD); 31–90 days multiple entry 65,000 XOF (~$108 USD). Applied online via voyage.gouv.tg; must be submitted at least 5 business days before arrival. Visa on arrival and express visas suspended until further notice.

TGO.name: Visa Touristique Entrées Multiples - Court Séjour (Tourist Visa Multiple Entry)
TGO.purpose: Multiple-entry tourist visa for short stays in Togo, covering tourism, conferences, and short business visits.
TGO.notes: Multiple-entry variant of the tourist visa. 1–15 days: 35,000 XOF (~$58 USD); 16–30 days: 45,000 XOF (~$75 USD); 31–90 days: 65,000 XOF (~$108 USD). Applied online via voyage.gouv.tg.

TGO.name: Visa Professionnel (Professional Visa)
TGO.purpose: Allows the exercise of certain professions (journalism, commerce) or the execution of projects with Togolese partners for up to 90 days, extendable to one year for business promoters.
TGO.notes: Standard duration up to 90 days; extendable to one year (91–365 days multiple entry: 100,000 XOF, ~$167 USD) for business promoters or active professionals. Applied online via voyage.gouv.tg at least 5 business days before arrival.

TGO.name: Visa d'Immigration - Études/Stage (Study/Internship Immigration Visa)
TGO.purpose: Enables foreign nationals to settle in Togo for study or internship purposes on a sustainable basis.
TGO.notes: Subcategory of the Immigration Visa. Fee: 65,000 XOF (~$108 USD) for 31–90 days multiple entry. Applicants must also obtain a Togolese residence permit (carte de séjour étudiant: 1-year at 100,000 XOF, 3-year at 250,000 XOF) to remain long-term. Applied online via voyage.gouv.tg.

TGO.name: Visa d'Immigration - Regroupement Familial (Family Reunification Immigration Visa)
TGO.purpose: Enables sustainable settlement in Togo for the purpose of family reunification with a legally residing family member.
TGO.notes: Subcategory of the Immigration Visa. Fee: 65,000 XOF (~$108 USD) for 31–90 days multiple entry. Long-term stay requires a residence permit (carte de séjour). Applied online via voyage.gouv.tg.

TGO.name: Visa d'Immigration Professionnel (Professional Immigration Visa)
TGO.purpose: Enables sustainable settlement in Togo for the purpose of professional activity and employment.
TGO.notes: Subcategory of the Immigration Visa intended for those establishing themselves professionally in Togo. Fee: 65,000 XOF (~$108 USD) for 31–90 days multiple entry. Long-term stay requires a residence permit (carte de séjour ordinaire or privileged). Applied online via voyage.gouv.tg.

TGO.name: Visa de Courtoisie (Courtesy Visa)
TGO.purpose: Issued free of charge to official representatives for diplomatic missions and official visits under bilateral or multilateral agreements.
TGO.notes: Issued free of charge (0 XOF) for all durations, multiple entry. Reserved for official diplomatic representatives and mission personnel. Long-term courtesy visas exempt holders from the standard visa requirement. Bilateral agreements also exempt holders of diplomatic and service passports from several countries from any visa requirement altogether.

TGO.name: Transit (Airside)
TGO.purpose: Allows passengers to transit through Togolese international airports without entering Togo, remaining airside throughout.
TGO.notes: Passengers remaining airside (not passing through immigration) are exempt from visa requirements. No separate transit visa category is published on the official portal. Travelers who wish to exit the airside area and enter Togolese territory must hold a valid visa or qualify for visa-free entry.

THA.name: TR Visa (Tourist)
THA.notes: Applied at Thai embassy/consulate. Single-entry (TR) or multiple-entry (TRMT) available. Standard single-entry TR: 60 days, extendable once by 30 days at immigration office (THB 1,900 fee). Multiple-entry TR valid 6 months, each stay up to 60 days.

THA.name: Thai e-Visa
THA.purpose: Tourism (and other visa categories via online application)
THA.notes: Thai e-Visa system launched globally January 1, 2025 across 94 Thai embassies/consulates. Applies to nationalities not entitled to visa exemption. Online application via thaievisa.go.th. Multiple visa types (TR, Non-B, Non-O, etc.) available through the portal. Specific stay durations depend on visa category.

THA.name: Non-Immigrant O-A Visa (Retirement)
THA.purpose: Retirement in Thailand for persons aged 50+
THA.notes: For applicants aged 50+. Requires proof of funds: THB 800,000 in Thai bank account (or monthly income/pension of THB 65,000, or combination totaling THB 800,000). Must have health insurance with minimum THB 40,000 outpatient / THB 400,000 inpatient coverage. 1-year stay, extendable annually at immigration. Applied at Thai embassy/consulate abroad. Issued as a multiple-entry visa; fee THB 5,000 (~USD 145) per official MFA O-A page (corrected from prior USD 80). Official URL updated to the MFA O-A page.

THA.name: Non-Immigrant B Visa (Business/Work)
THA.purpose: Business activities or employment in Thailand
THA.notes: For business activities or employment. Requires letter from Thai employer or business. Initial 90-day stay; must obtain work permit and convert to 1-year extension of stay at immigration in Thailand. Multiple-entry Non-B available for established employees.

THA.name: Long-Term Resident Visa - Work-From-Thailand (LTR-WFT)
THA.purpose: Remote work from Thailand for foreign employer
THA.notes: 10-year LTR visa for Work-From-Thailand Professionals. Requirements: employed by a publicly listed or large foreign company; minimum personal income USD 80,000/year (or USD 40,000/year with master's degree/investment/work in targeted field); health insurance USD 50,000+ coverage. 5-year permission to stay, renewable once for additional 5 years. THB 50,000 visa fee (~USD 1,430). 17% flat income tax option available. No work permit needed for remote/overseas employer income. Issued by Thailand BOI.

THA.name: Non-Immigrant ED Visa (Education)
THA.purpose: Study at a school, university, language/vocational course, training, or Muay Thai course in Thailand
THA.notes: For study/training in Thailand (schools, universities, language schools, vocational and Muay Thai courses). Single-entry 90-day stay, extendable in-country at the Immigration Bureau for the duration of the course. Fee THB 2,000 (~USD 80) single-entry; multiple-entry (1-year validity) also available. Applied online via thaievisa.go.th; requires acceptance letter from the institution and proof of funds.

THA.name: Non-Immigrant O Visa (Spouse / Family / Dependent)
THA.purpose: Accompany a Thai spouse, or a family member/dependent of a person working, studying, or living in Thailand
THA.notes: For spouses/dependents of Thai nationals or of foreigners working/studying in Thailand. Single-entry 90-day stay; extendable to one year at the Immigration Bureau (marriage extension requires THB 400,000 in a Thai bank or THB 40,000/month income). Fee THB 2,000 (~USD 80). Applied online via thaievisa.go.th.

THA.name: Non-Immigrant O Visa (Medical Treatment)
THA.purpose: Undergo medical treatment at a licensed hospital or facility in Thailand
THA.notes: For patients receiving treatment in Thailand. Requires a confirmation/appointment letter from a licensed Thai medical facility and proof of funds. Single-entry 90-day stay, extendable up to one year at the Immigration Bureau. Up to three accompanying companions may apply for a linked visa. A short-stay Tourist Visa 'MT' also exists for treatment under 90 days. Fee THB 2,000 (~USD 80).

THA.name: Transit Visa (TS)
THA.purpose: Transit through Thailand en route to another country, or attend a sports competition as a non-professional; also for aircraft/ship crew
THA.notes: Category S-TS-C: transit passengers, non-professional sports competitors, and crew. Single-entry, up to 30 days per stay, valid 90 days from issue. Required for transit passengers staying more than 12 hours or leaving the transit area. Requires proof of onward travel. Fee THB 800 (~USD 26). Applied online via thaievisa.go.th.

THA.name: Non-Immigrant O-X Visa (Long Stay 10 Years)
THA.purpose: Long-stay retirement for nationals of 14 eligible countries aged 50+
THA.notes: 10-year long-stay retirement visa (5-year validity, renewable once for another 5 years) for applicants aged 50+ from 14 eligible countries: Japan, Australia, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Norway, Sweden, Switzerland, United Kingdom, Canada, and the United States. Requires THB 3 million on deposit in a Thai bank, or THB 1.8 million deposit plus THB 1.2 million/year income, plus Thai health insurance. Multiple-entry. Fee THB 10,000 (~USD 400). Distinct from the O-A 1-year retirement visa.

THA.name: Non-Immigrant IB Visa (Investment and Business)
THA.purpose: Work on or invest in a project promoted by the Thailand Board of Investment (BOI)
THA.notes: For foreign nationals investing in or employed by BOI-promoted projects (One Start One Stop Investment Center, OSOS). Initial 90-day stay, extendable to one year in Thailand; work permit required to work. Fee THB 2,000 (~USD 80) single-entry, THB 5,000 multiple-entry. Related categories on the same MFA page: 'B' (business/work), 'B-A' (business approved) and 'IM' (investment, min THB 10 million capital).

THA.name: Work and Holiday Visa
THA.purpose: Youth exchange: young adults holidaying in Thailand who may also work incidentally
THA.notes: Bilateral youth-exchange scheme (agreements with Australia and New Zealand). Applicants aged 18-30 with tertiary qualifications. Multiple-entry, stay up to 12 months (visa valid 3 months to make first entry). Employment with any single employer limited to 3 months; one-time, non-renewable. Fee varies by embassy (e.g., ~NZ$1,000 at Wellington). Applied online via thaievisa.go.th.

TJK.name: Tourist E-Visa (Single Entry)
TJK.purpose: Short-term tourism and sightseeing in Tajikistan. Applied for online before travel.
TJK.notes: Must apply from outside Tajikistan. Cannot be extended once issued. Registration at Ministry of Internal Affairs (OVIR) required within 10 days of arrival if staying 10+ days. Optional GBAO (Gorno-Badakhshan Autonomous Region) permit available as add-on at additional cost.

TJK.name: Tourist E-Visa (Multiple Entry)
TJK.purpose: Short-term tourism allowing multiple entries into Tajikistan within the visa validity period.
TJK.notes: Must apply from outside Tajikistan. Cannot be extended. Available to citizens of approximately 121 eligible countries. GBAO permit available as add-on.

TJK.name: Tourist Visa on Arrival (T-Visa)
TJK.purpose: Tourist visa issued at Dushanbe International Airport for stays longer than 30 days or for nationalities requiring a visa that do not have an e-visa.
TJK.notes: Available at Dushanbe International Airport. Certain nationalities (Algeria, Egypt, Lebanon, Morocco, South Africa, Tunisia, Turkmenistan, Venezuela, Vietnam) may obtain a visa on arrival. Additional fees may apply. May require prior arrangement or invitation letter for some nationalities.

TJK.name: Business Visa (K-Visa)
TJK.purpose: For foreign nationals traveling to Tajikistan for business purposes, meetings, or commercial activities.
TJK.notes: Classified as category K. Requires a visa support letter from a Tajikistan-based organization. Applied through the official MFA standard-visa system at visa.gov.tj and collected in person at a Tajik embassy or consulate. Also available via the e-visa portal (business purpose) for eligible nationalities.

TJK.name: Student / Education Visa (O-Visa)
TJK.purpose: For foreign nationals admitted to an educational institution in Tajikistan for the purpose of study.
TJK.notes: Classified as category O (sub-types O1 for enrolled students/exchange/degree study and O2 for research, language and specialised graduate courses). Requires visa support letter from the educational institution in Tajikistan. Applied through the official MFA standard-visa system at visa.gov.tj and collected at a Tajik embassy or consulate. Must register with OVIR (Ministry of Internal Affairs) after arrival.

TJK.name: Private Visit / Family Visa (XC1)
TJK.purpose: For foreign nationals visiting family members or friends residing in Tajikistan.
TJK.notes: Classified as category ХС1 (XC1); also covers travel for medical treatment and personal purposes such as attending festivals, funerals and ceremonies (a separate XC2 sub-type exists for former Tajik citizens and close relatives of Tajik nationals). Requires a visa support letter/invitation from the host in Tajikistan. Applied through the official MFA standard-visa system at visa.gov.tj and collected at a Tajik embassy or consulate. Must register with OVIR after arrival.

TJK.name: Transit Visa
TJK.purpose: For travelers passing through Tajikistan en route to another country.
TJK.notes: Classified as category ТР (TR). Issued for transit across Tajikistan to a destination country for up to 72 hours; road transit visas are granted for the shortest route (calculated at 24 hours per 400 km). Passengers transiting airside without crossing the border do not require a visa. Applied through the official MFA standard-visa system at visa.gov.tj prior to travel.

TJK.name: Diplomatic / Official Visa
TJK.purpose: For foreign diplomats, government officials, and holders of diplomatic or service passports traveling on official government business.
TJK.notes: Covers the Diplomatic (category Д) and Service/Official (category Х) visas issued to heads of state and government, official delegations, diplomatic and consular staff, staff of international organisations, and their families. Many nationalities holding diplomatic or service passports also receive visa-free access for 30–90 days under bilateral agreements. Issued through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs; conditions vary by nationality.

TJK.name: Investor Visa (Category C)
TJK.purpose: For heads and representatives of foreign companies and enterprises that invest in the economy of Tajikistan, together with their family members.
TJK.notes: Standard (sticker) visa, category 'С' (C) in the MFA visa classification. Application submitted through the official MFA system at visa.gov.tj and the visa collected in person at a Tajik embassy or consulate. Exempt from the HIV/AIDS certificate required for other stays over three months. Consular fee is tiered by validity (approx. USD 30 up to 1 month, USD 40 for 3 months, USD 90 for 6 months, USD 150 for 1 year per the MFA consular tariff). Investment-threshold and multi-year 'golden-visa'-style validity figures cited by third-party sources are not confirmed on an official government page.

TJK.name: Work Visa (Category M)
TJK.purpose: For foreign citizens and stateless persons entering Tajikistan for employment/labour with a locally registered employer, and their family members.
TJK.notes: Standard (sticker) visa, category 'M' (Labour) in the MFA visa classification. Requires a visa-support/invitation letter from the Tajikistan-based employer; employment additionally requires a work permit from the migration service. Applied through the official MFA system at visa.gov.tj and collected at a Tajik embassy or consulate. Registration with OVIR (Ministry of Internal Affairs) required after arrival. Accompanying family members are admitted without the right to work. Consular fee tiered by validity (approx. USD 30 for 1 month up to USD 150 for 1 year).

TJK.name: Free Economic Zone Visa (Category МОИ)
TJK.purpose: For foreign citizens and stateless persons who work, run a business or carry out entrepreneurship within Tajikistan's free economic zones.
TJK.notes: Standard (sticker) visa, category 'МОИ' in the MFA visa classification, for activity within Tajikistan's free economic zones (entrepreneurship and doing business). Requires supporting documents from the free economic zone administration or host entity. Applied through the official MFA system at visa.gov.tj and collected at a Tajik embassy or consulate.

TKM.name: Tourist Visa
TKM.purpose: Leisure and tourism visits to Turkmenistan. Only a licensed national tourism agency of Turkmenistan may submit the Letter of Invitation (LOI) application on behalf of the foreign visitor.
TKM.notes: Requires a certified Letter of Invitation (LOI) from a licensed Turkmenistan national travel agency, submitted to the State Migration Service. Visa sticker issued at embassy/consulate or Ashgabat airport (airport issuance carries a +$50 surcharge). Standard single-entry up to 1 month is $40; up to 20 days is $30; up to 10 days is $20. Expedited 3-business-day processing doubles the fee. Processing time is 10 calendar days from receipt of documents. E-visa system signed into law April 2025 but portal not yet operational as of June 2026.

TKM.name: Business Visa
TKM.purpose: Commercial activities, meetings, and negotiations with Turkmenistan-registered business partners. The Turkmen business partner entity submits the LOI application on behalf of the visitor.
TKM.notes: Requires certified LOI from the Turkmen business partner, approved by the State Migration Service. Single entry up to 1 month is $40; multiple entry up to 1 month is $60 (each additional month +$40). Airport issuance carries a +$50 surcharge. Expedited 3-business-day processing doubles the fee. Standard processing is 10 calendar days.

TKM.name: Transit Visa (Single)
TKM.purpose: Transit through Turkmenistan territory (land or air) to a third country, for a single crossing.
TKM.notes: Single transit visa valid for up to 5 days. Requires travel documents and proof of onward journey. Contact a national travel agency of Turkmenistan or embassy for LOI. Airport issuance at Ashgabat airport carries a +$50 surcharge. Expedited processing doubles the fee. Standard processing: 10 calendar days.

TKM.name: Transit Visa (Double)
TKM.purpose: Transit through Turkmenistan territory twice (e.g. entering and exiting on a return journey), each crossing up to 5 days.
TKM.notes: Double transit visa; each transit leg valid for up to 5 days. Fee is $40 USD. Airport issuance carries a +$50 surcharge. Expedited processing doubles the fee. Standard processing: 10 calendar days.

TKM.name: Private/Family Visa
TKM.purpose: Visiting family members or private individuals residing in Turkmenistan. Covers personal visits not for tourism or business purposes.
TKM.notes: Listed as 'Private Visa' and 'Family Visa' on the Austria embassy page; detailed procedures marked 'information coming soon' at time of research. Requires an LOI certified by the State Migration Service from the host individual in Turkmenistan. Fee structure follows standard single-entry schedule ($20–$40 depending on duration). Airport issuance surcharge applies.

TKM.name: Diplomatic Visa
TKM.purpose: Entry for holders of diplomatic passports on official diplomatic missions. Issued upon submission of a Note Verbale from the applicant's foreign embassy to the Turkmenistan embassy.
TKM.notes: Requires the foreign embassy to submit a Note Verbale to the Embassy of Turkmenistan. Specific validity, fee, and stay duration details are not published on accessible official pages. Diplomatic passport holders from countries with bilateral visa-waiver agreements (Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bulgaria, China, Georgia, Hungary, Iran, Japan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Malaysia, Moldova, Mongolia, Romania, Russia, Singapore, Slovakia, South Korea, Switzerland, Tajikistan, Turkey, Ukraine, UAE) do not require a visa - see conditional_access.

TKM.name: Official/Service Visa
TKM.purpose: Entry for holders of official or service passports traveling on government business. Separate from full diplomatic visa.
TKM.notes: Listed as 'Official Visa' and 'Service Visa' on the Austria embassy consular page; detailed procedures marked 'information coming soon' at time of research. Holders of official/service passports from countries with bilateral waiver agreements are visa-exempt (see conditional_access). For others, requires embassy-to-embassy process similar to diplomatic visa.

TKM.name: Work Visa (WP)
TKM.purpose: Foreign nationals taking up employment with a Turkmenistan-registered employer. The employing organisation obtains the certified Letter of Invitation on the worker's behalf.
TKM.notes: Listed with code 'WP' among the 15 official visa categories on the Turkmenistan embassy (Turkey) and Istanbul consulate visa-requirements pages. Requires a certified Letter of Invitation from the State Migration Service, obtained by the sponsoring employer. Per-category fee, maximum stay, and validity are not published on any accessible official page; the general duration-based consular schedule (single entry $20 up to 10 days / $30 up to 20 days / $40 up to 1 month, each additional month +$30) and the standard 10-calendar-day processing time apply. Detailed requirements are administered by the State Migration Service (migration.gov.tm).

TKM.name: Student Visa (Study Visa, ST)
TKM.purpose: Foreign nationals enrolled at a Turkmenistan university or other accredited educational institution.
TKM.notes: Named 'Study Visa' on the Turkmenistan embassy (UK) consular page and listed with code 'ST' on the Turkey embassy and Istanbul consulate visa-requirements pages. Requires a certified Letter of Invitation from the State Migration Service, typically arranged by the host institution. Per-category fee, maximum stay, and validity are not published on any accessible official page; the general duration-based consular schedule and 10-calendar-day standard processing apply.

TKM.name: Investor Visa (Investment, IN)
TKM.purpose: Foreign investors carrying out investment activity in Turkmenistan.
TKM.notes: Named 'Investor Visa' on the Turkmenistan embassy (UK) consular page and listed with code 'IN' on the Turkey embassy and Istanbul consulate visa-requirements pages. Requires a certified Letter of Invitation from the State Migration Service. This is an entry visa and is distinct from the permanent residence permit right granted to foreign investors under the Law on Foreign Investments (see rbi). Per-category fee, maximum stay, and validity are not published on any accessible official page; the general duration-based consular schedule and 10-calendar-day standard processing apply.

TKM.name: Health Visa (HL)
TKM.purpose: Foreign nationals travelling to Turkmenistan to receive medical treatment.
TKM.notes: Listed with code 'HL' among the 15 official visa categories on the Turkmenistan embassy (Turkey) and Istanbul consulate visa-requirements pages. Requires a certified Letter of Invitation from the State Migration Service. Per-category fee, maximum stay, and validity are not published on any accessible official page; the general duration-based consular schedule and 10-calendar-day standard processing apply.

TKM.name: Humanitarian Visa (HM)
TKM.purpose: Compassionate visits - to see seriously ill close relatives or to carry out burials in Turkmenistan.
TKM.notes: Listed with code 'HM' on the Turkmenistan embassy (Turkey) and Istanbul consulate visa-requirements pages, described as being to 'visit seriously ill close relatives' or 'carry out burials.' Requires a certified Letter of Invitation from the State Migration Service. Per-category fee, maximum stay, and validity are not published on any accessible official page; the general duration-based consular schedule and 10-calendar-day standard processing apply.

TKM.name: Sports Visa (SP1/SP2)
TKM.purpose: Athletes and sports delegations attending competitions or sporting events in Turkmenistan.
TKM.notes: Listed with codes 'SP1'/'SP2' among the 15 official visa categories on the Turkmenistan embassy (Turkey) and Istanbul consulate visa-requirements pages. Requires a certified Letter of Invitation from the State Migration Service. Per-category fee, maximum stay, and validity are not published on any accessible official page; the general duration-based consular schedule and 10-calendar-day standard processing apply.

TKM.name: Driving Visa (DR)
TKM.purpose: Professional drivers of international road transport operating to or through Turkmenistan.
TKM.notes: Listed with code 'DR' among the 15 official visa categories on the Turkmenistan embassy (Turkey) and Istanbul consulate visa-requirements pages. Intended for professional drivers engaged in international road haulage. Requires a certified Letter of Invitation from the State Migration Service. Per-category fee, maximum stay, and validity are not published on any accessible official page; the general duration-based consular schedule and 10-calendar-day standard processing apply.

TKM.name: Electronic Visa (e-Visa) - Enacted, Not Yet Operational
TKM.purpose: Online visa application system for all nationalities, eliminating the Letter of Invitation requirement. Signed into law by presidential decree on April 18, 2025 as part of the Migration Law amendments.
TKM.notes: Presidential Decree of April 18, 2025 introduced the e-visa system and abolished the LOI requirement for the new system. The State Migration Service (migration.gov.tm) will administer the platform. As of June 2026, the portal is still not operational and no confirmed launch date has been announced. Fees, eligible nationalities, maximum stay, and processing times remain undefined pending Presidential implementation decrees. Until the platform launches, the old paper-application + certified LOI system remains in force.

TLS.name: Tourist Visa / Visa on Arrival (Class I)
TLS.purpose: Allows entry into Timor-Leste for tourism, family visits, and business prospecting. Available on arrival at Dili International Airport and Dili Sea Port, or in advance at an embassy/consulate.
TLS.notes: On-arrival grants up to 30 days single entry for USD $30. Advance applications (embassy/consulate) allow up to 90 days with single or multiple entries. Extendable in-country: USD $35 for up to 30 additional days or USD $75 for 30–60 additional days (per customs.gov.tl; migracao.gov.tl states $40 for extension - discrepancy between official pages). Maximum cumulative stay 90 days. Holders may not engage in paid professional activity. Minimum funds: USD $100 per entry plus USD $50 per day. Passport must be valid 6+ months with at least one blank page.

TLS.name: Transit Visa (VTU)
TLS.purpose: For foreign nationals passing through Timor-Leste en route to another country, allowing brief ground transit.
TLS.notes: Maximum 72 hours. Up to 2 entries permitted. Extension is not allowed. Requires travel document, proof of financial means, return/onward ticket, accommodation declaration, and documents justifying transit purpose.

TLS.name: Airport Transit Visa (VEA)
TLS.purpose: For travelers who need access to the international zone of the airport and are continuing travel on the same or another aircraft without entering Timor-Leste territory.
TLS.notes: Maximum 72 hours. Airside transit only - no entry into Timor-Leste territory. Extension not permitted. Requires travel document, proof of financial means, onward ticket, and accommodation declaration.

TLS.name: Business Visa Class I (VNG1)
TLS.purpose: For foreign nationals entering Timor-Leste to conduct business prospecting activities or explore investment opportunities.
TLS.notes: Maximum stay 60 days. Extension is not permitted. Multiple entries allowed. Requires travel document, proof of financial means, return ticket, accommodation declaration, documentation justifying purpose, and professional qualifications proof.

TLS.name: Business Visa Class II (VNG2)
TLS.purpose: For foreign nationals settling in Timor-Leste to conduct business as members or administrators of a company registered locally, requiring stays exceeding 183 days per year.
TLS.notes: Initial duration 6 months. Extendable for 2-year periods at USD $150 per renewal. Multiple entries. Requires certified commercial registration copy, economic activity authorization, tax payment certificate, medical certificate, criminal record from country of origin/residence, and professional qualifications documentation.

TLS.name: Work Visa (VTB)
TLS.purpose: Allows foreign nationals to enter Timor-Leste to pursue an occupation for others under an employment contract or service agreement, including volunteers working more than 120 days per year.
TLS.notes: Valid 1 year, renewable for equal periods at USD $100. Processing split: 15 days Immigration Office + 15 days SEFOPE Office. Requires certified employment/service contract, medical certificate, criminal record from country of origin, professional qualifications, employer's commercial registration and tax payment certificate, accommodation declaration, return ticket, and proof of financial support.

TLS.name: Temporary Stay Visa – Student (VET1)
TLS.purpose: Allows foreign nationals to reside in Timor-Leste for the duration of their study programme at a recognised institution.
TLS.notes: Duration matches the length of the study period. Extendable in 6-month increments at USD $50. Multiple entries allowed. Requires school declaration, medical certificate, criminal record, proof of accommodation, and proof of financial means.

TLS.name: Temporary Stay Visa – Specialized Activities (VET2)
TLS.purpose: For foreign nationals undertaking specialized work, technical missions, or contracted activities in Timor-Leste that do not qualify as standard employment.
TLS.notes: Valid up to 1 year (or duration of contract/mission). Extendable for equal periods at USD $50. Multiple entries. Requires work contract, professional qualifications, tax certificate, and medical clearance.

TLS.name: Temporary Stay Visa – Long-Term Volunteer (VET3)
TLS.purpose: For foreign nationals undertaking long-term volunteer activities in Timor-Leste not exceeding 120 days per year.
TLS.notes: Maximum 120 days. Extension not available. Multiple entries. Requires volunteer agreement and medical certificate. Volunteers exceeding 120 days annually should apply for the Work Visa (VTB) instead.

TLS.name: Temporary Stay Visa – Family Dependents (VET4)
TLS.purpose: For family members who are dependents of a foreign national legally residing in Timor-Leste under a qualifying visa or permit.
TLS.notes: Duration and extension period match the sponsoring family member's visa/permit. Multiple entries. Requires certified proof of family relationship and medical certificate.

TLS.name: Temporary Stay Visa – Other Activities (VET5)
TLS.purpose: Catch-all category for foreign nationals pursuing activities in Timor-Leste not covered by other Temporary Stay Visa sub-types.
TLS.notes: Duration and conditions determined on a case-by-case basis. Fee is USD $50. Documentation requirements depend on the specific activity.

TLS.name: Resident Stay Visa – Professional Activities (VFR1)
TLS.purpose: For foreign nationals intending to establish lawful residence in Timor-Leste for professional purposes, as a precursor to applying for a Temporary Resident Permit.
TLS.notes: 90 days, multiple entries. Extension not available - holders are expected to apply for a Temporary Resident Permit during this period. Requires professional credentials, commercial registration (certified), employer's tax certificate, medical certificate, and criminal record from country of origin.

TLS.name: Resident Stay Visa – Family Reunification (VFR2)
TLS.purpose: For family members of Timor-Leste citizens or legal residents seeking to join them and establish long-term residence through family reunification.
TLS.notes: 90 days, multiple entries. Extension not available - holders are expected to apply for a Temporary Resident Permit. Requires certified family relationship documentation (consular verification), medical certificate, and criminal record from country of origin.

TLS.name: Courtesy Visa (Visto de Cortesia)
TLS.purpose: Granted to foreign officials and other persons travelling to Timor-Leste for a service visit or official purpose, and to others entitled to courtesies under Timor-Leste law or international convention.
TLS.notes: Up to 30 days per visit; validity one year with multiple entries. No fee listed (N/A). Requirements and criteria are defined by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Cooperation (MNEC), not the Immigration Service. Requires travel document and documentation justifying the reasons and conditions of stay.

TLS.name: Special Stay Authorization (Estada Especial)
TLS.purpose: For foreign nationals employed by Timorese State institutions, UN agencies or accredited international organizations, bilateral cooperation programmes, or NGOs operating in cooperation programmes with Timor-Leste.
TLS.notes: A special stay authorization (not a visa in the strict sense) for cooperation, UN, NGO, international-organization, and state-employed foreign personnel. Initial period up to one year, tied to the employment/service contract, extendable for similar periods; multiple entries. No application or extension fee listed (N/A). Requires authorization from the Minister of the Interior; holder must register at Migration Services within 30 days of approval to affix the authorization stamp to the passport. Also referenced on the Special Stay Authorization form page (sub0204.php).

TLS.name: Visa to Establish Residence (Visto para Fixacao de Residencia)
TLS.purpose: For foreign nationals intending to settle permanently in Timor-Leste as a precursor to applying for a Residence Permit, including persons of independent means, professionals, and business owners.
TLS.notes: Grants six months single entry to enter Timor-Leste and apply for a Residence Permit. Applicant must demonstrate intention to remain on a permanent basis, means of subsistence (independent means accepted), accommodation, a clean criminal/police record, and physical and psychological fitness. Cannot be obtained at border posts - apply at an embassy/consulate abroad or the Department of Consular Affairs in Dili after arrival. May be restricted to residence in a specific region of the country for a period up to 5 years. This is the general residence-establishment visa under Migration Law 11/2017; the Resident Stay Visa sub-types VFR1 (professional activities) and VFR2 (family reunification) on sub0308 are variants of the same residence track.

TON.name: Visitors Visa (Visa Waiver - On Arrival)
TON.purpose: For leisure, family visits, attending workshops/conferences, or government aid projects. Holders may not take up employment, business, or study.
TON.notes: Free on arrival for nationals of visa-waiver countries (31 days for most; 90 days for Schengen nationals; 60 days for UAE nationals; 30 days for Chinese nationals). Extendable up to 6 months total. Non-waiver nationals must apply in advance at the embassy (fee: USD 69, processing 5 working days).

TON.name: Visitors Visa (Embassy Application)
TON.purpose: For nationals not on the visa-waiver list who wish to visit Tonga for leisure, family visits, or short-term purposes. A letter of authority must be obtained before travel.
TON.notes: Non-refundable processing fee of USD 69. Requires valid passport, return itinerary, proof of funds, passport photo, and clear reason for visit. Employment, business, and study are prohibited on this visa.

TON.name: Employment Visa
TON.purpose: For non-Tongan citizens seeking paid or voluntary/charitable employment in Tonga's public or private sectors.
TON.notes: Processing takes approximately one month. Requires letter of support from Ministry of Labour, Commerce & Industries, medical report, police clearance, and character references. For employment of 2+ years without repatriation clause, a TOP 1,000 bond per person may be required. Additional documentation (employment contract, professional qualifications, employer business license) needed for long-term positions.

TON.name: Business Visa
TON.purpose: For non-Tongan citizens or foreign companies wishing to set up or operate a business in Tonga.
TON.notes: Must be obtained before entering Tonga - visitor visa holders are prohibited from undertaking business activities. Processing approximately one month. Requires support letter from Ministry of Labour, Commerce & Industries, medical report, and police clearance. For 2+ year businesses, additional documents include business plan and financial investment evidence.

TON.name: Student Visa
TON.purpose: For students aged 18 or younger intending to attend school in Tonga at any level of education.
TON.notes: Issued for up to one year, renewable. Requires written acceptance from educational institution, proof of tuition payment, sponsor financial support documentation, and a signed declaration from the principal of previous school. Processing approximately one month.

TON.name: Assured Income Visa
TON.purpose: For non-Tongan passport holders seeking to retire in Tonga with a proven regular overseas pension or passive income.
TON.notes: Requires proof of minimum annual income of TOP 10,000 from an overseas pension or fund. Valid for 2 years or more, renewable. Work, study, and business activities are prohibited. Overstay penalty: TOP 1,500. Requires medical report, police clearance, and two character references.

TON.name: Residency Visa
TON.purpose: For persons with Tongan ancestry, former Tongan citizenship, or marriage to a Tongan national who wish to live in Tonga without applying for a recurring entry visa.
TON.notes: Fee is USD 115 for adults (18+) and USD 54.50 for minors. Requires proof of connection to Tonga (birth certificate, marriage certificate, or spouse's Tongan passport). For minors: certified birth certificate plus parent's Tongan ancestry documentation. Sponsor letter required confirming financial support for maintenance, medical, and accommodation. No investment amount required.

TTO.name: eVisa (Multiple Entry)
TTO.purpose: For foreign nationals who require a visa to enter Trinidad and Tobago for tourism, vacation, or business visits. All entry visas are issued electronically; no physical stamp in the passport.
TTO.notes: Fee is 800 TTD (approx. USD 118). Application via the official eVisa portal. Passport must be valid for at least 6 months. A digital passport photograph (JPG) and supporting documents (PDF) are required. Payment by Visa or Mastercard only. Possession of an eVisa does not guarantee entry into Trinidad and Tobago. Applicants from Asian, African, and Far-East countries are advised to apply at least 4 weeks in advance. Contact: immigration.visas@gov.tt.

TTO.name: eVisa (Multiple Entry) - Business
TTO.purpose: For foreign nationals visiting Trinidad and Tobago for business purposes, meetings, conferences, or commercial activities. Issued under the same electronic visa system as tourist visas.
TTO.notes: Fee is 800 TTD (approx. USD 118). Same application process as tourist eVisa. Trinidad and Tobago does not separately categorise tourist and business eVisas on the official portal; both are issued as the general multiple-entry eVisa.

TTO.name: Transit Visa
TTO.purpose: For foreign nationals passing through Trinidad and Tobago in transit to another destination who require a visa under normal circumstances.
TTO.notes: Bona fide operating crew of aircraft or seagoing vessels do not require a visa regardless of nationality. For other transit passengers who are nationals of countries requiring a visa, a transit visa must be obtained in advance. Specific fee and processing details not published on official government websites; applicants should contact immigration.visas@gov.tt.

TTO.name: Student Permit
TTO.purpose: Required for all foreign nationals (except Trinidad and Tobago residents) intending to study in Trinidad and Tobago for the full duration of their studies.
TTO.notes: Fee: 200 TTD (approx. USD 29) for CARICOM nationals; 400 TTD (approx. USD 59) for non-CARICOM nationals. Application via the eStudentPermit portal at estudentpermit.ttservices.online. Passport must be valid for at least 1 year. Digital passport photo and supporting documents required. Registered full-time students at the University of the West Indies St Augustine Campus are exempt. Renewals require an Assessment Form. Contact: immigration.studentpermits@gov.tt.

TTO.name: Work Permit
TTO.purpose: Required for any non-national of Trinidad and Tobago seeking employment in the country. Covers both individual and group work permit applications.
TTO.notes: Fee is 450 TTD per month for the approved period (approx. USD 66/month). Individual applications (1–9 persons) are processed exclusively online via TTBizLink. Group applications (10+ persons) may use fillable PDF forms or the online portal. Persons working for no more than 30 days in any 12 consecutive months are exempt from requiring a work permit. Extensions are available. Contact: eworkpermithelpdesk@mhs.gov.tt or 624-7513.

TTO.name: Minister's Permit
TTO.purpose: A special discretionary permit issued by the Minister with authority over immigration for cases that do not fall under standard visa or work permit categories.
TTO.notes: Application method and specific fee not published on official government websites. Issued at ministerial discretion. Contact: corpcomm@mhs.gov.tt or Level 19-21, Tower C, International Waterfront Centre, Port of Spain (224-4667).

TTO.name: Visa Waiver on Arrival
TTO.purpose: Allows nationals of Australia, New Zealand, and the Philippines to obtain a waiver of the visa requirement upon arrival at a port of entry in Trinidad and Tobago for short tourism or business visits.
TTO.notes: Available only to nationals of Australia, New Zealand, and the Philippines. Fee is 400 TTD (approx. USD 59). Single entry. Maximum stay 30 days. Issued at ports of entry. Possession of a waiver does not guarantee entry.

TTO.name: Extension of Stay
TTO.purpose: Allows visitors already legally in Trinidad and Tobago to extend their permitted stay beyond the period initially granted by immigration upon arrival.
TTO.notes: Appointments must be made at least 2 weeks in advance at regional immigration offices (north, south, Tobago). Specific fee and maximum extension period not published on official government websites. Contact the Immigration Division at immigration.information@gov.tt.

TTO.name: Work Permit Exemption Extension (Venezuelan Nationals)
TTO.purpose: A special work permit exemption extension available specifically for registered Venezuelan nationals lawfully present in Trinidad and Tobago.
TTO.notes: Available only to registered Venezuelan nationals. Application is made online. Specific eligibility criteria, fees, and duration not fully published on the official government overview page.

TTO.name: Diplomatic/Official Visa Exemption
TTO.purpose: Bearers of diplomatic, official, or service passports from countries with bilateral agreements are exempt from visa requirements for the duration of their accredited assignment or up to a specified period.
TTO.notes: Exempt nationalities under diplomatic/official passport bilateral agreements include: Argentina, Brazil, China (diplomatic/official/service), Costa Rica, Cuba (diplomatic/official/service), Haiti (diplomatic/official/service), Mexico, Panama, Venezuela (accredited diplomatic/official/service only; ordinary Venezuelan passports require a visa since June 2019). Terms vary by bilateral agreement - some cover the duration of accreditation, others up to 3 months for non-accredited holders.

TTO.name: CARICOM Skills Certificate (CSME Free Movement)
TTO.purpose: Allows eligible CARICOM nationals holding a Certificate of Recognition of CARICOM Skills Qualification to live and work freely in Trinidad and Tobago under the CARICOM Single Market and Economy framework.
TTO.notes: Available to CARICOM nationals in 12 approved skill categories: University Graduates, Artistes, Musicians, Media Workers, Sportspersons, Nurses, Teachers, Artisans, Associate Degree Holders, Domestic Workers, Agricultural Workers, and Private Security Officers. Processing time is 5–6 weeks minimum. Provides indefinite stay subject to immigration requirements. Not a visa per se but a rights instrument under Article 46 of the Revised Treaty of Chaguaramas.

TTO.name: Resident Status - Marriage to a Citizen/Resident (Section 6(1)(c))
TTO.purpose: For a foreign national married to a citizen or resident of Trinidad and Tobago seeking permanent resident status. This is the spouse/marriage-based residence route.
TTO.notes: Application under Section 6(1)(c) of the Immigration Act. Requires two Form P&16 (available at the Ministry of National Security and the Immigration Office, Scarborough, Tobago), marriage certificate, birth certificates, a statutory declaration of the sponsoring spouse's willingness to support the application, and Police Certificates of Character from Trinidad and Tobago, country of birth, and any country where the applicant has resided 3+ months (US applicants must provide an FBI/Federal certificate). Both applicant and spouse must attend an interview (conducted 8:00am-2:00pm). Applicant must be legally in the country. Fee not published on the official checklist. Handled by the Citizenship and Residency Unit, Temple Court 2, 52-60 Abercromby Street, Port of Spain (623-2441). Checklist selectable from https://nationalsecurity.gov.tt/appforms/residence/.

TTO.name: Resident Status - Sponsorship of Parent/Grandparent (Section 6(1)(b))
TTO.purpose: For a foreign national parent or grandparent being sponsored for permanent resident status by a citizen or resident of Trinidad and Tobago.
TTO.notes: Application under Section 6(1)(b) of the Immigration Act - sponsorship of a parent or grandparent by a citizen/resident of Trinidad and Tobago. Documentation requirements are listed on the official checklist. Fee not published on the official checklist. Handled by the Citizenship and Residency Unit, Temple Court 2, 52-60 Abercromby Street, Port of Spain (623-2441). Checklist selectable from https://nationalsecurity.gov.tt/appforms/residence/.

TTO.name: Resident Status - Work Permit or CSME Certificate Holder (Section 6(1)(a))
TTO.purpose: For foreign nationals who hold a Trinidad and Tobago work permit or a CARICOM (CSME) Skills Certificate and are seeking permanent resident status.
TTO.notes: Application under Section 6(1)(a) of the Immigration Act for holders of a work permit or a Trinidad and Tobago CSME certificate. Documentation requirements are listed on the official checklist. Fee not published on the official checklist. Handled by the Citizenship and Residency Unit, Temple Court 2, 52-60 Abercromby Street, Port of Spain (623-2441). Checklist selectable from https://nationalsecurity.gov.tt/appforms/residence/.

TTO.name: Resident Status - Continuous 5-Year Residence (Section 5(3))
TTO.purpose: Permanent resident status for foreign nationals who have resided continuously in Trinidad and Tobago for a 5-year period.
TTO.notes: Application under Section 5(3) of the Immigration Act - persons who have resided continuously in Trinidad and Tobago for 5 years. This is the general permanent-residence route (also tracked under residence-by-investment/rbi). Documentation requirements are listed on the official checklist. Fee not published on the official checklist. Handled by the Citizenship and Residency Unit, Temple Court 2, 52-60 Abercromby Street, Port of Spain (623-2441). Checklist selectable from https://nationalsecurity.gov.tt/appforms/residence/.

TUN.name: Tourist Visa / Entry Visa (Visa d'entrée)
TUN.purpose: Authorizes a foreign national to enter and stay in Tunisia for tourism or short-term visits. Required for nationals of countries without a bilateral exemption agreement.
TUN.notes: Legal basis: Décret n° 68-198 du 22 juin 1968 (validity not exceeding three months). Fee per the official Tunisian Embassy (Washington DC) visa-services schedule: USD 90 single-entry / USD 180 multiple-entry, applicable to all visa types. Processing up to 21 business days; application requires the Minister of Interior's approval. Nationals of countries with bilateral exemption treaties do not need this visa. Applied for in person at a Tunisian embassy or consulate abroad; no operational e-visa system exists as of mid-2026.

TUN.name: Business Visa (Visa d'affaires)
TUN.purpose: For foreign nationals travelling to Tunisia for business, trade, meetings, or professional activities on a short-term basis.
TUN.notes: Listed as a distinct visa category on the official Tunisian Embassy (Washington DC) visa-services page. Requires an official business invitation letter from the Tunisian host company in addition to a passport valid 6+ months. Fee USD 90 single-entry / USD 180 multiple-entry; processing up to 21 business days. Issued as a short-stay entry visa under the Décret n° 68-198 framework (stay up to three months). Applied for in person at a Tunisian embassy or consulate; nationals of countries with a bilateral exemption may not need it for short business visits.

TUN.name: Transit Visa (Visa de transit)
TUN.purpose: Allows a foreign national to pass through Tunisian territory en route to another destination, with a short permitted stay.
TUN.notes: Defined under Décret n° 68-198 du 22 juin 1968 (stay of up to 7 days). Listed as a distinct category on the official Tunisian Embassy (Washington DC) visa-services page; requires proof of onward travel (airline ticket or cruise confirmation). Fee USD 90 single-entry / USD 180 multiple-entry; processing up to 21 business days. Applied for in person at a Tunisian embassy or consulate abroad.

TUN.name: Temporary Residence Visa (Visa de résidence temporaire)
TUN.purpose: Grants a foreign national temporary residency status in Tunisia for stays exceeding the standard short-term entry allowance, typically for work, study, or extended visits.
TUN.notes: Established under Décret n° 68-198 du 22 juin 1968. Issued to foreigners not intending permanent settlement or those who do not qualify for ordinary residence. Holder receives a temporary residence card matching the visa validity. For stays exceeding 90 days, a residence permit must be obtained from the central police station in the traveler's district.

TUN.name: Ordinary Residence Visa (Visa de résidence ordinaire)
TUN.purpose: Grants long-term or permanent residency status to qualifying foreign nationals with established ties to Tunisia.
TUN.notes: Established under Décret n° 68-198 du 22 juin 1968. Available to: foreigners who have resided temporarily in Tunisia for 5 continuous years; foreign women married to Tunisian nationals; foreigners with Tunisian children; foreigners who have rendered appreciable services to Tunisia. Holder receives an ordinary residence card valid for 2 years, renewable.

TUN.name: Return Visa (Visa de retour)
TUN.purpose: Permits an ordinary resident of Tunisia to travel abroad and return to Tunisia within the visa validity period.
TUN.notes: Established under Décret n° 68-198 du 22 juin 1968. Issued exclusively to holders of ordinary residence status in Tunisia who need to travel abroad. Validity limited to one year.

TUN.name: Exit Visa (Visa de sortie)
TUN.purpose: Authorizes a foreign national holding temporary or ordinary residence in Tunisia to depart the country.
TUN.notes: Established under Décret n° 68-198 du 22 juin 1968. Issued to foreign nationals holding temporary or ordinary residence status in Tunisia who intend to leave the country.

TUR.name: e-Visa (Electronic Visa)
TUR.notes: Available to nationals of 100+ eligible countries. Single-entry most common; multiple-entry available for some nationalities. 30-day max stay per entry within 180-day validity. USD 75 standard fee (fee varies by nationality). Applied online at evisa.gov.tr. Only valid at designated entry points.

TUR.name: Sticker Visa (Consulate Visa)
TUR.purpose: Tourism, business, study, work - for nationalities not eligible for e-Visa
TUR.notes: Physical sticker visa issued by Turkish consulates/embassies. Applied online via the official visa pre-application system (visa.gov.tr, redirects to konsolosluk.gov.tr) then in person or through authorized centers. Required for nationalities not eligible for e-Visa. Processing time and fee vary by nationality and consulate. Multiple-entry and longer validity available.

TUR.name: Work Permit (Çalışma İzni)
TUR.notes: Issued by Ministry of Labour and Social Security. Employer-sponsored application. Initial permit 1 year, extendable to 3 years then indefinite. Foreign worker quota rules: generally max 1 foreigner per 5 Turkish employees. Online application via calismaizni.gov.tr. Applicant must apply within Turkey on a valid residence permit or from abroad.

TUR.name: Student Visa
TUR.purpose: Full-time study at Turkish educational institutions
TUR.notes: For study programs at Turkish universities and language schools. Requires official acceptance letter from a registered Turkish educational institution. Applied via the official visa pre-application system (visa.gov.tr) and Turkish embassy/consulate. Upon arrival, student must register with authorities and obtain student residence permit.

TUR.name: Turkish Citizenship by Investment
TUR.purpose: Citizenship via real estate or capital investment
TUR.notes: Routes: (1) Real estate investment USD 400,000+ (held 3 years); (2) Capital investment USD 500,000+ in Turkish company or government bonds; (3) Employment creation (50+ employees). Citizenship granted directly - no residency period required. Application filed with General Directorate of Migration Management. Citizenship confers Turkish passport and full rights. Dual citizenship permitted.

TUR.name: Business Meeting/Commerce Visa
TUR.purpose: Business meetings, commerce, conferences, seminars, trade fairs and exhibitions
TUR.notes: One of the 'Tourist/Businessperson' visa purposes issued by Turkish missions (business meeting, commerce, conference/seminar, festival/fair/exhibition). Nationals eligible for the e-Visa can travel for business on an e-Visa; others apply for a sticker visa via the official visa pre-application system. Fee and number of entries vary by nationality.

TUR.name: Transit Visa (Single/Double Transit)
TUR.purpose: Travellers passing through Türkiye en route to a third country
TUR.notes: Single- and double-transit visas listed under Türkiye's Tourist/Businessperson visa category. Some nationalities can obtain single/double transit through the e-Visa portal; others apply for a sticker visa. Passengers remaining airside during a connection generally do not need a transit visa.

TUR.name: Medical Treatment Visa
TUR.purpose: Foreign nationals seeking medical treatment at Turkish healthcare facilities, plus accompanying persons
TUR.notes: Issued for medical treatment in Türkiye; a separate 'Accompaniment' visa is available for a companion of the patient. Applied at Turkish missions via the official visa pre-application system. For extended treatment the stay can be continued on a short-term residence permit from the Presidency of Migration Management. Fee varies by nationality.

TUR.name: Family Unification Visa
TUR.purpose: Spouse, children or dependants joining a family member who is a Turkish citizen or legal resident
TUR.notes: Listed under Türkiye's 'Other' visa category as Family Unification. Applied at a Turkish mission via the official visa pre-application system; on arrival the holder obtains a family residence permit from the Presidency of Migration Management. Fee and requirements vary by nationality and sponsor status.

TUR.name: Digital Nomad Visa
TUR.purpose: Remote workers and freelancers employed by or contracting with companies based outside Türkiye
TUR.notes: Launched 2024 via the official GoTürkiye platform. Requirements: aged 21-55, a university degree, and minimum income of USD 3,000/month (USD 36,000/year); work must be for companies outside Türkiye. Two steps: obtain a Digital Nomad Identification Certificate online, then apply for the visa at a Turkish consulate. Grants a short-term residence permit up to 1 year, renewable. Open to nationals of 34 eligible countries (EU/EEA, UK, USA, Canada, Russia, Ukraine, Belarus, etc.).

TUR.name: Turquoise Card (Turkuaz Kart)
TUR.purpose: Highly qualified professionals, scientists, investors, and prominent cultural/sports figures - grants indefinite work rights
TUR.notes: Issued by the Ministry of Labour and Social Security (International Labour Force Directorate) to qualified foreigners, investors, scientists, and cultural figures. Confers rights equivalent to an indefinite (permanent) work permit. Issued with a 3-year transition period that becomes indefinite on application before expiry (extension requests within 180 days of expiry). Spouse and dependent children receive documents serving as residence permits. Distinct from the standard employer-tied work permit.

TUV.name: Visitors Permit (standard)
TUV.purpose: Short-term visit for tourism or personal purposes. No employment, business, study, or proselytising permitted.
TUV.notes: Issued on arrival by the Principal Immigration Officer under Regulation 2(1) of Immigration Regulations CAP 24.15.1 (2022 Revised Edition). Free of charge for nationals of countries listed in Schedule 1 (approximately 37 nationalities/territories including UK, Fiji, Kiribati, Samoa, Tonga, Malaysia, Kenya, etc.). All other nationalities pay AUD $100. Extendable once for a further 30 days (AUD $100 fee for no-work extension, AUD $200 if business/employment intended during extension).

TUV.name: Visitors Permit with Business Endorsement
TUV.purpose: Short-term visit to conduct business activities in Tuvalu, including attending conferences, training, performing professional services, or conducting business negotiations.
TUV.notes: Issued under Regulation 2(3) of Immigration Regulations CAP 24.15.1. Requires a special endorsement from the Principal Immigration Officer. Additional fee of AUD $100 on top of any standard visitor permit fee (so Schedule 1 nationals pay AUD $100 total; all others pay AUD $200 total). Business activities include conferences, training sessions, professional services (including to government and NGOs), and exploratory business negotiations.

TUV.name: Permit to Enter and Reside – Business
TUV.purpose: Allows a foreign national to reside in Tuvalu for the purpose of conducting business for up to one year.
TUV.notes: Issued under Regulations 3 and 5(1) of Immigration Regulations CAP 24.15.1. Fee: AUD $600 for principal applicant + AUD $150 per dependent if applied outside Tuvalu; AUD $1,200 + AUD $300 per dependent if applied inside Tuvalu. Application must include description of business nature and proof of financial resources. Extendable; maximum 3 extensions in any 5-year period unless Minister certifies national interest. Requires good health and character, valid outward ticket or repatriation bond.

TUV.name: Permit to Enter and Reside – Employment
TUV.purpose: Allows a foreign national to reside in Tuvalu to undertake paid employment for up to one year.
TUV.notes: Issued under Regulations 3 and 5(2) of Immigration Regulations CAP 24.15.1. Fee: AUD $600 for principal applicant + AUD $150 per dependent if applied outside Tuvalu; AUD $1,200 + AUD $300 per dependent if applied inside Tuvalu. Must be accompanied by employer sponsorship form (Form 5). Permit is cancelled if employment ceases or changes. Extendable; maximum 3 extensions in any 5-year period. Medical and radiological examination required if stay exceeds one year.

TUV.name: Permit to Enter and Reside – Study
TUV.purpose: Allows a foreign national to reside in Tuvalu to pursue study for up to one year.
TUV.notes: Issued under Regulation 3(1)(c) of Immigration Regulations CAP 24.15.1. Fee: AUD $300 for principal applicant + AUD $150 per dependent. Study on a standard Visitors Permit is explicitly prohibited; this permit is required for any period of study. Extendable up to 3 times in any 5-year period.

TUV.name: Permit to Enter and Reside – Academic or Scientific Research
TUV.purpose: Allows a foreign national to reside in Tuvalu for the purpose of academic or scientific research for up to one year.
TUV.notes: Issued under Regulation 3(1)(d) of Immigration Regulations CAP 24.15.1. Fee: AUD $600 for principal applicant + AUD $300 per dependent. One of the enumerated purposes for the Permit to Enter and Reside. Same general application process and extensibility rules apply.

TUV.name: Permit to Enter and Reside – Cultural or Religious Purpose
TUV.purpose: Allows a foreign national to reside in Tuvalu for a cultural or religious purpose for up to one year.
TUV.notes: Issued under Regulation 3(1)(e) of Immigration Regulations CAP 24.15.1. Fee: AUD $100 for principal applicant + AUD $50 per dependent. Note: proselytising is explicitly prohibited on a standard Visitors Permit, making this the appropriate permit for religious workers or missionaries requiring a longer stay.

TUV.name: Permit to Enter and Reside – Family Reunion or Family Support
TUV.purpose: Allows a foreign national to reside in Tuvalu for the purpose of family reunion or to provide family support for up to one year.
TUV.notes: Issued under Regulation 3(1)(f) of Immigration Regulations CAP 24.15.1. Fee: AUD $100 for principal applicant + AUD $50 per dependent. Covers both reunion with family members already residing in Tuvalu and providing support to family members. Distinct from the accompanying-person permit under Regulation 3(1)(g) (a separate entry).

TUV.name: Permit to Enter and Reside – Accompanying Person (Dependant)
TUV.purpose: Allows the spouse, children or other dependants accompanying a principal Permit to Enter and Reside holder to enter and reside in Tuvalu for the duration of the principal permit holder's stay.
TUV.notes: Issued under Regulation 3(1)(g) of Immigration Regulations CAP 24.15.1 (2022 Revised Edition) to a person entering Tuvalu 'for the purpose of accompanying a person entering Tuvalu under this subsection' — i.e. the spouse and children of a principal business, employment, study or research permit holder. No standalone fee is prescribed in Regulation 7; accompanying persons are charged as 'dependents' of the principal applicant (AUD $50 to $300 each, depending on the principal's purpose category and whether the application is lodged inside or outside Tuvalu). The permit is tied to, and cancelled with, the principal holder's permit. Any accompanying person aged over 16 who intends to reside for 12 months or more must complete a medical examination (Form 7) and radiological examination (Form 8) per Regulation 4(2).

TUV.name: Permit to Enter and Reside – Minister-Approved Purpose
TUV.purpose: A discretionary permit issued for any purpose not enumerated in the standard categories, approved at the Minister's discretion.
TUV.notes: Issued under Regulation 3(1)(h) of Immigration Regulations CAP 24.15.1. Fee: AUD $200 for principal applicant + AUD $100 per dependent. Requires Ministerial approval. Acts as a catch-all category for purposes not otherwise listed (e.g. medical treatment, diplomatic non-immunity personnel, etc.).

TWN.name: Visitor Visa - Tourism
TWN.purpose: For foreign nationals wishing to visit Taiwan for tourism, sightseeing, or leisure purposes.
TWN.notes: Stay options of 14, 30, 60, or 90 days available. Validity generally 3 months to 1 year. Single-entry fee US$50; multiple-entry US$100. Extensions possible at NIA for 60- and 90-day stays (up to 120 and 90 additional days respectively). Online application at visawebapp.boca.gov.tw. Passport must be valid for at least 6 months.

TWN.name: Visitor Visa - Business
TWN.purpose: For foreign nationals conducting commercial business activities in Taiwan, including meetings, negotiations, and trade activities.
TWN.notes: Stay options of 14, 30, 60, or 90 days. Evidence of business activities required (employment letter, invitation letter, or trading records). For nationals of designated countries: guarantor documentation required with NT$50/page cable fee. Single-entry US$50, multiple-entry US$100.

TWN.name: Visitor Visa - Employment
TWN.purpose: For foreign nationals who have obtained an approved work permit from Taiwan's Ministry of Labor and intend to take up employment in Taiwan.
TWN.notes: Requires Approval Letter issued by Taiwan Ministry of Labor prior to visa application. Applicants typically convert to Resident Visa after arrival. Employers must obtain work permits before visa application.

TWN.name: Resident Visa - White Collar Worker
TWN.purpose: For skilled professional foreign workers taking up employment in Taiwan with an approved work permit, allowing residence for the duration of employment.
TWN.notes: Resident visa validity 3 months; holder must apply for Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) within 30 days of arrival at NIA. Stay duration tied to ARC validity. Single-entry resident visa NT$2,200 / US$66; multiple-entry NT$4,400 / US$132. Domestic conversion from visitor visa incurs additional NT$800 handling fee.

TWN.name: Resident Visa - Full-time Academic Student
TWN.purpose: For foreign nationals admitted to a full-time degree program (secondary, bachelor's, master's, or doctoral) at a recognized Taiwan educational institution.
TWN.notes: Admission letter from a recognized Taiwan university or school required. Must apply for ARC within 30 days of arrival. Stay tied to ARC/enrollment validity.

TWN.name: Visitor Visa - Studying Chinese
TWN.purpose: For foreign nationals enrolled in Mandarin Chinese language courses at approved language centers in Taiwan.
TWN.notes: Enrollment documentation from approved Mandarin language center required. Extensions available through NIA.

TWN.name: Digital Nomad Visitor Visa
TWN.purpose: For remote workers from visa-exempt countries who wish to live in Taiwan while working for a foreign employer or as a freelancer.
TWN.notes: Only nationals of Taiwan visa-exempt countries are eligible. Age 30+: annual salary of at least USD 40,000 in last 2 years; age 20-29: at least USD 20,000. Alternative: hold a digital nomad visa from another country. Bank statements must show average monthly balance of at least USD 10,000 over 6 months. International health insurance covering full hospitalization required. Applications outside Taiwan submitted to ROC overseas missions; those already in Taiwan must apply at BOCA/MOFA at least 10 working days before current stay expires. Max stay and validity period not stated verbatim on official page.

TWN.name: Visitor Visa - Japanese Retirees (Age 55+)
TWN.purpose: A special long-stay visitor visa for Japanese nationals aged 55 and older who wish to spend retirement time in Taiwan.
TWN.notes: Exclusive to Japanese nationals. Two options: 1-year multiple-entry visa (requires insurance valid at least 2 years) or 6-month multiple-entry visa (insurance valid 6 months to 2 years). Each stay is non-extendable and up to 180 days. Requires proof of financial assets of at least USD 50,000 plus pension documentation. Police clearance certificate required. Accompanying spouse has no age requirement.

TWN.name: Resident Visa - Investment
TWN.purpose: For foreign nationals making a qualifying investment in Taiwan who intend to reside in Taiwan to manage their investment.
TWN.notes: Minimum investment of USD 200,000. Proof of investment issued by competent central government authority required. Visa validity 3 months; ARC must be applied for within 30 days of arrival. Processing: 8 working days for domestic applications.

TWN.name: Entrepreneur Visa (Startup Resident Visa)
TWN.purpose: For foreign nationals who establish or join a startup company in Taiwan and meet recognized entrepreneurial criteria.
TWN.notes: Initial 2-year validity, extendable in 2-year increments. Renewal criteria: annual gross revenue NTD 3M+, OR average revenue over 3 years, OR operating expenses NTD 1M+/year, OR employment of 3+ full-time ROC nationals. Processing 30 working days initial; 22 working days for extensions. Apply via Foreign Professionals Online Application Platform.

TWN.name: Employment Gold Card
TWN.purpose: A combined open work permit, resident visa, Alien Resident Certificate, and re-entry permit for highly skilled foreign professionals in 11 designated fields.
TWN.notes: Valid 1, 2, or 3 years (applicant's choice). Eligible fields: Architecture, Arts and Culture, Digital, Economy, Education, Finance, National Defense, Science and Technology, Law, Sports, Biotechnology/Environment. Fees vary: NT$3,700-NT$5,700 (most foreign passports); US passport holders abroad pay NT$7,605-NT$9,605. Process can exceed 60 business days. Open work authorization - work for any employer. Special tax incentives available. Apply at coa.immigration.gov.tw.

TWN.name: Working Holiday Visa
TWN.purpose: For young nationals of eligible countries to travel and work in Taiwan for up to one year, experiencing Taiwanese culture and supplementing travel funds through employment.
TWN.notes: Eligible countries: Australia, Austria, Belgium, Canada, Czech Republic, France, Germany, Hungary, Ireland, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand, Poland, Slovakia. Israel suspended as of May 2025. Age limits vary by country (typically 18-30 or 18-35). Specific requirements per country available via individual country guideline documents on BOCA site.

TWN.name: Visitor Visa - Employment-Seeking
TWN.purpose: For qualified foreign professionals seeking employment opportunities in Taiwan, allowing them to job-search during their stay.
TWN.notes: Eligibility: average monthly salary over past 6 months of at least NT$47,971; OR recent graduate (within 1 year) from a world top-1,500 university and currently unemployed; OR deemed eligible by MOFA. Requires financial proof of at least NT$100,000, health/hospitalization insurance, certificate of good conduct, and employment-seeking plan. Passport with 6+ months validity required.

TWN.name: Resident Visa - Foreign Spouse of ROC Citizen
TWN.purpose: For foreign nationals married to ROC citizens to reside in Taiwan for family reunification.
TWN.notes: Two sub-categories: Foreign Spouses of ROC Citizens with Household Registration, and without Household Registration (also covers Hong Kong/Macau/mainland Chinese residents via separate rules). Marriage certificate and supporting documents required. ARC must be obtained within 30 days of arrival.

TWN.name: Resident Visa - Minors Joining Family
TWN.purpose: For foreign minors under age 18 joining parents or grandparents residing in Taiwan.
TWN.notes: Requires proof of parent's or grandparent's legal residence in Taiwan. ARC must be obtained within 30 days of arrival.

TWN.name: Visitor Visa - Medical Treatment
TWN.purpose: For foreign nationals traveling to Taiwan to receive medical treatment for diseases on the designated 28 Disease Item List for Foreign Nationals at recognized Taiwan medical institutions.
TWN.notes: Must provide diagnosis and treatment proposal from a Taiwan medical institution and proof of funds. Up to 2 accompanying family members (spouse or relatives within third degree) and 2 medical personnel from home country allowed. Urgent cases can be initiated directly by Taiwan medical institutions.

TWN.name: Landing Visa (Transit/Emergency)
TWN.purpose: For nationals of visa-exempt countries holding emergency or temporary passports who need to enter Taiwan.
TWN.notes: Only for holders of emergency or temporary passports from visa-exempt countries (USA excluded). Fee: NT$1,600 (or gratis for reciprocal agreement countries) plus NT$800 handling fee (approximately US$24 additional). Stay non-extendable, begins day after arrival. Available at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (on-site BOCA office). Other airports (Songshan, Taichung, Kaohsiung) require temporary entry permit first. Cannot be converted to visitor or resident visa under normal circumstances.

TWN.name: Visitor Visa - Volunteering
TWN.purpose: For foreign nationals participating in approved volunteer programs in Taiwan.
TWN.notes: Volunteer program documentation and approval required. Single-entry fee US$50.

TWN.name: Visitor Visa - Conference and Exhibition
TWN.purpose: For foreign nationals attending international conferences, exhibitions, or trade shows held in Taiwan.
TWN.notes: Invitation letter from conference or exhibition organizer required. Also available as eVisa for eligible nationalities attending international conferences.

TWN.name: Resident Visa - Official Duties / International Exchange
TWN.purpose: For foreign nationals serving in official capacities or participating in international exchange programs approved by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
TWN.notes: Official letters of approval from competent authority required. Gratis issuance for reciprocal agreement countries. Diplomatic and official passport holders may have separate exemption arrangements.

TWN.name: Visitor Visa - Visiting Relatives
TWN.purpose: For foreign nationals making a short-term visit to relatives residing in Taiwan (family reunion / visiting family).
TWN.notes: Distinct from the resident visa for spouses/dependents - this is a short-stay visitor visa for visiting relatives. Requires proof of the relative's legal residence in Taiwan and relationship documents. Standard visitor visa fee applies (single-entry US$50; multiple-entry US$100 per BOCA's Standard Fees schedule). Stay duration, validity, and entries not stated verbatim on the official page.

TWN.name: Visitor Visa - Internship
TWN.purpose: For foreign nationals undertaking an approved internship in Taiwan.
TWN.notes: Requires an approval/permit letter issued by a competent government agency (e.g. Ministry of the Interior, Ministry of Economic Affairs, or Ministry of Health and Welfare). Standard visitor visa fee applies (single-entry US$50; multiple-entry US$100). Stay duration, validity, and entries not stated verbatim on the official page.

TWN.name: Visitor Visa - Religious Work
TWN.purpose: For foreign missionaries and religious professionals (pastors, priests, nuns, monks, imams) conducting religious activities in Taiwan.
